attrs.summary: The Patient Authentication & Profile Management module enables patients to securely register, authenticate, and manage their personal profiles within the Hairline platform.
FR-002 defines shared backend engines for processing medical intake data and head media, consumed by FR-003 (Inquiry) and others.

The Inquiry Submission & Distribution module enables patients to submit comprehensive treatment requests through the mobile app, which are then automatically distributed to relevant providers based on location and availability.
The Quote Submission & Management module enables providers to create, edit, submit, and manage detailed quote responses for distributed patient inquiries.
The Quote Comparison & Acceptance module enables patients to review quotes from multiple providers, including multiple parent quotes from the same provider.
Enable patients to convert one accepted subquote into a confirmed procedure booking by paying a deposit or first installment.

Enable patients to pay securely for procedures (deposit at booking and final payment before or on procedure day) in supported currencies and methods, while ensuring compliant handling of payments, automated receipt/invoice generation, platform commission calculation, and timely provider payouts after treatment completion.

Enable patients to pay for hair transplant procedures through interest-free installment plans spanning 2-9 months, providing financial flexibility while ensuring full payment completion 30 days before the scheduled procedure date.
Enable coordinated travel logistics for patients and providers across the full appointment lifecycle.

The Provider Team & Role Management feature enables multi-user collaboration within provider organizations by allowing clinic owners to invite team members, assign role-based permissions, and manage access to the Hairline platform.
The Treatment Execution & Documentation module enables providers to document the entire hair transplant procedure lifecycle from patient arrival through treatment completion.

The Aftercare & Recovery Management module provides comprehensive post-procedure support for hair transplant patients through milestone-based tracking, scan monitoring, questionnaire assessments, and multi-tenant communication.

Enable secure, auditable, real-time messaging and audio/video communication between patients and providers across the Hairline platform to support quote clarification, procedure coordination, and patient care.

Enable patients with completed treatment cases to submit post-procedure reviews with structured ratings and optional photos, published immediately upon submission (no pre-publication moderation gate).
The Provider Analytics & Reporting module delivers a 13-screen suite (12 analytical + 1 export config) split across two tenants: provider and admin.
The Provider Management module enables administrators to onboard and manage hair transplant providers who will serve patients through the Hairline platform.
The Admin Patient Management module provides Hairline internal administrators with comprehensive oversight and management capabilities for all patient accounts and activities across the platform.

The Admin Billing & Financial Management module provides Hairline administrators with comprehensive tools to manage the platform's financial operations across all stakeholders (patients, providers, and affiliates).
The Affiliate Management module enables Hairline to partner with external entities (influencers, clinics, organizations) who promote the platform in exchange for commission-based compensation.
Define, approve, and apply discounts across the Hairline platform with clear governance and auditability.
Provide reliable, configurable notifications (email, push, optional SMS in future phases) for key lifecycle events across patients and providers.
FR-021 defines Hairline's multi-language and localization capability across the Patient App, Provider Dashboard, Admin Platform, and system-delivered communications.
Search and filtering capabilities are critical for enabling users to efficiently navigate large datasets across the Hairline platform.
Establish organization-wide data retention, auditability, and privacy controls to meet healthcare and financial record-keeping obligations while honoring user privacy rights.
The Treatment & Package Management module establishes a two-tier content management system for medical procedures and service packages within the Hairline platform.

The Medical Questionnaire Management module enables administrators to manage a central catalog of questionnaire sets, where each set is a named, versioned package of questions (e.g., "Medical Safety Screening", "Pain Assessment", "Sleep Quality Check").

The App Settings & Security Policies module provides a centralized, audited, and versioned configuration surface for application-wide settings, security policies, app data lists, and notification templates that affect multiple modules and tenants (Patient, Provider, Admin).
Provide centralized management of legal content (Terms & Conditions, Privacy Policy, Consent forms, Cancellation Policy) with versioning, preview, publishing, acceptance tracking, and audit trail.

The Regional Configuration & Pricing module enables Hairline administrators to control how treatment locations (countries/cities) are presented to patients and set starting price estimates for different regions and currencies.
The Payment System Configuration module empowers platform administrators to manage the complete payment infrastructure for the Hairline multi-tenant platform.
The Notification Rules & Configuration module provides comprehensive administrative control over the Hairline platform's notification system.

The Admin Access Control & Permissions module is a Super Admin-only configuration tool that serves as the single source of truth for all role definitions and permission matrices across the entire Hairline platform.

Provider Dashboard Settings & Profile Management enables clinic administrators and staff to configure their organization's profile, account settings, notification preferences, billing information, and team member permissions.
The Help Centre Content Management module provides a centralized knowledge base and support system for both provider and patient platforms.
The Support Center & Ticketing System provides a unified formal support system for managing both patient and provider inquiries, technical issues, feedback submissions, and general support requests.
The Patient Help Center & Support Submission module provides the patient-facing interface for accessing self-service help content and submitting support requests directly from the patient mobile app.
Monitor Your Hair Loss gives a patient a structured, longitudinal record of their hair-loss condition before they decide whether to request treatment.

Monitor Your Transplant Progress is a self-service utility for patients whose hair transplant may have been performed outside Hairline and who want to record recovery progress without buying an aftercare package.

attrs.rationale: General Rules 1 (prd.md line 204). Close to REQ-002-010 but adds the audit content. Assumption (line 368): access is mediated by platform RBAC and immutable audit logging.

nodes.title: Engine stateless; draft UX in FR-003

attrs.statement: Draft/submit/edit UX is defined in FR-003; engine is stateless between calls except persisted artifacts.
attrs.rationale: General Rules 2 (line 205). Shared Services (line 50): engine operations are stateless between calls except for persisted artifacts. Implementation Notes (line 374): artifacts persisted in storage with references returned.

nodes.title: Medical records kept 7 years; no hard deletes

attrs.statement: Medical records retained minimum 7 years; deletion requests result in archival/anonymization (no hard deletes).
attrs.rationale: Data & Privacy Rules 2 (line 211). Applies at the patient deleted stage because deletion requests are named. FR-023 (Data Retention & Compliance) is not migrated yet and may own retention; see report.

nodes.title: Role-based access; admin sensitive views logged

attrs.statement: All access is role-based; admin access is logged with justification for sensitive views.
attrs.rationale: Data & Privacy Rules 3 (line 212).

attrs.statement: Intake payloads and media artifacts processed under this FR are encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256), in alignment with the Constitution and FR-026.
attrs.rationale: Data & Privacy Rules 4 (line 213).

nodes.title: V1 head media is a standardized photo set

attrs.statement: For V1, head media is a standardized photo set captured in the patient app and uploaded to the system (not a true 3D model).
attrs.rationale: Media Rules 1 (line 217). Executive Summary (lines 11 and 13): V1 'scan' is a standardized head scan photo set (multiple 2D views); true 3D capture is deferred to V2.

nodes.title: Photo set must include required viewpoints

attrs.statement: Photo set MUST include required viewpoints (e.g., front/top/left/right/back) as defined by policy (A-09).
attrs.rationale: Media Rules 2 (line 218). Implementation Notes (line 377): V1 validates photo set completeness (required views). Error code MEDIA_INCOMPLETE_VIEW_SET (User Story 2, line 252).

nodes.title: Allowed formats and size limits enforced

attrs.statement: Allowed formats: JPG/PNG; maximum per-file size and maximum total size MUST be enforced via policy (A-09).
attrs.rationale: Media Rules 3 (line 219). Error code MEDIA_SIZE_EXCEEDED with compression guidance (line 253); edge case 'oversize file' (line 260).

nodes.title: Basic quality checks with actionable guidance

attrs.statement: Basic quality checks (e.g., brightness/blur) MUST be enforced and actionable guidance returned on failure.
attrs.rationale: Media Rules 4 (line 220). Error code MEDIA_QUALITY_INSUFFICIENT with retake instructions (line 254); edge case 'media too short or poor lighting' (line 258). The thresholds are a Setting only by inference from 'below threshold' (line 254); see report.

nodes.title: Video duration limits apply if video is accepted

attrs.statement: If `headVideo` is accepted (optional fallback/future), duration constraints (min/max) apply via policy (A-09).
attrs.rationale: Media Rules 5 (line 221). Implementation Notes (line 377): duration applies only if video is accepted.

nodes.title: Failed validation returns error codes, stores nothing

attrs.statement: On validation failure, engine returns structured error codes and guidance to the caller (FR-003); no artifacts persisted.
attrs.rationale: Media Rules 6 (line 222). Repeated as Alternative Flow A1 (from line 98, caller can retry), integration contract rules (line 198) and edge cases (lines 258-260). Error codes named in User Story 2 (lines 252-254): MEDIA_INCOMPLETE_VIEW_SET, MEDIA_SIZE_EXCEEDED, MEDIA_QUALITY_INSUFFICIENT. Close to REQ-002-013, which states only the error codes.

attrs.statement: Engine records used version and returns policy-compliant response (or requests resubmission per FR-025 rules)
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A2 (from line 110): the engine records templateVersionUsed in the audit log. Repeated in Edge Cases (line 259).

nodes.title: Accepted media forms in the request

attrs.statement: Request media is one of: headScanPhotoSet { uris[], sizeBytesTotal?, viewHints? } (V1: standardized photo set capture); headVideo { uri, durationSeconds, sizeBytes, frameHints? } (optional fallback / future); altPhotos { uris[] } or altClips { uris[] } (aligns with system PRD supplemental media support)
attrs.rationale: Integration contract Request (lines 180-183). Key Entities note (line 336): V1 expects media as headScanPhotoSet; headVideo is optional fallback/future.

nodes.title: Distribution of processed payload through FR-003

attrs.statement: FR-003 retrieves engine-normalized payload and media URIs for distribution
attrs.rationale: Workflow 2 trigger and steps 1-2 (from line 124): FR-003 distributes to providers.

nodes.title: Admin edits versioned; prior versions stay available

attrs.statement: Admin edits are versioned; prior versions remain accessible for existing inquiries.
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability 3 (line 228).

nodes.title: New inquiries use latest published template

attrs.statement: System keeps prior versions for existing inquiries; new inquiries use the latest published version
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow C1 (from line 158): admin deprecates a template version; system marks it deprecated but preserves it for existing inquiries. Workflow 3 step 4: applies to new inquiries only. Business Process assumption (line 367): new submissions use the latest published questionnaire/rules; existing retain prior versions.

nodes.title: Patient creates and submits inquiry with full content

attrs.statement: System MUST allow patients to create and submit inquiries with destinations, media, date ranges, head scan media (V1 photo set; V2 true 3D), and medical questionnaire.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Workflow 1 outcome (complete inquiry created with destinations, media, head scan reference, date ranges and medical questionnaire; inquiry ID generated) and the Inquiry Payload composition list.

nodes.title: Inquiry distributed to matching and selected providers

attrs.statement: System MUST distribute completed inquiries to matching providers in selected countries and those explicitly chosen by the patient.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Distribution Rules 1 (providers in selected countries OR explicitly selected by patient) and Screen 9 (only inquiries for the provider's countries OR explicitly selected by the patient).

nodes.title: Providers see anonymized patient data and tiered alerts

attrs.statement: Providers MUST see anonymized patient data and tiered medical alerts until payment/acceptance per system PRD.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Workflow 2 last step (provider views enforce anonymization until payment and show medical alerts prominently) and Data Access Rules 1.

nodes.title: Draft autosave and resume with 7-day inactivity expiry

attrs.statement: System MUST support draft autosave and resume with 7-day inactivity expiry for incomplete inquiries.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Alternative Flow A1 (draft saved automatically; patient can resume within 7 days; draft expires after 7 days of inactivity) and User Story 2.

nodes.title: Admin views, edits, reassigns, soft deletes and overrides with audit

attrs.statement: Admin MUST be able to view, edit (with warnings), reassign, soft delete, and override distribution/expiration with full audit trail.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Workflow 4 and Admin Editability Rules.

nodes.title: Inquiry data retained at least 7 years

attrs.statement: System MUST retain inquiry data for at least 7 years; scan retention per system policy.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Data Retention (inquiry data retained for 7 years minimum) and the Screen 8 rule (inquiry data persists for 7 years minimum).

nodes.title: Inquiry linked to patient, providers, locations, scan and questionnaire

attrs.statement: System MUST link inquiries to patients, providers, locations, head scan media, and questionnaire responses.

nodes.title: Patient name masked and contact details hidden until payment

attrs.statement: System MUST mask patient names and hide phone numbers and email addresses until payment confirmation; patient ID (HPID-based) may remain visible as a pseudonymous identifier.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Data Access Rules 1 and Data and Privacy 2 (patient direct identifiers name, phone number, email anonymized until payment confirmation), Screen 9 (patient names partially masked until payment confirmation), Screen 10 (full patient details visible only after payment confirmation) and UI/UX Display Rule 5.

attrs.statement: System MUST encrypt all inquiry-related data at rest and in transit, and maintain immutable audit logs.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Data and Privacy 1 and 3 (all inquiry data encrypted at rest and in transit) and Security Considerations.

nodes.title: Shared Services used for notifications and media

attrs.statement: System MUST integrate with Shared Services for notifications and media/scan handling.

nodes.title: Internal APIs let FR-004 read inquiry without mutation

attrs.statement: System MUST expose internal APIs required by FR-004 (quote) to consume inquiry data without mutation.

nodes.title: Patient cancels in Inquiry or Quoted; admin only afterwards

attrs.statement: System MUST allow patients to cancel their own inquiry in Inquiry or Quoted stages with a required cancellation reason; cancellation is immediate and irreversible. From the Accepted stage onward, System MUST NOT offer patient cancellation; it MUST show "Contact support", and cancellation is performed only by an admin through FR-006.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Cancellation Rules 4 (cancellation is immediate and irreversible; no grace period, no admin approval required; reason required with predefined options), Workflow 5 and Alternative Flow E2.

nodes.title: Inquiry cancellation cascade to draft, sent and expired quotes

attrs.statement: System MUST auto-cancel only the draft, sent, and expired quotes when an inquiry is cancelled by the patient, with distinct cancellation status "Cancelled (Inquiry Cancelled)"; quotes in any other status MUST keep their status and cause, and `quote.cancelled_inquiry` (FR-020) MUST go only to providers whose quotes were cancelled by this cascade.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Alternative Flow A4, Workflow 5 outcome, Alternative Flow E3 and Cancellation Rules 4 (all associated draft, sent and expired quotes auto-cancelled with status Cancelled (Inquiry Cancelled)).

nodes.title: Admin booking cancellation cancels inquiry and releases hold

attrs.statement: When an admin cancels a booking through FR-006, System MUST set the inquiry to `Cancelled`, release any active appointment slot hold (FR-006 hold of the FR-026 configured duration) immediately, and leave the accepted quote with the status `accepted`.

nodes.title: Provider capacity management handled by a separate FR

attrs.statement: Provider capacity management is referenced but handled by a separate FR (TBD); integration expectations remain.

nodes.title: Exclusive provider decline releases to normal distribution once

attrs.statement: When the exclusive provider explicitly declines an FR-037 monitoring-conversion inquiry before quote creation, the system MUST audit the decline reason, remove exclusive routing, and execute normal inquiry distribution exactly once.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Distribution Rules 2, Workflow 3 diagram, Alternative Flow C2, Screen 10 business rules and User Story 3 scenario 4.

nodes.title: Treatment-area catalog exposed for inquiry creation

attrs.statement: System MUST expose an active, ordered treatment-area catalog for inquiry creation, including a stable option identifier, label, and image/icon URL; Admin manages the catalog under FR-026.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 1 Treatment Area notes (catalog retrieved from the Inquiry Configuration API; each option has a stable identifier, patient-facing label and image/icon URL; Hair, Beard and Both remain the default seeded options and are not a fixed client-side enum) and Inquiry Configuration Rules 5.

nodes.title: Minimum lead time enforced in date picker and at submission

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce the Admin-configured minimum inquiry lead time consistently in the patient date picker and at submission. The default blocked window is 3 days and does not change the existing two-year, non-overlap, or availability rules.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 5 notes and rules (minimum lead time from inquiry date is the active Admin-configured blocked window, default 3 days; calendar eligibility and submission validation use the same value).

nodes.title: Provider status revalidated at allocation, routing and reassignment

attrs.statement: System MUST revalidate provider status at allocation, exclusive routing, and reassignment, and MUST NOT allocate inquiries to a `Suspended` or `Deactivated` provider from the effective time, including through in-flight jobs or retries, or to an `Active` provider whose FR-015 `password_set` is false. On inquiry submission, an explicitly selected provider that has become ineligible MUST be rejected with a validation error that names the provider, so the patient can choose another; it MUST NOT be removed from the selection silently (Screen 7a).
attrs.rationale: Restated by Distribution Rules 2, Rule 6 (Active provider with password_set false is not eligible), Workflow 2 matching and exclusive routing, Workflow 4 reassignment, Screen 7a and the edge case for a distribution job or retry that targets a provider that became Suspended or Deactivated after matching (allocation is revalidated and skipped; no ProviderInquiry or notification is created).

nodes.title: Provider suspension or deactivation keeps accepted inquiry open

attrs.statement: When a provider becomes `Suspended` or `Deactivated`, System MUST NOT cancel an inquiry whose accepted treatment belongs to that provider; it MUST keep the inquiry open with `supportRequired = true` while FR-006 Alternative Flow B4 records cause `ProviderSuspended` or `ProviderDeactivated` on the booking; before treatment starts, B4 closes the booking and an admin rehomes the patient through FR-006 Alternative Flow B5, an `In Progress` booking stays `In Progress` for the admin decision in FR-006 Alternative Flow B7, and an `Aftercare` booking follows FR-006 Alternative Flow B6; for inquiries still comparing providers, System MUST cancel only that provider's ProviderInquiry participation and quotes, keep the inquiry stage, flag it `supportRequired = true`, and preserve other providers' offers. Before acceptance, patients MUST receive the offer-unavailability message with Contact Admin/Support; after acceptance and before treatment starts, they MUST receive the `booking.provider_fault_replacement` notice that an admin will arrange a replacement provider within the same inquiry. Patients MUST NOT receive the patient-cancellation message in either case (FR-015 A5/Screen 4).

nodes.title: Automatic redistribution after cascade removes the last live offer

attrs.statement: Before acceptance, when the provider-status cascade cancels a live offer (a sent quote that has not expired) and the patient has no other live offer on the inquiry, System MUST automatically redistribute the inquiry, at most once per provider-status event, to eligible providers that have not yet received it under the normal Workflow 2 distribution rules, keep `supportRequired = true`, and tell the patient "[Clinic] is no longer available. We are finding new offers for you." If the patient had explicitly selected the affected provider, System MUST ask the patient to confirm and MUST redistribute only after confirmation. System MUST NOT redistribute while another live offer remains (Workflow 2 Alternative Flow B4).
attrs.rationale: Restated by Workflow 2 Alternative Flow B4 step 3 (redistribution removes the exclusive restriction for an FR-037 exclusive inquiry; while the patient has not confirmed the inquiry is not redistributed and the patient keeps the Contact Admin/Support action; runs at most once per provider-status event and inquiry) and the matching edge case.

attrs.statement: Entry points: Patient-Initiated (primary flow through mobile app inquiry creation); Admin-Managed (direct inquiry creation and management by admin team); Provider-Viewed (provider access to distributed inquiries).
attrs.rationale: PRD Entry Points (69-71).

nodes.title: No direct patient-provider chat in this module

attrs.statement: Out of scope: direct patient-provider chat (handled by FR-012).

nodes.title: Providers cannot modify patient data before a quote

attrs.statement: Given pre-quote stage, when a provider attempts to modify patient data, the system blocks and logs read-only access. Provider can review inquiry details.
attrs.rationale: User Story 3 scenario 3 (1396); Screen 10 business rules (924); Provider Platform scope (35-37).

nodes.title: Primary service is Get a Hair Transplant; other services use other workflows

attrs.statement: Service options: "Get a Hair Transplant" (primary option); "Monitor Hair Loss", "Aftercare: Monitor Transplant Progress" and "Aftercare for Transplant" (secondary - different workflow). Primary focus on "Get a Hair Transplant" option; other services are secondary features.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 1 notes and business rules (463-484).

nodes.title: Patient eligibility validated at service selection

attrs.statement: System validates patient eligibility; if eligibility is not valid, show an eligibility error and block progression.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 1 flow diagram, service step (79-87).

nodes.title: One active treatment-area option chosen; inactive options stay readable

attrs.statement: Patient must select one active treatment-area option. The selected option must be active when the inquiry is created; inactive options remain readable on historical inquiries through their saved snapshot.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 1 business rules (478-481); Inquiry Configuration Rules 5.

nodes.title: Used treatment-area option cannot be deleted

attrs.statement: A treatment-area option used by an existing inquiry cannot be deleted. It may be deactivated for future inquiries while historical inquiry display retains the saved label and asset reference.
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules, Inquiry Configuration Rules 5 (1041-1042).

nodes.title: Lead time is an Admin-set whole number of blocked days

attrs.statement: Admin configures the minimum inquiry lead time as a whole number of blocked days. The default is 3; the permitted value is 0 through 730, consistent with the existing two-year date horizon.
attrs.rationale: PRD Inquiry Configuration Rules 5 (1043).

nodes.title: Patient platform reads catalog and lead time from the backend

attrs.statement: The patient platform retrieves the current catalog and lead-time setting from the backend. A client release is not required for ordinary option or lead-time changes only after implementation verifies compatibility with this dynamic response.
attrs.rationale: PRD Inquiry Configuration Rules 5 (1044).

attrs.statement: Maximum 10 countries selectable. Country selection limited to 10 countries maximum.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 2 rules (510), Validation and Constraints 1 (1161), Workflow 1 destination step (89).

nodes.title: Countries ordered by FR-028 regional configuration, else proximity

attrs.statement: Countries ordered by FR-028 regional configuration when available, otherwise by proximity to patient location. System suggests nearest countries to patient's location first.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 2 data fields and rules (500-513).

nodes.title: Starting price shown per destination country with fallback currency

attrs.statement: Starting prices displayed for transparency. Starting price per country; currency based on patient location; fallback pricing for unsupported currencies.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 2 notes and rules (503-513).

nodes.title: Detailed hair-concern fields: four required, two optional

attrs.statement: All required fields must be completed: nature of concern (text), duration (enum), previous treatments (text) and symptom severity (integer 1-10 slider). Lifestyle factors and additional notes are optional. Text fields have character limits.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 3 data fields and rules (519-545); Workflow 1 details step.

nodes.title: Visual evidence limited to 5 files with size and format rules

attrs.statement: Visual evidence limited to 5 files total. Photos: JPG/PNG <= 2MB each. Videos: MP4 <= 30s, <= 20MB each. File size and format validation enforced; invalid media is blocked with actionable guidance.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 3 rules (537-542), Validation and Constraints 1 (1163-1165), Workflow 1 upload step, Edge Cases (1419). The Screen 3 field table and Screen 10 list up to 5 photos and up to 5 videos; see the report question on per-type or combined limit.

nodes.title: Head scan photo set required and must meet FR-002 thresholds

attrs.statement: Head scan photo set must meet minimum completeness/quality thresholds required by FR-002. Head scan media quality validation applies.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 4 data fields and rules (554-572); Validation and Constraints 2.

nodes.title: Patient can retake a poor-quality head scan capture

attrs.statement: Patient can retake capture if quality poor; the system prompts retake with guidance when the scan quality is not valid.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 4 rules (571); Workflow 1 scan step.

nodes.title: Head scan media encrypted, access-controlled, shown through engine outputs

attrs.statement: Captured media encrypted and stored securely. Head scan media stored securely with access controls. Media accessible to providers for assessment via engine outputs.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 4 rules (572-574); Data Security 3.

nodes.title: V1 head scan is a photo set; true 3D is V2

attrs.statement: In V1, "3D head scan" capture is implemented as a standardized head scan photo set (multiple 2D views). True 3D capture is deferred to V2. Head scan requires viewer (photo set gallery in V1; interactive 3D in V2).
attrs.rationale: PRD Executive Summary (16-17), Screen 4 purpose and notes (547-570), Screen 10 head scan notes and rules (920).

nodes.title: Head scan media retained 2 years after inquiry completion

attrs.statement: Head scan media retained for 2 years after inquiry completion (photo sets in V1; 3D scans in V2).
attrs.rationale: PRD Data and Privacy Rules, Data Retention (1093-1095).

attrs.statement: Maximum 10 date ranges selectable.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 5 rules (591), Workflow 1 dates step.

attrs.statement: Date ranges cannot overlap. Overlapping date ranges are rejected server-side with correction prompts.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 5 rules, Validation and Constraints 2 (1169), Edge Cases (1420).

nodes.title: Date ranges at most 2 years in the future

attrs.statement: Dates limited to 2 years in future.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 5 rules, Validation and Constraints 1.

attrs.statement: System validates date availability and provider availability.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 1 dates step (97); Screen 5 notes and rules (593-602).

nodes.title: Every medical question needs Yes/No; Yes needs details

attrs.statement: All questions require Yes/No answers. Detailed explanations required for "Yes" answers. The patient must complete the medical questionnaire before submission; missing details for "Yes" answers block submission until completed.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 6 rules (643-644), Medical Data Rules 2, Submission Rules 1 (1023), Edge Cases (1421).

nodes.title: Questionnaire managed by admin through FR-025 and versioned

attrs.statement: Medical questionnaire managed by admin (not hard-coded) via FR-025 (Medical Questionnaire Management). Questionnaire content versioned and auditable.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 6 rules (646), Medical Data Rules 2 (1086-1090).

nodes.title: MVP questionnaires are Yes/No only; typed answers need V2 work

attrs.statement: MVP: Inquiry questionnaires support Yes/No questions only (enforced in FR-025 publishing/activation rules). Future (V2+): if Inquiry questionnaires allow non-Yes/No question types, the inquiry response schema and UI must be extended to support typed answers (e.g., numeric scale, multi-select, free text).
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 6 rules (647-648); Key Entities MedicalQuestionnaireResponse note.

attrs.statement: 3-tier color-coded alert system: Critical alerts (red - high risk conditions), Standard alerts (yellow/amber - moderate concerns), No alerts (green - no medical concerns). Alerts generated automatically from questionnaire.
attrs.rationale: PRD Medical Data Rules 1, Screen 6 rules (645), Workflow 1 medical step.

nodes.title: Medical alerts prominently shown as colour-coded chips

attrs.statement: Alerts prominently displayed to providers. Critical alerts: red color-coded chips. Standard alerts: yellow/amber color-coded chips. No alerts: green color-coded chips.
attrs.rationale: PRD Medical Data Rules 1, Screen 9 rules (846), Screen 10 rules (917), UI/UX Display Rules 4.

nodes.title: Critical alerts inform providers; they never reject the patient

attrs.statement: Inquiry flagged with critical alerts for provider awareness (not patient rejection). Admin can review and provide guidance to providers. Medical alerts are for provider awareness, not patient rejection.
attrs.rationale: PRD Alternative Flow A3 (140-156); Business Process Assumptions (1330).

nodes.title: Patient selects at least 1 and at most 5 providers

attrs.statement: Maximum 5 providers selectable. Patient must select at least 1 provider to proceed.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 7a data fields and rules (689-713); Distribution Rules 2.

nodes.title: Provider suggestions ranked by reviews and admin curation, in selected countries

attrs.statement: Provider suggestions based on positive reviews and admin curation (system PRD). Only providers in patient's selected destination countries are shown. Patient can search/filter providers by country, rating, and specialty.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 7a notes and rules (693-709); Workflow 1 provider step; Distribution Rules 2.

nodes.title: Selected providers included; others may also receive the inquiry

attrs.statement: Selected providers are included in the inquiry for distribution; system may also distribute to additional matching providers per distribution rules.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 7a rules (710).

nodes.title: Patient reviews all sections and accepts terms before submit

attrs.statement: Patient must review all sections. Patient can edit any section before submission. Terms and conditions must be accepted.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 7 rules (672-675); Workflow 1 review step.

nodes.title: Submission generates a unique inquiry ID in HPID format

attrs.statement: Submission generates unique inquiry ID (HPID format: HPID + YY + MM + 4-digit sequence). Inquiry uniqueness validation applies.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 7 rules (676), Workflow 1 review step and Workflow 2 identify step, UI/UX Display Rules 3 (1151-1153), Validation and Constraints 2.

nodes.title: A patient has only one active inquiry at a time

attrs.statement: Patient can only have one active inquiry at a time. Cancelled inquiries are not counted as "active".
attrs.rationale: PRD Submission Rules 1, Screen 8 rules (775, 782).

nodes.title: Inquiry editable by the patient only in Inquiry stage

attrs.statement: Patient can modify inquiry if still in "Inquiry" stage; otherwise a blocked message (stage changed) is shown.
attrs.rationale: PRD Submission Rules 1, Alternative Flow A2, Screen 8 rules.

nodes.title: Returning patient offered to continue an incomplete inquiry

attrs.statement: System shows "continue with your request" option; patient can resume from last completed step; system displays inquiry status as "incomplete" or "pending". On return within 7 days the system restores the last step and data and previously validated sections remain intact.
attrs.rationale: PRD Alternative Flows A1, A2; User Story 2.

nodes.title: Failed submission shows an error and allows retry

attrs.statement: Show submission error and allow retry when submission does not succeed.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 1 flow diagram, submission step.

nodes.title: Only complete and valid inquiries are distributed

attrs.statement: System detects a submitted inquiry meeting completeness requirements; an incomplete or invalid inquiry is not distributed and errors are returned or the inquiry is flagged for fix. Every inquiry record MUST include destinations, treatment date ranges, problem details and questionnaireSummary (including derived medical alerts), media attachments (photos/videos and head scan photo set / scanRef from FR-002), a linked patient identifier (HPID-based patientId) and distribution metadata via related ProviderInquiry records, fully populated before an inquiry is eligible for distribution to providers.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 2 trigger and flow diagram (186-215); Key Entities Inquiry Payload composition (1270-1279).

nodes.title: At most 10 providers per inquiry; explicit selections always included

attrs.statement: When matched providers exceed 10, select up to 10 providers (ensure explicitly selected providers included; remaining per matching rules).
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 2 flow diagram (199-202).

nodes.title: Provider-specific anonymized views created and timestamps recorded

attrs.statement: Create provider-specific inquiry views (anonymized); distribute inquiry to providers and record timestamps.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 2 flow diagram (204-213).

nodes.title: Provider notifications within 5 minutes with retry and SLA alert

attrs.statement: Send provider notifications (within 5 minutes). If notification dispatch fails: queue/retry, alert on SLA risk and log attempts.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 2 flow diagram (213-217); Alternative Flow B3 outcome.

nodes.title: No matched provider: admin assigns manually and patient may be told of delay

attrs.statement: If no providers are found in the patient's selected countries, the system notifies admin of the unmatched inquiry for manual assignment; patient is optionally notified of potential delay. Admin can manually assign inquiries.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 2 flow diagram (206-208), Alternative Flow B1, Distribution Rules 2; B4 step 3 (if redistribution finds no eligible provider, B1 applies).

nodes.title: Provider capacity checks are advisory and do not block distribution

attrs.statement: Provider capacity limits affect distribution where capacity data is available; until the dedicated Provider Capacity Management FR is delivered, capacity checks are advisory and MUST NOT block inquiry distribution.
attrs.rationale: PRD Alternative Flow B2, Distribution Rules 2.

attrs.statement: Providers must respond within 72 hours (configurable).
attrs.rationale: PRD Distribution Rules 2 (1031); the change log records alignment with the system PRD.

nodes.title: Unquoted inquiry expires after a configurable timeframe

attrs.statement: Inquiry automatically expires if unquoted (configurable timeframe). Inquiry expiration is configurable by admin.
attrs.rationale: PRD Submission Rules 1 (1024), Screen 9 rules (848).

nodes.title: FR-037 conversion with an assigned provider routes only to that provider

attrs.statement: When the inquiry is created via FR-037 (Monitor Your Hair Loss) conversion and the source monitoring case has an active provider assignment at the time of conversion (REQ-037-029, Business Rule 7), normal country/selection matching and the 10-provider distribution cap are bypassed and the inquiry is distributed exclusively to the assigned provider. Standard anonymization, notification timing, and dashboard behavior are unchanged.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 2 flow diagram (192-195) and Alternative Flow B3 (247-269); Distribution Rules 2.

nodes.title: Decline action only for the exclusive provider, with confirmation and reason

attrs.statement: Decline Exclusive Inquiry declines an FR-037 monitoring-conversion inquiry before quote creation; exclusive assigned provider only; confirmation and reason required.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 3 flow diagram (297-303), Screen 10 data fields (868).

nodes.title: Duplicate decline requests release the inquiry only once

attrs.statement: Repeated decline requests MUST NOT distribute the inquiry more than once. Duplicate decline requests return the committed result without creating duplicate provider views or notifications.
attrs.rationale: PRD Alternative Flow C2 (329), Edge Cases (1427).

nodes.title: Decline fallback is triggered only by an explicit decline, not by expiry

attrs.statement: This automatic fallback is triggered by an explicit provider decline only. Inquiry or quote expiry continues to follow its existing configured rules. Expiry does not use this decline fallback.
attrs.rationale: PRD Alternative Flow C2 expiry boundary (330), Distribution Rules 2, Edge Cases (1428).

nodes.title: Redistribution after provider status removes the exclusive restriction

attrs.statement: For an FR-037 exclusive inquiry, redistribution removes the exclusive restriction in the same way as the explicit-decline fallback (REQ-003-016). The supportRequired marker stays on the inquiry.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 2 Alternative Flow B4 step 3 (279).

nodes.title: Provider asks admin for clarification; inquiry stays in Inquiry stage

attrs.statement: Provider requests clarification via admin; admin facilitates communication; inquiry remains in "Inquiry" stage until resolved.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 3 flow diagram, Alternative Flow C1.

attrs.statement: Provider access limited to assigned inquiries. Only shows inquiries for provider's countries OR explicitly selected by patient.
attrs.rationale: PRD Data Access Rules 3, Screen 9 rules (844), Data and Privacy 2.

nodes.title: Masked patient name format and visible fields

attrs.statement: Patient name masking format: first name + last initial + asterisks (e.g., "John D*****"). Full name revealed only after payment confirmation. Patient ID (HPID-based) visible; name, phone number, and email remain masked/hidden until payment confirmation. Age, gender and country are shown.
attrs.rationale: PRD UI/UX Display Rules 5, Screen 10 notes (891-893).

attrs.statement: Patient ID format: HPID + YY + MM + 4-digit sequence. Example: HPID2501001 (HPID + 25 + 01 + 0001).
attrs.rationale: PRD UI/UX Display Rules 3, Screens 9, 10 and 11 Patient ID columns.

nodes.title: Primary date range shown with tooltip for the others

attrs.statement: Primary date range displayed prominently. Additional ranges shown as "[+ X other ranges]" with tooltip expansion. Tooltip shows all date ranges with full details.
attrs.rationale: PRD UI/UX Display Rules 1, Screen 9 rules.

nodes.title: Relative, yesterday and dated time display

attrs.statement: Recent inquiries: relative format ("X minutes ago", "X hours ago"). Previous day: specific format ("Yesterday at 3:45 PM"). Older inquiries: date format ("Sep 22, 2025").
attrs.rationale: PRD UI/UX Display Rules 2, Screen 9 rules.

nodes.title: Inquiry detail timeline lists creation, distribution, views and status changes

attrs.statement: Timeline: creation, distribution to providers, provider views, status changes; sorted descending by time with relative and absolute timestamps.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 10 notes (908-909).

nodes.title: Admin can edit every category of inquiry data

attrs.statement: Admin can edit ALL inquiry data in the system: inquiry data (all patient-submitted information), patient data (patient information, contact details), provider data (provider assignments and settings), system data (expiration rules, capacity limits) and medical data (questionnaire responses and alerts). Admin can override any system-calculated settings.
attrs.rationale: PRD Admin Editability Rules 1 and 2, Screen 10 rules (919), Screen 12 rules (1006).

nodes.title: Every admin change needs a reason

attrs.statement: Change reason required for all modifications. Block save and require a reason when none is provided.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 4 flow diagram, Admin Editability Rules 3, Screen 12 rules.

nodes.title: Admin edits logged with who, when, what, reason

attrs.statement: All admin edits logged with timestamp and admin identification. Edit history maintained for audit trail. Audit trail records who, when, what changed (old -> new), reason, IP (if available); filterable by field, user, date range; exportable (CSV/JSON) for compliance; immutable and timestamped. Complete audit trail maintained.
attrs.rationale: PRD Admin Editability Rules 3, Screen 12 notes (1004-1011) and rules.

nodes.title: Patient and provider notified of significant admin changes

attrs.statement: Patient and provider notified of significant changes. Trigger re-notifications when impactful fields change; admin may re-notify parties if impactful.
attrs.rationale: PRD Admin Editability Rules 3, Workflow 4 flow diagram, Screen 12 notes (1000).

nodes.title: Visual warnings shown for data modification

attrs.statement: Visual warnings displayed for data modification. Edit inquiry details with caution banners and field-level audit.
attrs.rationale: PRD Admin Editability Rules 3, Screen 12 notes and rules.

nodes.title: Admin reassignment offers only eligible providers

attrs.statement: Select provider(s) from eligible providers only (Active, Owner password set). Ineligible providers (status not Active, or Owner password not set) are hidden from the admin provider picker. If a selected provider becomes ineligible before the admin saves, the save is blocked with "[Provider] can't receive inquiries right now (not active or activation not completed)." The same check applies to providers included through the distribution override.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 4 flow diagram (349-352), Screen 12 notes (1005).

nodes.title: Admin reassignment avoids duplicates and may send a note

attrs.statement: Reassign providers (single/multi) with eligibility checks: search providers by country/specialty; multi-select. Validation: avoid duplicates; respect provider capacity policies (if enabled). Optional note sent to provider(s) upon assignment.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 12 notes (1002-1006).

nodes.title: Admin expiry and distribution overrides need confirmation and reason

attrs.statement: Override expiry/distribution windows with required reason. Expiry: set new deadline (cannot be in the past without justification). Distribution: re-run matching; include/exclude specific providers. All overrides require confirmation and reason entry.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 4 flow diagram (355-358), Screen 12 notes (1001-1004).

nodes.title: Admin soft delete only, with reason and Archived badge

attrs.statement: Soft delete only (no hard deletes). Archive requires reason and confirmation; retains data for audit; prevents further edits; read-only view after deletion; display badge "Archived" across all admin views; notify patient if required.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 4 flow diagram (360-363), Screen 12 notes (1007-1009) and rules (1013), Data Security 3 (soft deletes only, no hard deletes allowed).

nodes.title: Admin can escalate an urgent case

attrs.statement: Escalate urgent case: mark urgent and assign owner; escalation is logged.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 4 flow diagram (365-367).

nodes.title: Admin contacts patient or provider and the intervention is logged

attrs.statement: Admin contacts patient or provider, resolves the issue and updates the inquiry if needed; the system logs the intervention in the audit trail. Admin notes are time-stamped and visible to admins only.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 4 flow diagram (369-372), Screen 12 notes (999).

nodes.title: Admin overview shows all inquiries with filters and bulk actions

attrs.statement: Shows all inquiries in all lifecycle stages. Admin has full visibility of all data. Advanced filtering capabilities. Bulk actions available. Real-time status updates.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 11 business rules (958-962).

nodes.title: All inquiry data access is logged and monitored

attrs.statement: All data access logged for audit trail. Admin access logged for audit trail. Access attempts logged and monitored.
attrs.rationale: PRD Data Access Rules 3, Data and Privacy 2 and 3.

nodes.title: Cross-tenant data access only through authenticated APIs

attrs.statement: Cross-tenant data access through authenticated APIs only.
attrs.rationale: PRD Data and Privacy Rules, Data Access (1102).

attrs.statement: Medical questionnaire responses retained for 7 years.
attrs.rationale: PRD Data and Privacy Rules, Data Retention (1094).

nodes.title: Cancelled inquiries follow the same retention

attrs.statement: Cancelled inquiries are subject to the same retention policy as completed inquiries; cancellation does not accelerate data deletion timelines.
attrs.rationale: PRD Data and Privacy Rules, Data Retention (1096).

nodes.title: Admin sees patient cancellations but cannot block or reverse them

attrs.statement: Admin has oversight visibility of patient-initiated cancellations but cannot block or reverse them.
attrs.rationale: PRD Cancellation Rules 4 (1066).

nodes.title: Cancellation preflight changes no state and a failure does not cancel

attrs.statement: Preflight (no state change): confirm inquiry still active; load quotes and notification targets. If preflight fails, show a temporary error with Retry/Back and do NOT cancel yet.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 5 flow diagram (390-395).

nodes.title: Cancellation commits atomically with an audit event

attrs.statement: Atomic commit: set inquiry = Cancelled with timestamp and reason; cancel draft, sent, and expired quotes (if any); write immutable audit event. With no quotes, only the inquiry status is updated and no quote cascade is needed.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 5 flow diagram (397-399), Alternative Flow E1 (421-432).

attrs.statement: Cancellation event is logged in immutable audit trail with: patient ID, inquiry ID, timestamp, reason, optional feedback.
attrs.rationale: PRD Cancellation Rules 4 (1068).

nodes.title: Providers notified of cancellation within 5 minutes without the reason

attrs.statement: All affected providers receive notification of cancellation; cancellation reason is NOT shared with providers (patient-private analytics data). Send/enqueue notifications (target <= 5 minutes); if enqueue/send fails, queue/retry notifications and log attempts (do not roll back cancellation). Inquiry.cancelled is sent to distributed providers.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 5 flow diagram (401-405), Alternative Flow E1, Alternative Flow E3 notes, Cancellation Rules 4, Screen 8a rules.

attrs.statement: Cancellation reason is patient-private data (not shared with providers; stored for analytics and audit).
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 8a rules (774).

nodes.title: Cancellation reason chosen from admin-configurable options

attrs.statement: Cancellation reason is required before the Confirm button becomes active. Default options: "Changed my mind", "Found a better option elsewhere", "Medical concerns", "Financial reasons", "Travel restrictions", "Timeline doesn't work", "Other" (admin-configurable via FR-026 Screen 5a). Additional notes are required if "Other" is selected (max 500 characters). Optional feedback: max 1000 characters.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 8a data fields and rules (755-777).

nodes.title: Account-deletion request cancels the inquiry with a system reason

attrs.statement: System MAY cancel an eligible inquiry as a consequence of a patient account deletion request (FR-001). In that case, the system MUST set a system-generated cancellation reason for audit (e.g., "Account Deleted (System)") and MUST NOT prompt the patient for a cancellation reason. Draft, sent, and expired quotes are auto-cancelled as in Workflow 5, other quotes keep their status and cause; providers are notified and MUST NOT see the cancellation reason; inquiry becomes read-only.
attrs.rationale: PRD Alternative Flow E3 (437-450), Cancellation Rules 4 (1064).

nodes.title: Cancelled inquiry stays visible and read-only

attrs.statement: Cancelled inquiry remains visible in patient dashboard with "Cancelled" badge (read-only); no actions available except viewing details.
attrs.rationale: PRD Cancellation Rules 4 (1065), Screen 8 notes (742).

attrs.statement: No cooldown period after cancellation: patient can immediately create a new inquiry (one-active-inquiry rule: cancelled inquiry is no longer "active").
attrs.rationale: PRD Cancellation Rules 4 (1067), Screen 8b rules (813-814), Alternative Flow A4 (172-176).

nodes.title: Cancel Inquiry and Contact support shown by stage

attrs.statement: "Cancel Inquiry" is visible only in Inquiry or Quoted stages and hidden when stage is Accepted, Confirmed, In Progress, Aftercare, Completed, or Cancelled. "Contact support" is shown in place of "Cancel Inquiry" from the Accepted stage onward (Accepted, Confirmed, In Progress or Aftercare) and opens Help & Support so an admin can act on the request.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 8 data fields and notes (731-740), Workflow 5 trigger (382).

nodes.title: Inquiry status is the source of truth when cancel and quote submit collide

attrs.statement: If a quote is submitted concurrently with cancellation, the system processes cancellation first (inquiry status is source of truth); the incoming quote submission is rejected with an "Inquiry no longer active" error. FR-004 must implement the corresponding rejection handling.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 5 flow diagram (399-400), Edge Cases (1425).

nodes.title: Provider draft locked with Inquiry Cancelled banner

attrs.statement: If the patient cancels while a provider is drafting a quote, the provider's draft is locked with an "Inquiry Cancelled" banner upon next save/refresh.
attrs.rationale: PRD Edge Cases (1424).

nodes.title: Cancellation success screen reflects server time and real cascade

attrs.statement: Cancellation Timestamp reflects server-side time (not client clock) for audit consistency. Impact Summary must match the actual cascade results (number of quotes cancelled). The success screen is shown only after Workflow 5 completes successfully.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 8b rules (809-815).

nodes.title: Admin cancels from acceptance onward with reason and audit

attrs.statement: From acceptance onward, only an admin can cancel, through the FR-006 booking cancellation, from any booking state, with a mandatory reason and an audit entry. The booking and the inquiry become Cancelled, any active appointment hold is released, and the accepted quote keeps the status accepted. Refunds and fees follow the payment placeholder.
attrs.rationale: PRD Cancellation Rules 4 (1062), Alternative Flow E2 (434-449), User Story 4 scenario 3.

nodes.title: supportRequired is an independent marker cleared only by audited admin resolution

attrs.statement: supportRequired is an independent marker, not a lifecycle stage. Clearing it requires an audited admin resolution. Later reactivation does not clear supportRequired; only an audited admin resolution clears it.
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules 6 (1060), Workflow 2 Alternative Flow B4 step 5 (284), Key Entities Inquiry.

nodes.title: Provider-caused causes are distinct and never overwritten

attrs.statement: Provider-caused causes are distinct from patient cancellation, account-deletion cancellation, and Payment Window Expired, and are never overwritten by later provider status changes. The causes ProviderSuspended and ProviderDeactivated are stored on the affected ProviderInquiry and on the FR-006 booking.
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules 6 (1061), Workflow 2 Alternative Flow B4 Boundary (286), Key Entities (1258).

nodes.title: Completed and cancelled inquiries are not reclassified; reactivation restores nothing

attrs.statement: Completed and already-cancelled inquiries are not reclassified. Later reactivation does not restore cancelled participation or quotes. A cancelled ProviderInquiry record is retained and never reopened by reactivation.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 2 Alternative Flow B4 step 5 (284), Key Entities ProviderInquiry status (1262).

nodes.title: Provider becomes eligible once its password is set; earlier inquiries not re-sent

attrs.statement: An Active provider that has not yet set its password (FR-015 password_set = false) becomes eligible once the password is set; inquiries distributed before then are not re-sent to it.
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules 6 (1057).

nodes.title: Cascade processing deduplicated per provider-status event and inquiry

attrs.statement: Cascade processing is deduplicated per provider-status event and inquiry. A replayed provider-status cascade produces no duplicate cancellations, support flags, or patient messages.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 2 Alternative Flow B4 Boundary (286), Edge Cases (1431).

nodes.title: Patient told other offers stay open, or asked to confirm redistribution

attrs.statement: Before acceptance, the patient receives the offer-unavailability message (provider.status_cancellation_patient) with a Contact Admin/Support action (FR-020). When other offers remain open, the message says "[Clinic] is no longer available. Your other offers are still open." When the patient must confirm first, the message asks the patient to confirm the redistribution. In neither case does the patient see the Workflow 5 patient-cancellation confirmation, and no patient cancellation reason is requested.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 2 Alternative Flow B4 step 4 (281).

nodes.title: Dashboard shows provider-unavailable banner and keeps other offers actionable

attrs.statement: A provider-caused status change (ProviderSuspended or ProviderDeactivated) never shows patient-cancellation copy. For a still-comparing inquiry (Inquiry or Quoted stage), the dashboard shows a provider-unavailable banner with a Contact Admin/Support action, the affected provider's offers show as unavailable while other offers remain actionable, and when the patient had explicitly selected the affected provider the dashboard first asks the patient to confirm the redistribution. After acceptance, the dashboard keeps the current stage and tells the patient that an admin will arrange a replacement provider within the same inquiry.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 8 notes (743).

nodes.title: Distribution timestamp set once per provider and feeds response metrics

attrs.statement: distributed_at (timestamp, UTC) is set once per provider when the inquiry is distributed to that provider, including when an inquiry is released to normal distribution after an exclusive provider declines (REQ-003-016). Distribution retries or re-sends to the same provider never overwrite it. It is the start point for FR-014 time to first quote (TTFQ) and response rate, and for the FR-020/FR-030 inquiry.ttfq_sla_breached alert.
attrs.rationale: PRD Key Entities ProviderInquiry (1260).

nodes.title: Provider inquiry detail shows full inquiry content and scan metadata

attrs.statement: Provider inquiry detail shows: countries (primary country highlighted; remaining in order selected), problem details, media (photos with thumbnails and modal preview, videos with poster frame and player), head scan (V1 photo set gallery viewer with zoom/compare, quality score and capture metadata if available, retake indicator if replaced after initial capture), all selected date ranges (primary first), the full Q&A list with derived alerts and a link to the audit trail of the questionnaire version used.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 10 notes (884-916).

nodes.title: Shared treatment version and one to five package options

attrs.statement: Providers MUST create, edit, and submit parent quotes with one shared immutable Treatment-version relationship and one to five package-based Quote Options. Technique details MUST be loaded read-only through that relationship and MUST NOT be duplicated as provider-entered Quote data.

nodes.title: Admin-controlled expiry window captured at first send

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce the admin-controlled FR-026 expiry window (default 48h), captured at first send, and compute the deadline per sent quote.

nodes.title: Competing quotes cancelled on subquote acceptance

attrs.statement: System MUST cancel every other parent quote for the same inquiry as `cancelled_other_accepted` upon one subquote acceptance. Each sent parent quote MUST produce one not-selected notice per parent quote; unsent drafts MUST be cancelled silently without notice.

nodes.title: Provider withdrawal after acceptance hands over to FR-006

attrs.statement: System MUST support provider withdrawal after acceptance by moving the parent quote to `withdrawn`, keeping the AcceptanceEvent and snapshot unchanged, and handing the case to the FR-006 provider-fault transfer, with full audit and the mandatory `quote.withdrawn` notice.

nodes.title: Admin inline edit of draft and sent quotes

attrs.statement: Admin MUST be able to inline edit policy-bound fields of `draft` and `sent` quotes with required reason and re-notifications; admin edits MUST be blocked once a subquote is accepted.

nodes.title: Quote references inquiry and patient and appends only

attrs.statement: Quotes MUST reference original inquiry and patient; quote data appends, never overwrites inquiry data.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules restate it: quotes MUST reference the distributed inquiry ID and be linked to the original patient object; no reduction or overwriting of inquiry-supplied fields; downstream stages inherit upstream data.

nodes.title: Edits and transitions versioned and auditable

attrs.statement: All quote edits and state transitions MUST be versioned and auditable.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules and Workflow 3 restate it: all state transitions (draft to sent to expired, etc.) MUST be fully auditable, are logged, and result in notifications as appropriate.

attrs.statement: Patient identifiers MUST remain anonymized to providers until payment confirmation.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules: patient information remains censored at this stage until payment confirmation; only anonymized identifiers and allowed fields are visible to providers. Screen 3 hides contact until payment.

attrs.statement: All quote data MUST be encrypted at rest and in transit; soft deletes only.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules: quotes CANNOT be hard deleted (only archived/soft deleted).

attrs.statement: Module MUST integrate with FR-003 for inquiry context and FR-020 for notifications.

nodes.title: Admin settings applied from FR-026 quote configuration

attrs.statement: Admin settings (quote expiry window, quote-expiring-soon lead time, and quote currency) MUST be applied from the FR-026 quote configuration.

nodes.title: Money on withdrawal follows FR-006 placeholder

attrs.statement: Money handling for provider withdrawal after acceptance follows the FR-006 provider-fault placeholder; exact refund and payment-allocation mechanics are owned by FR-007, FR-007B, and FR-017.

System MUST auto-cancel only the draft, sent, and expired quotes for an inquiry when that inquiry is cancelled by the patient (FR-003 Workflow 5), with distinct status "Cancelled (Inquiry Cancelled)"; quotes in any other status MUST keep their status and cause; `quote.cancelled_inquiry` (FR-020) MUST go only to providers whose quotes were cancelled by this cascade.
attrs.rationale: The cascade is system-initiated, not a provider or patient action on the quote itself.

nodes.title: Multiple parent quotes per provider per inquiry

attrs.statement: System MUST allow the same provider to create multiple parent quotes for one active inquiry; every quote retains an independent lifecycle, expiry, version history, and audit history.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules: each inquiry may have multiple parent quotes from multiple providers or from the same provider; package alternatives within a parent quote are Quote Options, not independent quote responses.

nodes.title: One to five ordered Quote Options

attrs.statement: Each quote MUST contain between one and five ordered Quote Options, and submission MUST be blocked outside that range.

nodes.title: Option keeps source package and quote-owned snapshot

attrs.statement: Each Quote Option MUST retain the selected provider package ID/version and a stable, versioned quote-owned snapshot of its inclusions and standard values.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules: selecting a package MUST create a quote-owned snapshot.

nodes.title: Inline customization never touches the package library

attrs.statement: Providers MUST be able to customize every selected package inline for the current quote without updating or creating reusable package-library records.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules: inline option customization MUST NOT update or create reusable package-library records.

nodes.title: Applicable date ranges and complete option/date pricing

attrs.statement: Each Quote Option MUST define at least one applicable patient-requested date range and a price, appointment date/time, timezone, and optional structured promotion for every applicable option/date combination. Pairings the provider cannot offer MAY be left out.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules: providers must select option applicability from patient-requested date ranges; a parent quote yields up to (options x date ranges) subquotes; unavailable combinations are omitted rather than priced; each priced pairing becomes one subquote for FR-005.

nodes.title: Separate relative day plan per option

attrs.statement: Each Quote Option MUST own a separate ordered day-to-day treatment plan using consecutive relative day numbers.

nodes.title: Shared clinical facts stay on the parent quote

attrs.statement: Estimated grafts, graft description, visual treatment plan, clinicians, common notes, and common requirements MUST remain shared parent-quote fields.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules: these MUST NOT be duplicated as option-specific facts.

attrs.statement: Quote version and audit records MUST capture the complete parent-and-options aggregate atomically, including option additions/removals, package snapshots, inclusion changes, date-price changes, and option plan changes.

nodes.title: Stable identifiers and aggregate subquote version

attrs.statement: FR-004 MUST expose stable identifiers for the parent quote, Quote Option, and option/date price so FR-005 can record exactly one accepted option/date combination. FR-004 versions the complete parent quote aggregate atomically; therefore, the FR-005 `subquoteVersion` MUST equal the owning parent quote's current `QuoteVersion`. Quote Options and option/date-price records do not have independent revision counters.

Provider Quote Creation/Edit MUST use the ordered seven-tab flow defined in Screen 1, including Sub-screen 2A for quote-local package editing and one combined Dates & Pricing tab driven by the selected package options.

Every Quote, Quote Option, option item, option/date price, and option plan-day field MUST follow the Screen 1 Quote Data Ownership Matrix, with exactly one provider-editing surface or an explicit read-only/system-derived owner.

nodes.title: Quote currency from configuration, captured at first send

attrs.statement: Quote currency MUST come from the active FR-026 quote configuration (the FR-029 Default Currency), MUST NOT be provider input, and MUST be captured on the quote at first send so historical prices retain their original currency.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules: drafts carry no captured currency; packages carry no currency of their own; currency is displayed read-only.

attrs.statement: Providers MUST be able to attach quote-level supporting files that apply to every option; file security, access, audit, and retention rules MUST be enforced.
A quote MUST support one or more eligible clinician assignments shared across every option.
Graft description MUST be generated from the approved system template and estimated graft count, displayed read-only, and versioned with the quote.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules: providers MAY enter and revise Estimated Grafts; the system regenerates Graft Description whenever Estimated Grafts changes; providers MUST NOT directly edit it.

nodes.title: System-owned values visible only where authorized

attrs.statement: System-owned identifiers, lifecycle status, price summaries, commission, timestamps, customization state, and version/audit metadata MUST be visible only where authorized and MUST NOT be provider-editable.

nodes.title: Analytics count parent responses, amounts from accepted price

attrs.statement: Quote-amount analytics MUST be computed from the accepted option/date price only. Unaccepted quotes MUST be excluded from amount metrics and counted once as a parent response in volume and conversion metrics; Quote Options MUST NOT be counted as responses.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules: analytics MUST distinguish parent quote responses from Quote Options so option counts do not inflate quote-response or conversion metrics.

nodes.title: Provider status revalidated at creation and submission

attrs.statement: System MUST revalidate provider status at quote creation and submission and MUST reject quote submission by a `Suspended` or `Deactivated` provider from the effective time, including in-flight requests.
attrs.rationale: Edge Cases: a submission at or after the effective time is rejected; no sent quote, patient notification, or version is created.

attrs.statement: When a provider becomes `Suspended` or `Deactivated`, System MUST cancel that provider's unaccepted parent quotes with status `cancelled_provider_status` and `cancellationProvenance` `ProviderSuspended` or `ProviderDeactivated`, once per parent quote rather than per option or option/date alternative, without rewriting the AcceptanceEvent, accepted IDs/versions, or quote-local package snapshots, and without reclassifying terminal or completed history. An accepted parent quote MUST NOT receive `cancelled_provider_status`; it keeps `accepted` and is handled by the FR-006 provider-fault transfer. Processing MUST be deduplicated per provider-status event and quote.

nodes.title: One package seeds one option with prefills

attrs.statement: Each selected package MUST seed exactly one alternative Quote Option (maximum five per parent quote), never summed with another package. The package standard price MUST prefill each applicable option/date-price row, and the package's relative day plan MUST prefill the option plan.

nodes.title: Two package edit paths and option provenance

attrs.statement: Editing a package in the FR-024 package management screen MUST change only the library (as a new package version), and editing inside quote creation MUST change only a quote-local copy that is never written back. Each Quote Option MUST record its source package ID, source package version, and an inline-customised flag.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules, Package library edits and quote inline edits: the quote-local edit path covers Sub-screen 2A, Tab 5 and Tab 4 prices and never creates a package version; the first inline change sets the option's inline-customised flag.

nodes.title: Promotion terms copied at send; one automatic promotion

attrs.statement: System MUST store the offered price as entered and any promotion discount separately, MUST copy the terms of every attached promotion into the sent quote version at send, and MUST attach at most one automatic FR-019 promotion per quote to each eligible option/date-price row at send, chosen by the FR-019 priority order when several qualify. Later FR-019 promotion edits MUST NOT change a sent quote.

nodes.title: Expiry and currency captured at first send

attrs.statement: System MUST capture the quote expiry and quote currency read-only at first send from the FR-026 quote configuration. Drafts MUST carry neither, and there MUST be no per-quote expiry extension.

nodes.title: No quote edits or new quotes after acceptance

attrs.statement: After a subquote is accepted, System MUST block every FR-004 quote edit by providers and admins. Treatment-detail changes (plan, clinicians, grafts) MUST go through FR-010. An accepted parent quote MUST never be reopened, expired, or restored to an acceptable state, including after `Payment Window Expired`, and no new parent quote MAY be created or sent for an inquiry with an accepted subquote, except the admin-authored replacement quote of REQ-004-048.

nodes.title: Appointment fields are the FR-006 slot-hold key

attrs.statement: The Quote Option appointment date/time and time zone, together with the provider, MUST be the key FR-006 uses for the slot hold placed at acceptance; FR-004 MUST NOT create an appointment record.
System MUST emit `quote.expiring_soon` once per sent parent quote when it reaches the FR-026 quote-expiring-soon lead time, and MUST NOT emit it for draft, accepted, or terminal quotes.
Every option/date price MUST be greater than 0 before send, and a zero price MUST block send. A date range the clinic cannot serve MUST be left out of that option rather than priced.
attrs.rationale: A zero price is blocked with an inline error on that row.

nodes.title: Default Currency change on a draft

attrs.statement: If the FR-029 Default Currency changes while a draft holds prices, System MUST switch the draft to the new currency, keep every typed number unchanged, and show a "currency changed, check your prices" banner that the provider MUST acknowledge before send.

A sent quote carrying an automatic FR-019 promotion MUST hold exactly one reserved use of that promotion's usage limit. A re-send of a new version MUST keep the existing reservation, create one only if the new version newly qualifies, and release it if the new version no longer carries the promotion. The reservation MUST be released when the quote expires, is withdrawn, or ends not selected or cancelled, MUST be released with reason `not_applied` when the accepted row does not carry the promotion, and MUST be consumed at acceptance when the accepted row carries it, so the usage limit is never exceeded. If the booking later ends in `Payment Window Expired` or is cancelled before the first payment, FR-005 and FR-019 own the return of the consumed use to the limit.
System MUST set the parent quote's `firstSentAt` on its first send, and a re-send or new version MUST NOT change it.

nodes.title: Treatment Base Price is a reference-only prefill

attrs.statement: The FR-024 treatment Base Price MAY prefill a new option/date-price row only where no other standard value exists; it MUST be treated as a non-binding reference and MUST NOT be read after the quote is sent.
FR-004 MUST be the producer of `quote.updated` and MUST emit it when a new version of an already-sent quote is re-sent, described as "quote revised (new version)".

nodes.title: quote.submitted on first send and quote.expired on expiry

attrs.statement: System MUST emit `quote.submitted` on the first send of a parent quote and `quote.expired` when expiry processing moves a sent parent quote to `expired` (FR-030).

nodes.title: FR-004 is the only producer of quote.withdrawn

attrs.statement: FR-004 MUST be the only producer of `quote.withdrawn`. The notice MUST go to the patient for every withdrawal and to the admin only when the withdrawn quote was already accepted.
attrs.rationale: A withdrawal before acceptance is a normal provider action; FR-006 reacts to a post-acceptance withdrawal without emitting the event again.

attrs.statement: During an FR-006 provider-fault transfer before treatment starts, System MUST let an admin author a replacement quote for the replacement provider inside the same inquiry through Screen 8, with a mandatory reason and full audit. The quote MUST be marked admin-authored for a replacement and linked to the closed AcceptanceEvent, MUST NOT be offered for patient comparison or emit `quote.submitted`, and MUST be the target of the FR-005 admin-authored replacement acceptance.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules: it is the only exception to the block on new quotes after acceptance.

nodes.title: Admin edit of a sent quote creates a version

attrs.statement: An admin edit of a sent quote through Screen 7 MUST create a new quote version and MUST emit `quote.updated` when that version is re-sent.

System MUST NOT attach an automatic FR-019 promotion to an admin-authored replacement quote or take a promotion usage reservation for it; the admin sets the replacement price directly. A replacement quote that is not accepted MUST expire under the normal quote expiry, MUST leave the inquiry flagged `supportRequired` without cancelling it automatically, and MUST allow the admin to author another replacement quote or cancel the inquiry and booking.

nodes.title: Inquiry must be active to create or submit

attrs.statement: System MUST verify parent inquiry is not in Cancelled status before accepting quote creation or submission. If inquiry is cancelled mid-draft (race condition), system rejects submission with error "Inquiry no longer active" and locks the draft with "Inquiry Cancelled" banner. Opening quote creation for a cancelled inquiry is blocked with "Inquiry no longer active — this inquiry was cancelled by the patient." and no draft is created; a drafting provider sees the banner "This inquiry was cancelled by the patient. Your draft can no longer be submitted." on next save or refresh, and the draft is retained for reference but cannot be submitted.

nodes.title: Restricted recipient mode for FR-037 conversions

attrs.statement: If the inquiry was created via an FR-037 monitoring-case conversion with an active exclusive provider assignment (REQ-037-029, Business Rule 7; see FR-003 Workflow 2 Alternative Flow B3), only that assigned provider may create quotes for the inquiry, including any additional parent quote. Any other provider attempting to open the inquiry for quote creation is blocked with error "This inquiry is restricted to its assigned provider." The restriction does not change the other workflows (editing, expiry, withdrawal, admin oversight) on quotes that already exist. FR-038 is self-service and does not create an FR-004 inquiry or provider assignment.

nodes.title: Only assigned clinic staff submit or edit

attrs.statement: Only assigned clinic staff may submit/edit quotes for assigned inquiries.
Treatment type selection MUST use admin-curated treatment catalog; no free text.

nodes.title: Grafts, prices and slots present and valid

attrs.statement: Graft/quantity, option/date prices, and scheduled slots MUST be present and valid.

nodes.title: Package active when selected; later changes warn only

attrs.statement: Every Quote Option MUST originate from a package that is active in the authenticated provider's package library when it is selected. If the source package is later edited or deactivated, existing draft and sent options keep their snapshot; a draft may still be submitted, and Tab 7 shows a warning that the source package has changed or is inactive.

nodes.title: What a package seeds and what is entered per quote

attrs.statement: A selected package seeds services and their pricing, included travel services (transport, hotel, flight, and other travel services), the standard price, and the relative day-by-day plan; date ranges, additional notes, and documents are never packaged and are entered per quote.

nodes.title: Treatment first; every option uses it

attrs.statement: Package selection occurs after the shared treatment is selected; every option in the quote MUST use that parent treatment. Tab 2 is unavailable until an active treatment is selected.
Changing the treatment after options exist requires confirmation. The system must identify incompatible options and must not silently retain or discard dependent package, pricing, or plan data.

nodes.title: Library changes never alter existing options

attrs.statement: Package-library changes after snapshot creation MUST NOT alter existing draft or sent options unless the provider explicitly replaces the source package and confirms a new snapshot; replacing the package requires a new snapshot and audit entry.

nodes.title: Each option/date pairing once per option
