attrs.rationale: Admin approval required for all refunds

nodes.title: Accepted snapshot is the commercial base for every payment view

attrs.statement: All payment, receipt/invoice, provider/admin financial-detail, and refund views MUST use one FR-006 Booking's immutable accepted subquote snapshot as the commercial base; exclude sibling alternatives/live library prices and prevent component double-counting. The accepted promotion and discounted price are read from the snapshot and never recomputed; no promotion code can be entered, removed, or replaced at checkout or payment.
attrs.rationale: Payment amounts derive from the accepted subquote's offered price after the accepted promotion, as frozen in the acceptance snapshot, and are never recomputed. Do not price from a parent range, sum alternative packages/date rows, reload library prices, or add informational price components to an already complete offered total. The accepted promotion and discounted price are frozen at acceptance (FR-019). Checkout and payment offer no code entry, removal, replacement, or price-changing revalidation; do not mutate the AcceptanceEvent or reapply current promotion settings to payments.

nodes.title: Initial payment guard before processor submission

attrs.statement: Before initial processor submission, system MUST validate FR-006 selection eligibility, accepted versions, and exclusive unexpired hold ownership; invalid handoffs are blocked and hold expiry follows `Payment Window Expired`, without hold extension or quote reopening. Payment failure MUST NOT extend or restart the hold; only the FR-006 audited admin revive creates a new hold. Later confirmed-booking payments do not acquire a new acceptance hold.
attrs.rationale: **Initial Payment Guard**: Before calling the payment processor, validate the FR-006 handoff (FR-006 owns these checks): the booking is `Accepted`; the parent inquiry is not `Cancelled`; the parent quote and accepted subquote are still `Accepted`; the provider is still Active (FR-015); parent/subquote versions match the AcceptanceEvent (`acceptedSubquoteVersion = acceptedParentQuoteVersion`); and that event owns the unexpired exclusive appointment hold. Payment cannot select a different package, option/date-price record, appointment, or quote price. This hold guard applies to the first confirming charge, not to later installments/final payments on an already confirmed booking.

nodes.title: Amount and currency read from the accepted snapshot

attrs.statement: System MUST read the payment amount and the accepted patient currency/exchange-rate from the FR-005 accepted snapshot for initial and subsequent payments, never recomputed; checkout cannot change these values or reselect package/date/appointment/quote price.
attrs.rationale: Patient payment currency and applicable exchange rates come from the accepted snapshot and remain read-only throughout checkout and later payments Patient locale/system currency or market exchange rate changes after acceptance; payment currency/rates remain the accepted values, not a new checkout selection

nodes.title: Payment history resolves to the AcceptanceEvent and snapshot

attrs.statement: Payment history MUST resolve through its booking to the AcceptanceEvent, accepted parent/subquote IDs, equal aggregate versions, selected option/date-price provenance, and original snapshot; subsequent authorized admin interventions (FR-006 revive, appointment change, cancellation, and provider-fault transfer) remain separately recorded.

nodes.title: First successful initial payment confirms booking and consumes the promotion use

attrs.statement: On the first successful initial payment, System MUST confirm the booking, create its appointment record from the hold (FR-006), and, for a provider-selected promotion or patient-entered code, consume the promotion use reserved at acceptance (FR-019 REQ-019-014). An automatic promotion's use is consumed at acceptance and follows FR-019 REQ-019-015.
attrs.rationale: The appointment record is created only on successful initial payment; before that, only the temporary hold keyed by provider, appointment date/time, and time zone exists (FR-006).

nodes.title: Payment Window Expired applies only to the first payment step

attrs.statement: `Payment Window Expired` MUST apply only to the first payment step, as stated in FR-006 (REQ-006-016). A missed later installment or final payment MUST NOT cause `Payment Window Expired`, booking cancellation, or inquiry cancellation.
attrs.rationale: A missed later installment or final payment never causes `Payment Window Expired`, booking cancellation, or inquiry cancellation; it is flagged and notified.

nodes.title: Provider fault after acceptance blocks payment and credits or refunds paid money

attrs.statement: When a provider fault after acceptance closes a booking (FR-006 Alternative Flow B5), System MUST block further payment against it and treat money already paid under the B5 placeholder: credit toward the replacement booking, refund of any unused part, and no patient fee. Detailed mechanics are defined in the payment pass.
attrs.rationale: Provider fault after acceptance follows FR-006 Alternative Flow B5 (Alternative Flow B4 above); paid money follows its placeholder, with detailed mechanics deferred to the payment pass.

nodes.title: Up to three automatic retries with backoff for transient failures

attrs.statement: **Retry Policy (Constitution-aligned)**: For transient processor/network failures, Payment Service MUST perform up to 3 automatic retries using exponential backoff with jitter (and idempotency) before marking a payment attempt failed; hard declines require explicit patient action to retry.
attrs.rationale: System classifies failure type (hard decline vs transient error). surface progress and final failure to patient if retries exhaust

nodes.title: Hard decline shows a clear error; patient retries or picks another method against the same snapshot

attrs.statement: For hard declines, System displays clear error and suggested next steps (retry, use different method). Patient retries or selects another method against the same accepted snapshot while the original FR-006 hold remains valid.
attrs.rationale: Display clear error messaging and retry options on failure Booking remains unconfirmed until successful initial payment; failure/retry does not change the accepted selection.

nodes.title: Failed or abandoned authentication leaves payment incomplete; retry only while the original hold is active

attrs.statement: Payment remains incomplete until successful authentication; booking not confirmed. Retrying is allowed only while the original FR-006 hold remains active; an authentication challenge does not restart the payment window.
attrs.rationale: System informs patient of the authentication requirement and guides action If challenge fails or times out, System presents retry and alternative method options Hold expires during an authentication challenge; retry cannot extend/recreate the hold or bypass FR-006 eligibility; only an FR-006 audited admin revive starts a new hold

nodes.title: Expired selection stays blocked; AcceptanceEvent retained; recovery by new inquiry or admin revive

attrs.statement: On hold expiry, FR-006 releases the hold, creates no appointment record, and records `Payment Window Expired`; payment against that accepted selection remains blocked. Retain the AcceptanceEvent and snapshot unchanged. Do not reopen the parent quote or make the accepted subquote selectable again; recovery is by cancelling the inquiry and starting a new inquiry, or by the FR-006 audited admin revive.
attrs.rationale: `Payment Window Expired` blocks further payment against that selection without reopening its parent/subquote; only the FR-006 audited admin revive creates a new hold.

nodes.title: Admin revive starts a new hold and re-takes a promotion use

attrs.statement: An admin revive does not extend the expired hold. It starts a new hold of the FR-026 slot-hold duration at the revive time and, where the accepted promotion has a usage limit, takes one use again (re-reserved for a provider-selected promotion or patient-entered code, taken again for an automatic promotion; the revive is rejected if the limit has no room); initial payment then runs the Initial Payment Guard against that new hold.

nodes.title: Interest-free installment plans of 2 to 9 monthly payments

nodes.title: Feasible options from time to procedure, monthly frequency and cutoff

attrs.statement: System MUST determine feasible installment options based on time until procedure, monthly frequency, and cutoff days configured in FR-029 (minimum 30 days); offered options are limited to enabled installment counts configured in FR-029 (2-9)
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-007b-002 (prd.md line 814). Restated by General Module Rules (only feasible counts are offered given booking date, procedure date, monthly frequency and cutoff window), Main Flow steps 2 and 3 (e.g. 2 to 5 installments for a procedure in 6 months) and Screen 1 (Maximum Installments 2 to 9, based on (days until procedure - 30) / 30).

nodes.title: Integration with the payment processor for scheduled charges

nodes.title: Reminder 3 days before each installment due date

attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-007b-014 (prd.md line 835). Restated by the Patient and Shared Services scope, Communication Structure (email and push), Main Flow step 10 and Fixed in Codebase (reminder timing). User Story 2: the reminder carries the amount and date.

nodes.title: Automatic charge on the due date

attrs.statement: System MUST automatically charge payment method on installment due date
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-007b-015 (prd.md line 836). Restated by Payment & Billing Rules (charges are automatic on scheduled dates; patient consent is given at checkout) and Main Flow step 11.

nodes.title: Confirmation notification after a successful charge

nodes.title: Failed charge detected and patient notified immediately

nodes.title: Three automatic retries at 1, 3 and 7 days

attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-007b-018 (prd.md line 842). Restated by Alternative Flow B1 steps 3 to 5, Payment & Billing Rules, Fixed in Codebase (3 attempts; schedule 1, 3 and 7 days) and the S-02 scope.

nodes.title: Plan flagged Defaulted after three failed retries

nodes.title: Admin notified of a defaulted plan

attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-007b-020 (prd.md line 844). Restated by Alternative Flow B1 step 7 (defaulted plan and overdue booking), Communication Structure (admin alerts) and the S-03 scope.

nodes.title: Patient can update the payment method of an active plan

attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-007b-021 (prd.md line 848). nodes.title: Refund calculated per cancellation policy for partial installments

attrs.statement: System MUST calculate refunds for canceled bookings with partial installments paid per cancellation policy
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-007b-022 (prd.md line 849). Restated by Alternative Flow B2 step 2, the Admin scope (process refunds for canceled bookings with partial installments) and Screen 6 (Cancel Plan calculates refunds per cancellation policy).

nodes.title: Remaining installments cancelled with the booking

attrs.statement: System MUST cancel remaining installments when booking is canceled
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-007b-023 (prd.md line 850). Restated by Alternative Flow B2 step 5, Screen 6 (Cancel Plan stops future installments) and User Stories 5 and 6.

nodes.title: Date change recalculates the schedule or requires immediate payment

attrs.statement: System MUST handle procedure date rescheduling by recalculating installment schedule or requiring immediate payment
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-007b-024 (prd.md line 851). Restated by Alternative Flow B3, Payment & Billing Rules (rescheduling may require plan adjustment or immediate payment of the remaining balance) and Edge Cases.

nodes.title: Plan total, currency and exchange rate copied read-only from the accepted snapshot

attrs.statement: System MUST copy the installment plan total, currency and exchange rate read-only from the FR-005 accepted snapshot through the FR-006 booking; the total already includes the accepted promotion and any patient promotion code; it MUST NOT be recomputed and MUST be shown with its currency on all installment screens
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-007b-025 (prd.md line 855). Restated by General Module Rules, Main Flow upstream context and step 1, Screens 1, 2, 4 and 6 (Currency read-only, from the accepted snapshot), Data Dependencies, the FR-019 dependency (promotion already in the total), User Story 1 scenarios 4 and 5, and Edge Cases (a quote, package or promotion edited after acceptance has no effect).

nodes.title: First-installment retries only within the FR-006 payment hold

attrs.statement: System MUST allow first-installment retries only within the original FR-006 payment hold; `Payment Window Expired` applies only to that first payment step, and missed later installments MUST NOT cause `Payment Window Expired` or inquiry cancellation

nodes.title: Provider fault after acceptance cancels remaining installments and credits paid ones

attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-007b-027 (prd.md line 857). Restated by Alternative Flow B4 steps 1 and 2 and its outcome (the patient keeps the value already paid and continues with the replacement provider in the same inquiry), and the FR-006 dependency note.

nodes.title: Patient can download installment payment receipts

nodes.title: Completed plan shown as Fully Paid; booking status follows FR-006

nodes.title: Patient may be charged late or rescheduling fees

nodes.title: Defaulted plan resolved manually or by admin cancellation

attrs.statement: Admin reviews and contacts the patient to resolve the payment issue; payment is resolved manually, or the admin cancels the booking through the FR-006 Cancel Booking action with a mandatory reason. Admin can cancel the booking for chronically defaulted plans.
attrs.rationale: PRD prose rule, no id. prd.md line 153 (Alternative Flows); line 375 (Screen 5: Admin Installment Plan Management Dashboard).

nodes.title: Later missed installments never cancel the booking automatically

attrs.statement: Alternative Flow B1 covers installments after the first. A missed or failed later installment never causes automatic booking cancellation; failure of the first installment at checkout is part of the first payment step and follows the FR-006 payment hold.

nodes.title: Patient cancellation goes through Contact Support and an admin cancels

attrs.statement: The patient requests cancellation through Contact Support; after subquote acceptance the patient cannot cancel in the app (FR-006) and the request reaches the admin queue in FR-016. The admin reviews the request and cancels the booking through the FR-006 Cancel Booking action with a mandatory reason and audit entry; the refund amount follows the FR-006 payment placeholder.
attrs.rationale: PRD prose rule, no id. prd.md line 161 (Alternative Flows).

nodes.title: Cancellation refund ladder on paid installments

attrs.statement: Cancellation refunds are calculated based on timing: more than 30 days before the procedure = 90% of paid installments; 15 to 30 days = 50%; less than 15 days = no refund.
attrs.rationale: PRD prose rule, no id. prd.md line 491 (Payment & Billing Rules).

nodes.title: Same refund percentages for installment and single payments

attrs.statement: The cancellation refund policy applies the same percentages to installment plans as to single payments.
attrs.rationale: PRD prose rule, no id. prd.md line 639 (Business Process Assumptions).

nodes.title: Refund percentages set by admin per timing window

attrs.statement: The cancellation refund policy for installment plans is configurable with restrictions: the admin sets the percentages per timing window.
attrs.rationale: PRD prose rule, no id. prd.md line 482 (Admin Editability Rules).

nodes.title: Partial refund outcome recorded on the plan

attrs.statement: The system records the partial refund outcome on the installment plan; booking status moves to Cancelled per FR-006; no further installments are charged.
attrs.rationale: PRD prose rule, no id. prd.md line 166 (Alternative Flows).

nodes.title: Provider notified when a booking with an active plan is cancelled

attrs.statement: The provider is notified when a booking with an active installment plan is cancelled.
attrs.rationale: PRD prose rule, no id. prd.md line 167 (Alternative Flows).

attrs.statement: When a patient disputes a charge for a partial-installment refund, the admin reviews the dispute and processes the refund per the resolution; the admin may cancel the booking or allow continuation.
attrs.rationale: PRD prose rule, no id. prd.md line 804 (Edge Cases).

nodes.title: Admin date change triggers recalculation without changing the total

attrs.statement: The admin date change, made through the FR-006 Change Appointment action and notified to the patient and provider through booking.rescheduled, triggers installment plan recalculation from the updated booking date; the plan total, currency and the accepted snapshot do not change. Patient self-service rescheduling remains deferred to V2.
attrs.rationale: PRD prose rule, no id. prd.md line 173 (Alternative Flows).

nodes.title: Sufficient time: schedule dates adjusted to the new date

attrs.statement: After a date change the system checks whether the new procedure date allows completion of the remaining installments (30-day buffer); if there is sufficient time, the system adjusts the installment schedule dates to align with the new procedure date.
attrs.rationale: PRD prose rule, no id. prd.md line 175 (Alternative Flows).

nodes.title: Insufficient time: remaining balance paid immediately or plan cancelled

attrs.statement: If the new procedure date leaves insufficient time, the system notifies the patient that the remaining balance must be paid immediately or the installment plan canceled; the admin, in coordination with the patient, either collects the remaining balance immediately or cancels the booking through the FR-006 Cancel Booking action.
attrs.rationale: PRD prose rule, no id. prd.md line 176 (Alternative Flows).

nodes.title: Provider fault during Aftercare does not change the plan

attrs.statement: A provider fault during Aftercare reassigns only the aftercare provider (FR-011) and does not change the installment plan.
attrs.rationale: PRD prose rule, no id. prd.md line 182 (Alternative Flows).

nodes.title: Replacement plan takes its total from the replacement quote's snapshot

attrs.statement: Any installment plan for the replacement booking takes its total, currency and exchange rate from the replacement quote's acceptance snapshot, never from the original snapshot or a live quote.
attrs.rationale: PRD prose rule, no id. prd.md line 186 (Alternative Flows).

nodes.title: Cutoff change applies only to new bookings

attrs.statement: If the admin increases the cutoff window (e.g. from 30 to 45 days via FR-029), it applies only to new bookings; existing installment plans are unchanged.
attrs.rationale: PRD prose rule, no id. prd.md line 803 (Edge Cases).

attrs.statement: Reducing the number of installments mid-plan is not supported; the patient can pay the remaining balance early to complete the plan.
attrs.rationale: PRD prose rule, no id. prd.md line 802 (Edge Cases).

nodes.title: Payment status polled when the processor webhook fails

attrs.statement: If the payment processor webhook fails to deliver a charge status, the system polls payment status as a fallback so that no confirmation or retry is missed.
attrs.rationale: PRD prose rule, no id. prd.md line 805 (Edge Cases).

attrs.statement: Installment charges are idempotent: a retry never produces a duplicate charge.
attrs.rationale: PRD prose rule, no id. prd.md line 649 (Technical Considerations).

nodes.title: Installment schedule and amounts immutable once confirmed

attrs.statement: Installment schedule and amounts are immutable once confirmed (prevents tampering).
attrs.rationale: PRD prose rule, no id. prd.md line 685 (Security Considerations).

nodes.title: Commission on the booking total, deducted from payout after the final installment

attrs.statement: Platform commission is calculated on the booking total (accepted price after promotion), using the commission type (Percentage or Flat Rate) and value from the snapshot taken at booking confirmation (FR-029), deducted from provider payout after the final installment completes.
attrs.rationale: PRD prose rule, no id. prd.md line 492 (Payment & Billing Rules).

nodes.title: Provider payout delayed until the plan is fully paid

attrs.statement: Provider payout is delayed until all installments are completed and the instalment plan is fully paid.

attrs.statement: Access to installment payment data follows RBAC: patients see their own installments, providers see booking payment status, and admins see all plans.

nodes.title: PCI-DSS via the processor; GDPR and HIPAA-aligned payment data handling

attrs.statement: The following are fixed in code and not editable by the admin: interest rate (always 0%), installment frequency (monthly, 30-day intervals), core payment security controls and encryption standards, number of retry attempts (3), retry schedule (1, 3 and 7 days later), reminder timing (3 days before the due date) and audit logging scope for payment events. nodes.title: Admin dashboard metrics, plan list and drill-down

nodes.title: Admin views the plan configuration owned by FR-029

nodes.title: Admin Cancel Plan and Apply Cancellation Policy

nodes.title: Provider fault before treatment starts hands off to the FR-006 replacement flow

nodes.title: Passport submission only after booking Confirmed

nodes.title: Passport data encrypted and number masked for the patient

attrs.statement: The system MUST notify the provider when a patient submits passport details or admin corrects the record.

nodes.title: Automatic passport request at Confirmed (Path A)

attrs.statement: The system MUST automatically request passport details from the patient once when the linked FR-006 booking becomes **Confirmed** and the accepted option snapshot yields Path A. No provider or admin trigger is required.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Main Flow 1 trigger and step A2, Patient Platform scope, Shared Services scope and Business Rules 'Automated Trigger on Confirmed Booking'.

nodes.title: Flight as two independent leg records

attrs.statement: The system MUST allow flight information to be submitted as two independent records (outbound and return), each with a `leg_type` indicator.

nodes.title: Flight submitter follows the travel path

attrs.statement: The system MUST allow the patient to submit flight records in Path B or the provider to submit them in Path A only when flight is included in the accepted option. It MUST reject mixed submitters for the same booking.
attrs.rationale: No submitter mixing: Path A flight and hotel entries come from the provider only, Path B entries from the patient only; admin corrects in both paths (Travel Path Determination).

nodes.title: Travel dates validated against the current appointment

attrs.statement: The system MUST validate that `arrival_date` is ≥ `departure_date`, that the outbound flight arrives on or before the current booking appointment date, that the return flight departs after it, and that hotel check-in is on or before that date with check-out after check-in. The current booking appointment equals the accepted snapshot appointment unless an admin-approved change exists. Because treatment plan days are relative, a return flight or hotel check-out before the last treatment plan day is not rejected; it raises the soft warning in REQ-008-031.
attrs.rationale: Field-level date validation also appears on Screens 3, 4, 8 and 9. Treatment plan days are relative, so an early departure is a warning (REQ-008-031), not a rejection.

nodes.title: No total price on the flight record

attrs.statement: The system MUST NOT include a `total_price` field in the flight record (payment is handled against the accepted option/date-price selection).
attrs.rationale: Flight cost is part of the accepted option/date-price selection (FR-004, FR-005, FR-007); Screens 3 and 8 and the Assumptions repeat the exclusion.

attrs.statement: The system MUST normalise the flight API field to `baggage_allowance` (singular) for consistency.
attrs.rationale: The PRD marks the baggages_allowance spelling as an API naming discrepancy to resolve with the backend team.

nodes.title: Hotel submitter follows the travel path

attrs.statement: The system MUST allow the patient to submit hotel information in Path B or the provider to submit it in Path A only when hotel is included in the accepted option. It MUST reject mixed submitters for the same booking.
The system MUST validate that `check_out_date` is after `check_in_date`.

nodes.title: Hotel transportation field is canonical for pickup notes

attrs.statement: The `transportation` field in the hotel record MUST be the canonical field for airport pickup and transfer coordination in MVP.
attrs.rationale: No separate transport form exists in MVP (Screens 4 and 9 notes, Hotel Records, Assumptions).

nodes.title: Itinerary is a read view per confirmed booking

attrs.statement: The system MUST assemble one active travel itinerary per confirmed booking/appointment as a read view from its TravelContext, the current passport, flight, and hotel records, and the Booking; the itinerary MUST NOT be stored as a separate record.
attrs.rationale: Itinerary Rules and Screen 5 purpose restate this; admin corrections refresh the relevant section automatically.

nodes.title: Itinerary visible to patient, provider and admin

attrs.statement: The system MUST display the itinerary to the patient, provider (for coordination), and admin.
The system MUST log all changes to travel records (who, when, what) for audit.
attrs.rationale: Itinerary Rules: all record submissions and admin corrections are logged (who, when, what).

nodes.title: Travel records locked on submission; admin corrections versioned

attrs.statement: Travel records (passport, flight, hotel) MUST be locked immediately after submission. The system MUST prevent any edit by the patient or provider post-submission. Admin corrections MUST write a new locked version, mark the previous as superseded, and log the correction with a mandatory reason.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 1, 3, 4, 8 and 9 rules, Passport Rules, Flight Records and Alternative Flow A2. Admin correction on any tab writes a new locked version and marks the previous one superseded (Screen 12 tabs).

nodes.title: Travel path derived from the accepted option snapshot

attrs.statement: The binary travel path MUST be derived from `included_services` in the accepted FR-004 Quote Option snapshot carried by the FR-005 AcceptanceEvent, not selected by the provider in FR-008. `flight` or `hotel` yields `provider_included` (Path A); neither yields `patient_self_booked` (Path B), including transport-only options. FR-008 MUST persist the derived path and accepted inclusions in TravelContext at booking confirmation. Path A allows provider entry only for included flight/hotel services and never patient entry; Path B allows patient entry only and never provider entry. An omitted Path A flight/hotel service is "Not included" and is not collected in MVP. The reusable package preset and parent quote are not the authority for this choice.
attrs.rationale: Travel Path Determination: travel_path is not user-selectable; the provider edits option-level included_services in FR-004 and those changes stay within that quote. Transport-only inclusion remains Path B.

nodes.title: Provider travel status tracker follows included services

attrs.statement: For a Path A booking, the system MUST surface a travel status tracker on the provider's confirmed booking view covering passport, outbound flight, return flight, and hotel; entry actions MUST follow the accepted option's included services.

The system MUST automatically send the applicable travel request notification to the patient (in-app + email) once when the booking transitions to Confirmed after successful initial payment — no manual trigger required.

nodes.title: Patient notified of provider entry and admin correction

attrs.statement: The system MUST notify the patient when the provider enters travel details on their behalf (Path A), and when admin applies a correction to any of their travel records.

nodes.title: Provider notified of patient submission and admin correction

attrs.statement: The system MUST notify the provider when the patient submits passport or travel details, and when admin applies a correction to any travel record for their patient.

nodes.title: Admin views, filters and drills into all travel records

attrs.statement: Admin MUST be able to view, filter, and drill into all travel records across all appointments.

nodes.title: Admin edits any travel record with audit entry

attrs.statement: Admin MUST be able to edit any travel record with a mandatory audit log entry.

FR-008 MUST create or reuse exactly one TravelContext per confirmed FR-006 Booking, keyed by `booking_id`; passport, flight, and hotel records MUST link to that TravelContext rather than using a flat `quote_id` as their sole operational key.

nodes.title: TravelContext retains the accepted snapshot provenance

attrs.statement: TravelContext MUST retain the immutable AcceptanceEvent ID, accepted parent quote and subquote IDs/aggregate version, Quote Option ID, Option/Date-Price ID, accepted appointment date/time/timezone, accepted date range start and end, and included-service snapshot, all read from the FR-005 accepted snapshot. The accepted parent and subquote versions MUST match the same FR-004 aggregate `QuoteVersion`. FR-008 MUST NOT reselect or reconstruct a different package, date range, appointment, or price.
attrs.rationale: acceptedSubquoteVersion equals acceptedParentQuoteVersion because both refer to the same FR-004 parent aggregate revision (Travel Context and Booking Lifecycle).

nodes.title: No travel coordination before successful initial payment

attrs.statement: FR-008 MUST NOT create TravelContext or send initial travel requests on subquote acceptance, payment attempts, `Payment Window Expired`, or cancellation before successful initial payment. Repeated delivery of the confirmed-booking signal MUST NOT duplicate TravelContext or the initial request.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules 'Automated Trigger on Confirmed Booking' and acceptance scenarios 1 and 2: replayed confirmation events or retries never create a second TravelContext or a duplicate initial request.

nodes.title: Cancelled booking closes the TravelContext; date change flags review

attrs.statement: When a confirmed booking is cancelled, FR-008 MUST set the TravelContext to `closed` and close pending travel requests and reminders while retaining submitted travel records and audit history. An admin-approved appointment change MUST flag existing travel dates for audited revalidation; external travel is not automatically rebooked.

nodes.title: Travel APIs resolve the booking server-side and reject overrides

attrs.statement: Travel record APIs MUST accept a confirmed `booking_id`, resolve TravelContext and acceptance provenance server-side, enforce the Path A / Path B submitter and inclusion rules, and reject client-supplied changes to accepted quote, subquote, option, date-price, path, or inclusion values. Travel record APIs and patient re-notification MUST also reject any write against a closed TravelContext.

Only an admin MAY clear `travel-date-review-required`, by confirming that the existing flight and hotel dates still fit the current booking appointment or by correcting the affected records. Either action MUST return the TravelContext to `active` and record the admin, time, reason and outcome in the audit log.

nodes.title: Early departure raises an acknowledged soft warning

attrs.statement: When a return flight departs, or the hotel check-out date falls, before the last treatment plan day (current booking appointment date plus the plan day count minus one), the system MUST show the submitter a soft warning that must be acknowledged before saving, MUST still allow the record to be saved, MUST record who acknowledged it and when, and MUST show the provider an early-departure flag on the booking.
attrs.rationale: Applies on Screens 3, 8 and 12 (return flight) and Screens 4, 9 and 12 (hotel check-out); the provider's status badge shows 'Leaves before last treatment day' with the time the submitter acknowledged the warning (Screen 6).

nodes.title: Provider-fault transfer carries travel records to the replacement booking

attrs.statement: When FR-006 Alternative Flow B5 transfers a patient to a replacement booking, the system MUST keep the original TravelContext closed with its records read-only, MUST carry the passport record over to the replacement TravelContext as a new locked booking-linked record, MUST copy the current flight and hotel records to it with a copy-source reference and the flag "travel-date review required", and MUST set the replacement TravelContext to `travel-date-review-required` until an admin clears the review under REQ-008-030.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B2: copied flight and hotel records show 'Travel-date review required' on the provider Travel section until admin clears it; admin confirms or corrects copied dates on Screens 11 and 12.

attrs.statement: The itinerary MUST be a read view assembled from the TravelContext, the current passport, flight, and hotel records, and the Booking; no itinerary table or stored itinerary record MAY exist.

nodes.title: Automatic flight and hotel request at Confirmed (Path B)

attrs.statement: The system MUST automatically request flight and hotel details (no passport) from the patient once when the linked FR-006 booking becomes **Confirmed** and the accepted option snapshot yields Path B. No provider or admin trigger is required.
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-008-005b does not fit the Rule id pattern, so it is recorded as REQ-008-034. Passport is not requested in Path B (Passport Rules).

nodes.title: Future phase: in-app flight search and booking

attrs.statement: The system SHOULD integrate a flight search API (e.g. Amadeus) to enable in-app flight booking in a future phase.

nodes.title: Future phase: in-app hotel search and booking

attrs.statement: The system SHOULD integrate a hotel search API (e.g. Booking.com) to enable in-app hotel booking in a future phase.

nodes.title: Future phase: commission tracking on platform bookings

attrs.statement: The system SHOULD support commission tracking on platform-facilitated bookings once API booking is live.
The system SHOULD support a dedicated transport record entity when Hairline operates its own driver network.

nodes.title: Future phase: real-time flight price estimates

attrs.statement: The system SHOULD display real-time flight price estimates during inquiry date selection once a flight API is integrated.

nodes.title: MVP is information capture and coordination only

attrs.statement: In MVP the platform MUST NOT support in-app flight or hotel booking, platform-managed transport, commission tracking, airport transport booking, travel price preview during inquiry date selection, or OCR/auto-extraction of travel data from patient screenshots. It facilitates information capture and coordination only: all flight and hotel bookings are completed outside the platform by the patient or the provider, and all travel details are entered manually.
attrs.rationale: PRD Executive Summary, Out of Scope (MVP) list and Assumptions. Airport transport is informational only through the hotel Transportation Details field.

nodes.title: Travel lives inside the confirmed booking detail screens

attrs.statement: Travel status, records and actions MUST be surfaced as a Travel section inside the confirmed booking detail screen of the provider (visible only once the booking is Confirmed) and of the admin (visible for every confirmed booking regardless of travel path). There MUST be no standalone travel dashboard or travel oversight screen; admin reaches a booking through the existing inquiry and booking management.
attrs.rationale: Entry points: the automated in-app prompt and email on Confirmed for the patient, and the Travel section of the booking detail screen for provider and admin (Multi-Tenant Architecture; Screens 6 and 11 placement). Conflicts with REQ-008-023 and SC-007 wording; recorded as a question.

nodes.title: Passport photo is a reference document only

attrs.statement: The passport photo MUST be stored in compliant secure storage as a reference document only. It MUST NOT be parsed or processed automatically, is viewable but not downloadable by the assigned provider and admin, and is not shown in any list, itinerary view or the patient's confirmation view. All passport fields are entered manually by the patient.

nodes.title: Travel path fixed at booking confirmation

attrs.statement: The travel path MUST be fixed at booking confirmation: the derived path and the included-service snapshot are stored in the booking's TravelContext, and later package-library or quote changes MUST NOT reroute an existing booking. Neither the parent quote as a whole nor the reusable package preset determines the accepted travel choice.

nodes.title: Included travel items listed on the patient itinerary

attrs.statement: Included travel items of the accepted option (for example hotel, airport transfer, or another travel service such as a city tour) MUST be listed as Package Travel Items on the patient itinerary whenever they exist, in Path A or Path B. Services not included are shown as Not included and are not collected in MVP.

nodes.title: Transport is provider-arranged and has no separate record

attrs.statement: Transport (airport pickup) MUST always be provider-arranged when included in the accepted option and MUST NOT be tracked as a separate record or form in MVP; it is captured through the Transportation Details notes of the hotel record. Providers may use those notes to plan clinic-side logistics such as verifying arrival times for pickup.

nodes.title: Passport required for Path A only

attrs.statement: Passport submission MUST be required for every Path A appointment and MUST NOT be required or requested for Path B, where the patient manages their own passport for independent bookings. The passport submission screen is never shown for Path B.

nodes.title: Invalid passport submission rejected, nothing stored

attrs.statement: A passport submission that fails validation (missing required fields, invalid dates, or failed photo quality check) MUST be rejected with field-level errors; no passport record is created or updated and the passport status remains Awaiting until a successful submission.

nodes.title: Passport photo quality gate before submission

attrs.statement: Before a passport photo can be submitted, the app MUST run an on-device quality check (lighting, focus, blur) and block submission with an actionable error (for example 'Too blurry - retake in better light') when it fails. The check is a quality gate only: no OCR or data extraction.
attrs.rationale: The PRD names Google ML Kit as the Flutter implementation; that is a technical choice and is not carried into the graph.

nodes.title: Passport data is PII, encrypted at rest and in transit

attrs.statement: Passport data (especially passport_number and passport_image) MUST be treated as PII under GDPR and data protection rules and MUST be encrypted at rest and in transit.

nodes.title: Provider passport access logged and limited to assigned clinic

attrs.statement: Provider access to passport data MUST be logged (timestamp, provider user ID), and a provider MUST NOT be able to view passport data of patients not assigned to its clinic. The provider sees the passport number in full and the passport view is read-only; incorrect data is corrected by contacting admin.

nodes.title: Earlier passport details reused through a new locked record

attrs.statement: If a patient previously submitted passport details for an earlier appointment, the patient MAY reuse them through a new booking-linked locked record; the earlier record MUST NOT be edited. If the passport has since changed (for example renewed), admin MUST correct the applicable record.

nodes.title: Edit of a submitted record is blocked and redirected to admin

attrs.statement: Once a passport, flight or hotel record is submitted, an attempt by the patient or provider to edit, delete or re-submit it MUST be blocked and the submitter MUST be shown a message that corrections are requested through admin. The provider has no edit or flag capability on a patient-submitted record and contacts admin when it looks incorrect.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A2; Screens 1, 3, 4, 6, 8, 9 and 10 rules.

nodes.title: At most two current flight records per booking

attrs.statement: A confirmed booking MUST have at most two current flight records (outbound and return); superseded admin-correction versions remain in history. Both legs use the same form and the leg type is set at creation.

nodes.title: Round-trip legs are independent and presented sequentially

attrs.statement: A round trip MUST be two FlightRecord entries (outbound, return) linked to the same appointment. Each leg MUST be independent, so either may be missing (one-way, or return not yet confirmed). After the outbound leg is submitted the system prompts for the return leg, the form header labels the leg ('Outbound Flight' or 'Return Flight'), and the UI presents the legs as two sequential steps or two tabs.
attrs.rationale: Round-Trip rules, Screens 3 and 8, and the Assumption that round trip is the standard expectation.

nodes.title: At most one current hotel record per booking

attrs.statement: A confirmed booking MUST have at most one current hotel record in MVP (no multi-hotel or multi-city case); superseded admin-correction versions remain in history. Provider hotel entry is enabled only while no hotel record has been submitted for the appointment.

nodes.title: Itinerary sections show submitter, timestamp and pending state

attrs.statement: Each itinerary section MUST show the submission timestamp and the submitter (patient or provider). A pending item shows an 'Awaiting submission' state, and a submission link appears only when the patient owns that item (Path B, or the Path A passport). The passport section (full name, masked passport number, date of expiry) appears only for Path A, and the return flight section only if a return record exists.

nodes.title: Record visibility limited to owner, assigned clinic and admin

attrs.statement: A patient MUST see only their own travel records; a provider MUST see only bookings assigned to its clinic and only the booking currently open (no cross-patient or cross-clinic access); admin sees all travel records without restriction.

nodes.title: No-travel declaration by a Path B patient

attrs.statement: On the travel requirement check (Path B only), the patient MUST state whether travel is needed. Yes leads to flight and then hotel submission. No MUST set the TravelContext travel_required flag to false (no_travel_required), suppress further travel submission reminders for the booking, skip the flight and hotel steps, and show the itinerary as 'No travel required'. The check is not shown for Path A.

nodes.title: No-travel declaration reversed by admin only

attrs.statement: A patient MUST NOT be able to reverse a no-travel declaration and contacts admin instead. Admin MAY override no_travel_required from the Travel section and re-send the travel submission request. The declaration and any admin override MUST be recorded on the TravelContext with timestamp and actor ID.

nodes.title: Admin re-notify limited to patient-owned pending items

attrs.statement: Admin 'Re-notify patient' MUST send a manual reminder only for a patient-owned pending item: the passport in Path A, or flight or hotel in Path B unless the booking is marked no_travel_required. Provider-owned Path A flight and hotel items MUST NOT create patient submission reminders.

nodes.title: Closed TravelContext is read-only; refunds are out of scope

attrs.statement: A closed TravelContext MUST reject new passport, flight and hotel records, patient re-notification and admin corrections; its records stay read-only with their audit history, and Enter Flight, Enter Hotel, Re-notify patient, Confirm Travel Dates and Apply Correction are not available. Any external flight or hotel cancellation is coordinated outside the platform under the governing booking policy; FR-008 MUST NOT calculate refunds or cancellation fees.

nodes.title: Appointment change keeps the accepted baseline visible

attrs.statement: When an approved admin intervention changes the appointment date after confirmation, the system MUST preserve the immutable accepted appointment baseline, show the current booking appointment alongside it, and revalidate the existing flight and hotel dates before the itinerary is treated as current. Patients and providers see 'Travel dates under admin review' on the affected sections but cannot clear it. FR-008 MUST NOT automatically rebook external travel.

Treatment plan days in the accepted option are relative days. FR-008 MUST NOT store them as calendar dates; it derives the last treatment plan day only to show the early-departure warning, and later FR-010 changes to the treatment plan, clinicians or grafts MUST NOT change the TravelContext or the accepted snapshot.

nodes.title: Provider status badges and entry actions follow path and inclusion

attrs.statement: The provider Travel section MUST show status badges for passport (Path A only), outbound flight, return flight and hotel (Not included, Awaiting or Submitted), updated in real time on submission and on admin correction, and MUST show the Awaiting states immediately when the booking becomes Confirmed. In Path A, Enter Flight and Enter Hotel appear only for included services; services not included show 'Not included' with no entry action. In Path B only View Travel Details (read-only) is shown and the provider cannot enter or modify records.

'Incomplete' MUST be an admin-managed passport status, used when a submitted passport record is deemed unusable or incorrect and is pending admin correction; the patient and provider cannot re-submit to change a locked record.

nodes.title: Admin corrections need a mandatory reason note

attrs.statement: Every admin correction of a travel record MUST require a mandatory 'Reason for correction' note before saving. Admin photo replacement and field edits create a new locked version, and the previous version stays in the backend records.
Admin MAY soft-delete any travel record with a mandatory reason; deletion is not permanent and is retained in the backend audit trail.

nodes.title: Passport tab hidden for Path B

attrs.statement: The passport tab and passport status MUST be hidden entirely for Path B appointments because no passport is captured.

nodes.title: Retention periods for travel data and audit entries

attrs.statement: Booking confirmation data (flight and hotel) MUST be retained for 7 years, aligned with medical data retention under the constitution; audit log entries for travel record mutations MUST be retained for 10 years under constitution Section VI.

nodes.title: Access and modification events logged with IP

attrs.statement: All access and modification events on travel records MUST be logged with timestamp, user ID and IP.

nodes.title: Travel notifications go by email and in-app

attrs.statement: All travel notifications MUST be sent by email and in-app.

nodes.title: Replacement TravelContext notices at provider-fault transfer

attrs.statement: When the replacement TravelContext is set to travel-date-review-required after a provider-fault transfer, the patient, the replacement provider and admin MUST be notified.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B2 step 6.

nodes.title: Provider-fault carry-over applies before treatment starts

attrs.statement: The provider-fault carry-over MUST apply only when an admin transfers the patient through FR-006 Alternative Flow B5 after the original booking was confirmed and before treatment starts. A provider fault during Aftercare reassigns only the aftercare provider (FR-011) and leaves the booking and its TravelContext unchanged.

nodes.title: Only verified logged-in patients may submit travel records

attrs.statement: Only verified, logged-in patients MAY submit passport and travel records.
attrs.rationale: Dependencies (internal), FR-001; FR-001 does not state this rule for travel records.

attrs.statement: Admin MUST be able to manage travel settings and, in a future phase, API configuration, commission parameters and per-country enablement once API booking is live.
attrs.rationale: Admin Platform scope and Screen 12 future note. The PRD does not define any MVP travel setting; recorded as a question.

nodes.title: System MUST allow provider owners to invite team members via email with secure, time-limited...

attrs.statement: System MUST allow provider owners to invite team members via email with secure, time-limited invitation links (7-day expiry), and MUST make provider-side team management view-only while the provider organization is Suspended, blocking invite, resend, role change, suspend, and remove (Rule 10)

nodes.title: System MUST support the four protected provider roles (Owner, Manager, Clinical Staff, Billing...

attrs.statement: System MUST support the four protected provider roles (Owner, Manager, Clinical Staff, Billing Staff) and global custom provider roles defined in FR-031; a custom role MUST have a non-Owner base type and be assignable only to non-Owner staff
attrs.rationale: The provider platform starts with four protected clinic-side roles that directly reflect how real clinics operate, while keeping clear separation from Hairline's own Admin Platform roles. Super Admins may also define global custom provider roles in FR-031; provider organizations can assign them to non-Owner staff but cannot change their definitions. Custom Provider Role: A Super Admin-defined role based on Manager, Clinical Staff, or Billing Staff. Its explicit permission grants determine access within the selected base type's protected-action limits. It cannot be based on Owner or replace the primary Owner.

nodes.title: System MUST enforce role-based access control for all provider platform features and data

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce role-based access control for all provider platform features and data

nodes.title: System MUST allow Owners and eligible Manager-base actors with the required permission to modify...

attrs.statement: System MUST allow Owners and eligible Manager-base actors with the required permission to modify non-Owner team member roles with immediate permission updates

nodes.title: System MUST allow Owners and Managers to remove non-Owner team members with immediate access...

attrs.statement: System MUST allow Owners and Managers to remove non-Owner team members with immediate access revocation

nodes.title: System MUST enforce "at least one owner" rule—prevent removal or demotion of last owner

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce "at least one owner" rule—prevent removal or demotion of last owner

nodes.title: System MUST send email notifications for team management events (invitation, role change, removal)

attrs.statement: System MUST send email notifications for team management events (invitation, role change, removal)

nodes.title: System MUST enforce the global provider email identity rule (Rule 3): an email can belong to...

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce the global provider email identity rule (Rule 3): an email can belong to only one provider organization at a time as Owner, team member, or pending invitation; invitations, FR-015 provider creation, and FR-015 owner login-email edits that use an email tied to another non-Deactivated provider must be blocked; emails of Deactivated providers are freed for reuse while their records stay archived
attrs.rationale: Rule 3 (Global Provider Email Identity): An email belongs to at most one provider organization at a time, across all forms of membership: Owner (created via FR-015), team member, or pending invitation. When a provider is Deactivated (FR-015), its Owner, team member, and pending-invitation emails are freed for reuse; the old records stay archived and are not reactivated by reuse. FR-015 provider creation and owner login-email edits apply this same rule.

nodes.title: System MUST maintain team member records with: name, email, role, status...

attrs.statement: System MUST maintain team member records with: name, email, role, status (Active/Suspended/Removed), invitation date, acceptance date, last activity timestamp. A team member record is created only when an invitation is accepted

nodes.title: System MUST persist invitation records with: token, expiry date, status...

attrs.statement: System MUST persist invitation records with: token, expiry date, status (Pending/Accepted/Expired/Cancelled), email delivery state (a failed send is "Pending Send" on a Pending invitation, not a status), sender, recipient email, role offered. Until acceptance an invited person exists only as an invitation; "Invited" is the display badge for a Pending invitation, not a team member status

nodes.title: System MUST consume the protected and custom provider role permission definitions configured...

attrs.statement: System MUST consume the protected and custom provider role permission definitions configured centrally in FR-031
attrs.rationale: Rule 7: FR-031 defines provider roles and their permission matrices centrally; FR-009 handles team assignment and consumes those definitions without allowing clinics to edit them.

nodes.title: System MUST maintain team member-to-provider organization relationships with role assignment per...

attrs.statement: System MUST maintain team member-to-provider organization relationships with role assignment per organization

nodes.title: System MUST log all team management actions in audit trail with: timestamp, actor, action type,...

attrs.statement: System MUST log all team management actions in audit trail with: timestamp, actor, action type, target team member, old values, new values, IP address
attrs.rationale: Rule 4: All team management actions (invite, role change, removal) are logged in audit trail with timestamp, actor, and action details. System logs all actions in audit trail System logs role change in audit trail with timestamp, actor, old role, new role

nodes.title: System MUST apply a team member's role change to their active sessions within 5 seconds without...

attrs.statement: System MUST apply a team member's role change to their active sessions within 5 seconds without forcing logout: the previous permissions stop applying, and the member's next request uses the refreshed permissions. System MUST invalidate all active sessions for a team member within 5 seconds of removal

nodes.title: System MUST validate actor permissions before allowing any team management action (invite, role...

attrs.statement: System MUST validate actor permissions before allowing any team management action (invite, role change, removal)
attrs.rationale: System validates actor has permission to assign selected role System validates actor has permission to remove target team member

nodes.title: System MUST generate cryptographically secure, single-use invitation tokens that expire after 7...

attrs.statement: System MUST generate cryptographically secure, single-use invitation tokens that expire after 7 days
attrs.rationale: Rule 5: Invitation links expire after 7 days—expired invitations can be resent with new expiry. System generates secure invitation token (expires in 7 days)

nodes.title: System MUST encrypt all team member data at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3)

attrs.statement: System MUST encrypt all team member data at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3)

nodes.title: System MUST enforce rate limiting on invitations: maximum 10 invitations per hour per provider...

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce rate limiting on invitations: maximum 10 invitations per hour per provider organization

nodes.title: System MUST integrate with email service to send invitation and notification emails with 99%+...

attrs.statement: System MUST integrate with email service to send invitation and notification emails with 99%+ delivery rate

nodes.title: System MUST integrate with authentication service to create team member accounts and manage...

attrs.statement: System MUST integrate with authentication service to create team member accounts and manage sessions

nodes.title: System MUST publish role change events to session management service for real-time permission...

attrs.statement: System MUST publish role change events to session management service for real-time permission updates

nodes.title: System MUST write all team management events to centralized audit logging service

attrs.statement: System MUST write all team management events to centralized audit logging service

nodes.title: System MUST restrict admin impersonation of a provider team member to Super Admins and apply the...

attrs.statement: System MUST restrict admin impersonation of a provider team member to Super Admins and apply the FR-015 "Login as Provider" rules: reason (min 20 chars) and password re-authentication before start, persistent banner with End Session, write actions allowed except changing the user's password, login email, or payout/bank/financial settings, session start/end and every write action logged and attributed to the admin, and automatic end after 30 minutes of inactivity. Impersonation MUST be blocked when the provider is Deactivated and MUST be read-only under FR-032 Rule 6 when the provider is Suspended
attrs.rationale: Impersonation is blocked when the provider is Deactivated ("Login as Provider is not available for a deactivated provider."). When the provider is Suspended, the session is read-only under FR-032 Rule 6, the same as for the user. Super Admin only. Before starting, the admin enters a reason (min 20 chars) and re-authenticates with password (MFA re-authentication is a future enhancement tied to the platform-wide MFA rollout). The impersonated session shows a persistent banner: "You are viewing as [Name] — admin session by [Admin Name]" with an "End Session" action. The admin may act on the impersonated user's behalf, except changing that user's password or login email, or changing payout/bank or financial settings; those actions are blocked during the session. Session start (with reason), session end, and every write action performed during the session are logged in the FR-009 audit trail and FR-015 Tab 8: Activity Log, attributed to the admin acting as the user. The session ends automatically after the standard 30-minute admin inactivity timeout.

nodes.title: Notification, authentication and audit services used by team management

attrs.statement: S-03: Notification Service sends invitation and team-management emails with secure signup links Provider Auth Service (PR-01) handles team member account creation, login, password reset, and session management while enforcing PR-01/FR-031 permission checks S-06: Audit Log Service records all team management actions for compliance

nodes.title: Owner role: single main account holder

attrs.statement: Owner (Main Account Holder): Single primary account per provider organization. Responsible for bank details and payouts, contract acceptance, and high-risk configuration. Mapped to the "provider admin / main account holder" described in the client transcription.

nodes.title: Manager role: clinic manager and operations

attrs.statement: Manager (Clinic Manager / Operations): Operational lead and front-of-staff representative. Can see and manage the full patient journey in the provider portal (inquiries, quotes, schedules, day-to-day operations), coordinate staff work, and manage most team settings, but cannot change bank details or assign/change the Owner role.

Clinical Staff: Medical staff who perform procedures and aftercare (surgeons, clinicians, nurses). Focused on in-progress and aftercare sections, treatment documentation, scans, and medical notes. Default: limited or no access to billing or sensitive configuration (final per-feature permissions are configured centrally in FR-031 and may deviate from this default).

Billing Staff: Finance-oriented staff who work with quotes and payouts ("how much they're making"). Can view and reconcile financial information but cannot alter clinical records or manage team structure or assign/change the Owner role.

nodes.title: Communication in scope: emails and in-platform notifications

attrs.statement: Email invitations to new team members with secure signup link Email notifications when team member role changes Email notifications when team member is removed or suspended In-platform notifications for team management events

nodes.title: Communication out of scope: SMS, tutorials, team chat

attrs.statement: SMS notifications for team management (handled by S-03: Notification Service if needed; no SMS is sent in MVP and this channel is reserved for future phases) Video tutorials for team onboarding (handled by separate content module) Chat/messaging between team members (separate collaboration feature)

"Pending Send" is a delivery state, not an invitation status, and the invitation takes a seat while it is Pending (Rule 6) System displays warning to Provider Owner: "Invitation created but email failed. We'll retry automatically." Background job retries sending every 10 minutes for 24 hours

nodes.title: Seat limit, seat usage counting and invitation blocking

attrs.statement: Rule 6: Maximum team size per provider organization defaults to 100 members and is configured by admins per FR-015. Seat usage counts non-Owner team members with status Active or Suspended plus invitations with status Pending that are not past expires_at, and each person is counted once. The Owner, Removed members, and Expired, Cancelled, or Accepted invitations do not count. A Suspended member keeps the seat; only removal frees it. Providers can request limit increases through support per FR-015; invitations must be blocked when seat usage reaches the limit.

nodes.title: Super Admin-defined custom roles assignable to non-Owner staff

attrs.statement: Rule 8: Super Admin-defined global custom provider roles are assignable to non-Owner staff. Their Manager, Clinical Staff, or Billing Staff base type preserves eligibility for existing role-limited actions; an explicit permission grant is also required. Custom roles never satisfy the primary Owner requirement or gain Owner-only actions.
attrs.rationale: Custom Provider Role: A Super Admin-defined role based on Manager, Clinical Staff, or Billing Staff. Its explicit permission grants determine access within the selected base type's protected-action limits. It cannot be based on Owner or replace the primary Owner.

nodes.title: Invitation is not a team member until accepted

attrs.statement: An invited person exists only as an invitation (Pending, Accepted, Expired, Cancelled) until they accept. A team member record is created only when the invitation is accepted.

nodes.title: Team member statuses Active, Suspended, Removed; Removed takes no seat

attrs.statement: Team member statuses are Active, Suspended, and Removed, stored as `active`, `suspended`, and `inactive` (`inactive` means Removed and is kept for compatibility). A Removed member never takes a seat. "Invited" is only the badge that team lists show for a Pending invitation row; it is not a team member status.

nodes.title: Legacy invitee rows migrated into invitations

attrs.statement: Legacy invitees that the old invite flow stored as team member rows (status `inactive` or `pending`, never accepted and no password set) are migrated into invitations: Pending if their invite or activation link has not expired, otherwise Expired. The placeholder member row is then deleted, so after migration `inactive` means Removed only (CR-FR009-20261028-01).

nodes.title: Suspended provider: team management is view-only

attrs.statement: Rule 10 (Suspended Provider Team Management): While the provider organization is Suspended (FR-015; banner per FR-032 Rule 6), the provider Team page and team member detail pages are view-only. Provider users cannot invite, resend or cancel an invitation, change a role, suspend, reactivate, or remove a member. The Team page shows "Your account is suspended. Team changes are unavailable. Please contact support." Admin invitations to a Suspended or Deactivated provider are blocked by REQ-009-024.
attrs.rationale: While the provider organization is Suspended, the dashboard is view-only (Rule 10): invite, resend, cancel invitation, role change, suspend, reactivate, and remove actions are unavailable, and the page shows "Your account is suspended. Team changes are unavailable. Please contact support." Form unavailable while the provider organization is Suspended (Team page view-only, Rule 10); admin invitations are blocked separately (Screen 12, REQ-009-024).

nodes.title: Fixed in codebase: protected roles, one Owner minimum, audit structure, template structure, session security

attrs.statement: Protected role identities and primary Owner rule. Custom role base type and permissions are configured centrally in FR-031, not by provider organizations. Minimum number of Owners required (always 1) Audit log structure and required fields Email invitation template structure (content editable, structure fixed) Session management security parameters

nodes.title: Admin cannot modify a provider's team without consent except Screens 10-12 actions

attrs.statement: Admin can view any provider's team structure but cannot modify it without provider consent (audit trail logged), except the admin actions defined in Screens 10-12 (including inviting staff via Screen 12 and actions taken during a Super Admin impersonation session)

nodes.title: Admins may suspend team members but cannot delete accounts

attrs.statement: Admin can suspend team members but cannot delete accounts (compliance requirement)

nodes.title: Provider subscription billing may later factor in team size

attrs.statement: Payment & Billing Rules: Not applicable to this module; team management itself has no direct payment flows. Provider subscription billing (future) may factor in team size.

nodes.title: MFA and device re-authentication deferred and non-blocking

attrs.statement: MFA enrollment during team member account setup (Screen 8): phone number capture for MFA, MFA factor selection, and enforcement that "password + MFA" must succeed before activation. MFA-gated actions in Screen 11 (Admin Team Member Detail): export full audit requiring MFA, session actions requiring MFA re-auth, MFA Status and MFA Reset controls, and admin-force removal/reset flows that currently mention MFA. Device-level MFA concepts such as "Linked Devices" are documented as placeholders only. Where this PRD currently mentions "re-authentication" for high-privilege actions, the initial implementation will rely on password-based re-auth only. Upgrading these flows to MFA-backed re-auth is a future enhancement aligned with the platform-wide MFA rollout. Implementation teams MUST treat the above as non-blocking, non-MVP requirements for FR-009 and track them against the corresponding security/MFA epics instead of this feature’s delivery scope.

nodes.title: Edge: bounced invitation logged and Owner notified in-platform

attrs.statement: System logs bounce event, marks invitation status as "Bounced", and notifies provider owner via in-app notification: "Invitation to [email] failed—email address may be invalid. Please verify and resend."

System enforces rate limit: maximum 10 invitations per hour per provider organization. If limit exceeded, display error: "You've reached the invitation limit (10 per hour). Please try again later." This prevents abuse and email service quota exhaustion.

nodes.title: Edge: invitation link and account creation are responsive

attrs.statement: Invitation link and account creation flow are fully responsive—works on any device. After account creation, mobile user is prompted to "Download Mobile App" (if patient platform) or "Bookmark this page" (if provider web app).

nodes.title: Edge: optimistic locking on concurrent role change

attrs.statement: Optimistic locking: last write wins. First admin's change is applied. Second admin's attempt returns conflict error: "This team member's role was recently changed by [Admin Name]. Please refresh and try again."

nodes.title: Treatment documentation limited to Clinical Staff and, where appropriate, the Owner

attrs.statement: Integration point: Treatment workflow checks team member role before allowing procedure documentation (only Clinical Staff and, where appropriate, the Owner can act as documenting providers)

nodes.title: IP location is optional: show the IP address alone when geolocation is unavailable

attrs.statement: Failure handling: Graceful degradation—if service unavailable, show IP address without location

nodes.title: Check In moves a confirmed booking to In Progress

attrs.statement: System MUST allow providers to "Check In" confirmed bookings when patient arrives at clinic, transitioning status to "In Progress"
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 940.

nodes.title: Only Owner, Manager or Clinical Staff document treatments

attrs.statement: System MUST validate provider role (Owner, Manager, or Clinical Staff) before allowing treatment documentation; Billing Staff cannot document treatments
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 941.

attrs.statement: System MUST auto-save treatment documentation every 2 minutes during active procedures to prevent data loss
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 942.

nodes.title: Minimum documentation required before treatment completion

attrs.statement: System MUST require minimum documentation before allowing treatment completion: conclusion notes, prescription, advice, medication (min 1), actual graft count, final head scan photo set (V1)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 943.

nodes.title: Completion signalled to FR-011, which owns the Aftercare transition

attrs.statement: System MUST signal treatment completion to FR-011 upon provider saving the End of Treatment modal. FR-011 owns the status transition to "Aftercare" and aftercare plan activation
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 944.

nodes.title: Patient notified when treatment starts and completes

attrs.statement: System MUST send real-time status notifications to patient mobile app when treatment starts ("In Progress") and when treatment completes ("Aftercare")
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. The patient notice events are EVT-treatment-started and EVT-treatment-completed. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 945.

nodes.title: Post-op instruction sheet sent within 5 minutes of completion

attrs.statement: System MUST generate and send post-op instruction sheet to patient via email and in-app notification within 5 minutes of treatment completion
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 947.

nodes.title: Completion data signalled to FR-011 for aftercare setup

attrs.statement: System MUST signal treatment completion data (conclusion, prescription, advice, medication, graft count) to FR-011 for aftercare setup. FR-011 owns aftercare template selection, plan activation, milestone generation, scan schedules, and questionnaire cadence
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 948.

nodes.title: Documentation due within 24 hours of Check In, with reminders

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce treatment documentation completion within 24 hours of Check In; send reminder notifications at 12 and 24 hours if incomplete
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Treatment plans span several days; see the product owner question on how the 24-hour window applies. The deadline and the reminder timing are governed by the two documentation Settings. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 949.

nodes.title: All documentation fields persisted with audit trail

attrs.statement: System MUST persist all treatment documentation fields with audit trail: graft counts, treatment reference, head scan photo sets (V1), treatment photos, medications, notes, timestamps, provider actions
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 960.

nodes.title: Documentation linked to snapshot and current details; estimate vs actual

attrs.statement: System MUST link treatment documentation to the accepted snapshot and the case's current treatment details, allowing providers to compare estimated vs. actual graft counts
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 961.

nodes.title: Treatment photos encrypted at rest and retained 7+ years

attrs.statement: System MUST store treatment photos encrypted at rest (AES-256) with retention period of 7+ years per healthcare compliance regulations
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 962.

nodes.title: Immutable audit log of documentation actions

attrs.statement: System MUST maintain immutable audit log of all treatment documentation actions: who documented, what changed, when changed (timestamp), IP address
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 963.

nodes.title: Documentation access limited to the owning clinic

attrs.statement: System MUST restrict treatment documentation access to provider clinic that owns the booking (no cross-clinic access)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 967.

nodes.title: Patient medical data encrypted in transit and at rest

attrs.statement: System MUST encrypt patient medical data (treatment notes, complications, medications) in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 968.

attrs.statement: System MUST implement role-based access control (RBAC) for treatment documentation: Owner, Manager, and Clinical Staff roles can document treatments; Billing Staff can view according to their access level but cannot document
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 969.

nodes.title: Upload file types validated and virus scanned

attrs.statement: System MUST validate file types on uploads — JPG, PNG for treatment photos and head scan photo sets (V1) — and perform virus scanning before storage
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 970.

attrs.statement: System MUST rate-limit photo uploads (max 50 uploads per hour per provider) to prevent abuse or system overload
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 971.
