attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 975.

nodes.title: Check In gated on outstanding balance; no payment capture in FR-010

attrs.statement: System MUST read booking payment state (from P-03 / FR-007) to gate "Check In" when there is an outstanding balance; FR-010 does not initiate payment capture
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. The same gate is held by FR-006 REQ-006-043 (Check In button availability). Kept here because the PRD states it as an FR-010 requirement. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 976.

nodes.title: Notifications go through S-03 Notification Service

attrs.statement: System MUST integrate with S-03 Notification Service to send status notifications, post-op instructions, and medication instructions to patients
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 977.

nodes.title: Completion data signalled to FR-011 (P-05 Aftercare)

attrs.statement: System MUST integrate with P-05 Aftercare Module (FR-011) by signalling treatment completion data; FR-011 handles aftercare plan creation and activation
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 978.

attrs.statement: System MUST expose RESTful API endpoints for treatment documentation CRUD operations (create treatment record, update progress, upload photos, complete treatment)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 979.

nodes.title: Provider suspension or deactivation handling for In Progress cases

attrs.statement: When a provider's suspension or deactivation becomes effective, System MUST cancel that provider's In Progress cases with cause `ProviderSuspended` or `ProviderDeactivated` and an independent `supportRequired` marker, block further provider documentation, preserve clinical notes/photos and any recorded completion milestone, and let an admin rehome the patient to a replacement provider in the same inquiry through the FR-006 Alternative Flow B5 transfer, without restoring the case on reactivation (Alternative Flow B5; FR-015 A5/Screen 4). Provider-requested Cancel/Close Case (B4) remains a non-transitioning admin notification.
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Conflicts with Rule 12, Alternative Flow B5, the edge case, REQ-010-029, REQ-010-031 and FR-006 REQ-006-015/019, which keep the In Progress case In Progress. The graph keeps this line verbatim and follows the stay-In-Progress reading elsewhere; see the product owner question. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 950.

nodes.title: Accepted snapshot is the only source of money and appointment data

attrs.statement: System MUST read price, currency, date range, appointment, and promotion only from the accepted snapshot reached through the booking's AcceptanceEvent, and MUST seed the case's treatment plan days, clinician set, and estimated graft count from the same snapshot; FR-010 MUST NOT read accepted data from live FR-004 records or edit the snapshot (Rule 14)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 951.

nodes.title: FR-010 is the only path for post-acceptance treatment-detail changes

attrs.statement: System MUST make FR-010 the only path for post-acceptance changes to treatment plan days, clinician set, and estimated graft count, blocked while the booking is `Accepted` and limited to the clinic (Owner, Manager, or Clinical Staff, from `Confirmed` until Check In) and admins (from `Confirmed` onward); each change MUST require a reason, be audited with before/after values, notify the patient through the FR-030 `treatment.plan_changed` event, leave the accepted snapshot unchanged, and never change money fields (Rule 13; Alternative Flow A2)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 952.

nodes.title: Plan days stored and displayed as relative day numbers only

attrs.statement: System MUST display and store treatment plan days as relative day numbers only, never as calendar dates (Rule 15)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 953.

nodes.title: Treating provider never reassigned in FR-010

attrs.statement: System MUST NOT reassign the treating provider in FR-010; provider withdrawal, drop-out, or replacement after acceptance MUST be handed to the FR-006 Alternative Flow B5 provider-fault transfer before Check In, and to the FR-006 Alternative Flow B7 admin decision while In Progress (Rule 16; Alternative Flow B6)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 954.

nodes.title: Admin Change Treatment Details screen from Confirmed onward

attrs.statement: System MUST give admins the Change Treatment Details screen (Screen 9) for any booking from `Confirmed` onward that is not `Cancelled`, with mandatory reason, a before and after confirmation step, a Treatment Detail Change record, an audit entry, and the `treatment.plan_changed` event; the clinic form follows the same rules but closes at Check In
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 955.

nodes.title: No manual setting of booking or case status in FR-010

attrs.statement: System MUST NOT let any user set a booking or case status by hand in FR-010; provider Cancel / Close Case requests and admin case closures resolve only through the FR-006 governed actions (change appointment, cancel booking, provider-fault transfer, In-Progress provider-fault decision)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 956.

nodes.title: Day-based progress synced to patient app and admin within 30 seconds

attrs.statement: System MUST sync day-based treatment progress (accepted Quote Option ID, current treatment day number, day description from the case's current treatment plan, seeded from that option's `QuoteOptionPlanDay` records in the accepted snapshot, and day status) to patient app and admin dashboard in real-time (within 30 seconds of provider update) for transparency into day-to-day treatment progress *(day statuses only — clinical notes are provider-only)*
attrs.rationale: Renumbered from the PRD id REQ-010-007A (ids are digits only). Renumbered from the PRD id REQ-010-007A (ids are digits only). Day statuses only; clinical notes stay provider-only. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 946.

nodes.title: Booking status moves Confirmed, In Progress, Aftercare, Completed with no skipping

attrs.statement: Booking status MUST transition through sequence: Confirmed → In Progress → Aftercare → Completed (no skipping stages). Exceptions: after a provider fault an admin may move an In Progress booking to Aftercare through the FR-006 In-Progress provider-fault decision (Rule 12), and an admin may cancel the booking from any non-terminal state through the FR-006 Cancel Booking action.
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 552.

nodes.title: Documentation starts only at Check In; record created at confirmation as Awaiting Check In

attrs.statement: Treatment documentation MUST be initiated by the "Check In" action from the Confirmed list (cannot pre-document treatments). The treatment record itself is created at booking confirmation (first successful payment) in status "Awaiting Check In", seeded from the accepted snapshot, so audited treatment-detail changes before Check In have a record to change
attrs.rationale: The record is created at booking confirmation, which the PRD places in the booking flow, so the rule also applies at the booking stage. The Check In gate itself is held by FR-006 REQ-006-043. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 553.

nodes.title: Timestamps recorded in UTC and shown in the provider's local timezone

attrs.statement: All timestamps (check-in, end of treatment) MUST be recorded in UTC and displayed in provider's local timezone
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 556.

nodes.title: At most one treatment In Progress per patient

attrs.statement: Maximum one treatment can be "In Progress" per patient at any time (prevents duplicate documentation)
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 558.

nodes.title: Plan days, clinician set and estimated graft count locked for providers after Check In

attrs.statement: Treatment Plan (per-day) day descriptions, the assigned clinician set, and the estimated graft count are LOCKED for providers once Check In is performed — providers cannot modify them mid-procedure. While the booking is `Accepted` (unpaid) they are locked for everyone. From `Confirmed` until Check In the clinic may change them, and from `Confirmed` onward an admin may change them, only through the treatment-detail change (Rule 13). Each change MUST carry a reason and MUST be captured in the audit trail (previous values preserved).
attrs.rationale: Source link names the stakeholder item the product owner decision log (reports/2026-10-16/mtg002-quote-model-decisions-2026-10-16.md, items M2 and Q2) refines. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 559.

nodes.title: Each treatment day is a discrete record

attrs.statement: Each treatment day is a discrete record — day records are NEVER consolidated into a single multi-day record
attrs.rationale: Repeated by the Screen 4 business rule on day independence. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 560.

nodes.title: Only five day statuses are valid

attrs.statement: Valid day statuses are: Not started | In progress | Finished | Need caution/attention | Cancelled/Deferred. No other statuses are permitted.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 and Screen 5 add that Pause is not a valid status and must not appear in the Status dropdown. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 561.

nodes.title: Provider Cancel or Close Case does not change status or trigger money actions

attrs.statement: The provider's Cancel / Close Case action does NOT auto-transition status or trigger financial actions. The admin resolves it only through the FR-006 governed actions (change appointment, cancel booking, or provider-fault transfer); no one sets a booking status by hand
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 562.

nodes.title: Suspension or deactivation leaves In Progress cases In Progress with a support marker

attrs.statement: An effective provider suspension/deactivation (FR-015 A5/Screen 4) does not cancel the provider's In Progress cases: each stays In Progress with cause `ProviderSuspended` or `ProviderDeactivated` and an independent `supportRequired` marker, and provider documentation is blocked (Alternative Flow B5). This cascade is distinct from Rule 11's provider-requested closure. Clinical notes, photos, head scan photo sets, and any already recorded completion milestone are preserved; an admin decides case by case through FR-006 Alternative Flow B7 to move the booking to Aftercare and reassign the aftercare provider through FR-011 Screen 19, or to cancel the booking. No replacement acceptance is created for an In Progress case. Reactivation never restores the provider's actions on the case.
attrs.rationale: Conflicts with REQ-010-025 (see the product owner question). Also stated in Alternative Flow B5 and the suspended-mid-treatment edge case; the edge case adds that a later deactivation does not overwrite an earlier ProviderSuspended cause. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 563.

nodes.title: Post-acceptance treatment-detail changes only through FR-010, with reason and audit

attrs.statement: After subquote acceptance, FR-010 is the only path for changing the treatment plan days, the assigned clinician set, and the estimated graft count. No change is allowed while the booking is `Accepted` (unpaid); changes are allowed only from `Confirmed`. Only the clinic (Owner, Manager, or Clinical Staff, from `Confirmed` until Check In) or an admin (from `Confirmed` onward) may make the change. Each change MUST record actor, role, reason, timestamp, and before/after values; MUST notify the patient through the FR-030 `treatment.plan_changed` event; MUST leave the accepted snapshot unchanged as the original record; and MUST NOT change price, currency, date range, appointment, or promotion (Alternative Flow A2). Admin changes use Screen 9.
attrs.rationale: Restates REQ-010-027 with more detail (who may change, what is recorded); possible duplicate within this FR. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 564.

nodes.title: Money and appointment baseline read only from the accepted snapshot

attrs.statement: Price, currency, date range, accepted appointment baseline, and promotion are read only from the accepted snapshot, reached through the FR-006 booking's AcceptanceEvent. The operative procedure date (Check In gate and displays) is the current FR-006 booking appointment, which equals the snapshot appointment unless an approved FR-006 admin date change applies. FR-010 never edits the snapshot or reads these values from live FR-004 records. The case's current treatment details are seeded from the same snapshot and then change only under Rule 13.
attrs.rationale: Restates REQ-010-026 and adds the operative procedure date; possible duplicate within this FR. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 565.

nodes.title: FR-010 never reassigns the treating provider; hand-off to FR-006 flows

attrs.statement: FR-010 never reassigns the treating provider. Provider withdrawal, drop-out, or replacement after acceptance and before Check In is handed to the FR-006 Alternative Flow B5 provider-fault transfer (Alternative Flow B6); after Check In it is handed to the FR-006 Alternative Flow B7 admin decision (move to Aftercare with an aftercare reassignment, or cancel), with no replacement acceptance. The B5 payment placeholder applies to the transfer: amounts already paid move with the patient as credit toward the replacement booking, any unused part is refunded, and the patient pays no cancellation fee.
attrs.rationale: Restates REQ-010-029 and adds the payment placeholder; possible duplicate within this FR. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 567.

nodes.title: Patient name and contact visible to provider only after payment

nodes.title: Treatment documentation retained at least 7 years

Patient must complete payment through the booking/payment flow (FR-007) before treatment documentation can start.
attrs.rationale: The blocking condition itself is held by FR-006 REQ-006-043 (see cross-FR duplicates). Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 604, 911, 921.

nodes.title: Early arrival: provider confirms early Check In; original appointment time kept

attrs.statement: Provider clicks Check In; system detects early arrival and displays confirmation prompt Outcome: Treatment proceeds earlier than scheduled; original appointment time preserved in booking record
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A1. The confirmation prompt text is in the flow step; the Outcome line is the second part. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 138, 143.

attrs.statement: Screen 9 validation: Current Treatment Plan Days: Days stay relative; no calendar dates; at least one day remains; days that already have a day status other than Not started cannot be removed Assigned Clinicians: At least one clinician remains; only clinicians on the treating provider's staff list Change Reason: Mandatory; 10 to 1000 characters Confirm Change: Enabled only when at least one value changed and the reason is valid
attrs.rationale: Estimated graft count range is held by the graft-count rule. The clinic form on Screen 4 follows the same rules. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 531, 532, 534, 537.

nodes.title: Admin treatment-detail change available from Confirmed, never while Accepted, Expired or Cancelled

attrs.statement: The admin may use this screen at any time from `Confirmed` onward, including after Check In, during `Aftercare`, and after `Completed`; it is never available while the booking is `Accepted`, `Payment Window Expired`, or `Cancelled`.
attrs.rationale: Applies on screen SCR-010-09. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 542.

nodes.title: Change saved only after the admin confirms the before and after summary

attrs.statement: The change is saved only after the admin confirms the before and after summary.
attrs.rationale: Applies on screen SCR-010-09. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 543.

nodes.title: Each saved change creates one Treatment Detail Change record and an audit entry

attrs.statement: Each saved change creates one Treatment Detail Change record (Entity 5) with actor, actor type, role, reason, timestamp, and before and after values, and adds an audit trail entry.
attrs.rationale: Applies on screen SCR-010-09. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 544.

nodes.title: Patient no-show: Cancel or Close Case notifies admin; booking stays Confirmed

attrs.statement: Provider clicks Cancel/Close Case; selects reason: No-show; adds note System notifies admin; the booking stays Confirmed. The admin rebooks through the FR-006 Change Appointment action (FR-006 Screen 8) or cancels through the FR-006 Cancel Booking action (FR-006 Screen 9); deposit retention follows the FR-006 payment placeholder. No-Show is an admin-managed case label, not a system-defined booking pipeline status
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B1. The flow header says financial penalties are applied per cancellation policy, which step 6 does not support (product owner question). Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 176, 177.

nodes.title: Medical postponement: Cancel or Close Case notifies admin; booking stays Confirmed

attrs.statement: Provider selects reason: Medical postponement; documents the condition and clearance requirements System notifies admin; the booking stays Confirmed. The admin reschedules through the FR-006 Change Appointment action (FR-006 Screen 8) with no financial penalty, or cancels through the FR-006 Cancel Booking action (FR-006 Screen 9). Note: 'Postponed' is an admin-managed case label, not a system-defined booking pipeline status
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B2. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 189, 190.

nodes.title: Interrupted treatment: reason in day note; case stays In Progress until admin acts

attrs.statement: Provider documents interruption reason in the affected day's note field Provider sets day status to Cancelled/Deferred; clicks Cancel/Close Case; documents reason System notifies admin; the case stays In Progress until the admin acts. The admin lets the case resume later, changes treatment details through Screen 9, or cancels the booking through the FR-006 Cancel Booking action (FR-006 Screen 9); financial reconciliation follows the FR-006 payment placeholder
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B3. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 201, 204, 205.

nodes.title: Provider closes an In Progress case with a reason; admin notified

attrs.statement: Provider clicks Cancel/Close Case; selects closure reason from list (No-show, Patient cancellation, Medical, Operational, Other); adds free-text note System sends notification to admin with reason and note
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B4. Closure is resolved through the FR-006 Cancel Booking action or the In-Progress provider-fault decision. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 216, 217.

nodes.title: Provider documentation blocked and records read-only after a provider status cascade

attrs.statement: Provider documentation actions (day edits, End Treatment) are blocked; day records, clinical notes, photos, head scan photo sets, and any already recorded completion milestone are retained read-only Patient/admin notifications per FR-015 Screen 4 and FR-030; the patient is told an admin will contact them about the next step
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B5; overlaps Rule 12, possible duplicate within this FR. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 231, 232.

nodes.title: Provider fault before Check In: documentation blocked, records retained read-only

attrs.statement: FR-006 cancels the booking with cause ProviderFault; provider documentation on this case is blocked; day records, notes, photos, and head scan photo sets are retained read-only
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B6. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 246.

nodes.title: Replacement booking reads money and seeds treatment details from the replacement acceptance

attrs.statement: Patient and admin are notified through FR-006 Alternative Flow B5 (booking.provider_fault_replacement); the replacement provider learns through quote.accepted and the patient receives booking.scheduled; the replacement booking follows the FR-006 main flow; its FR-010 case reads its money fields and seeds its treatment details from the replacement acceptance snapshot
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B6. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 248.

nodes.title: Saved End of Treatment is final for the provider; adjustments go through admin and FR-011

attrs.statement: Once saved, the provider cannot return to edit In Progress documentation — an audit snapshot is captured. Provider cannot edit completed treatment record; aftercare template selection and plan activation are handled entirely by FR-011. If adjustments are needed, provider contacts admin; admin can modify the aftercare plan through FR-011's admin interface; audit trail logs admin intervention.
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 442, 932.

nodes.title: Actual graft count is the definitive record; estimates preserved

attrs.statement: Actual graft count is the definitive record; the current estimated graft count, and the original estimate in the accepted snapshot, are preserved for reference and audit.
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 443.

nodes.title: Completion blocked until the final head scan is stored; photos queue when storage is down

attrs.statement: Media files (head scan photo sets and treatment photos) queued locally on provider device with status "Pending Upload"; background process retries upload every 5 minutes; provider sees upload progress indicator; treatment completion blocked until all required uploads (final head scan photo set) are successfully stored — optional treatment photos may remain queued without blocking completion. Error handling: If upload fails, photos queued locally; retry with exponential backoff; provider notified of pending uploads
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 757, 917.

nodes.title: If the FR-011 signal fails, treatment stays complete and admin triggers aftercare

attrs.statement: If signal to FR-011 fails, treatment still marked complete in FR-010, but admin notified to manually trigger aftercare setup in FR-011
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 767.

nodes.title: Admin may edit treatment documentation except snapshot, money fields and provider

attrs.statement: Admin has full edit access to treatment documentation fields as confirmed in client requirements, except the accepted snapshot, the money fields read from it (price, currency, date range, appointment, promotion), and the treating provider, which are read-only in FR-010.
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 507.

nodes.title: Admin edits logged with admin identity and a reason

attrs.statement: All edits by admin are logged in the audit trail with timestamp and admin identity; admin MUST provide a reason for each edit (stored alongside before/after values).
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 510.

nodes.title: Admin can trigger End Treatment on behalf of the provider

attrs.statement: Admin can trigger End Treatment on behalf of a provider; the End of Treatment modal collects the same required fields as Screen 6.
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 513.

nodes.title: Admin may correct provider clinical notes for legal or compliance reasons, always logged

attrs.statement: Editing provider clinical notes by admin is permitted for legal or compliance corrections and is always logged.
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 515.

nodes.title: Admin remove means archive or soft-delete only, restorable

attrs.statement: Admin “remove” actions are archive/soft-delete only (no hard delete) for treatment documentation or media assets; archived items remain retained per policy and are restorable.
attrs.rationale: Overlaps the hard-delete ban in the Audit Rule; possible duplicate within this FR. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 516.

nodes.title: No automatic financial resolution on case cancellation

attrs.statement: Case cancellation is performed by an admin through the FR-006 Cancel Booking action; financial reconciliation follows the FR-006 payment placeholder and the platform does not perform automatic financial resolution.
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 514.

nodes.title: Auto-saved state restored when the provider reopens the record

attrs.statement: Auto-save mechanism persists all field changes every 2 minutes to server; when provider re-opens treatment record, last auto-saved state restored; provider can continue from where they left off.
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 913.

nodes.title: Optimistic locking: second saver is warned before overwriting

attrs.statement: System implements optimistic locking: first provider to save changes succeeds; second provider receives warning "Another user has modified this treatment record. Reload to see latest version?" with option to review changes before overwriting.
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 915.

nodes.title: Reminders at 12 and 24 hours; admin dashboard flags Overdue Documentation

attrs.statement: System sends reminder notification to provider 12 hours after Check In if treatment still "In Progress"; second reminder at 24 hours; admin dashboard flags treatments "In Progress" > 24 hours as "Overdue Documentation" for manual follow-up.
attrs.rationale: Overlaps REQ-010-010; the fixed 12 and 24 hour values sit beside a configurable deadline (product owner question). Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 919.

nodes.title: If real-time sync fails, viewers see the last known status with a last-updated indicator

attrs.statement: If real-time sync fails, queue update for retry; patient/admin see last known day status with "last updated [time] ago" indicator
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 752.

nodes.title: Notification failure does not block the treatment workflow

attrs.statement: If notification fails, queue for retry; notifications are informational, not critical to treatment workflow
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 762.

nodes.title: Patient consent for photo storage and use is obtained during booking

attrs.statement: Treatment documentation must comply with HIPAA-equivalent standards (access controls, audit trails, encryption); patient consent obtained during booking for photo storage and usage
attrs.rationale: The whole Compliance line is kept because the consent clause is part of the same sentence as the HIPAA-equivalent requirement. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 784.

attrs.statement: status ("Awaiting Check In", "In Progress", "Completed", "Cancelled"; the record is created with status "Awaiting Check In" when the booking becomes `Confirmed`, seeded from the accepted snapshot, so treatment-detail changes before Check In have a record to change; Check In sets "In Progress"; saving End Treatment sets "Completed"; "Cancelled" is set when the booking is cancelled through the FR-006 Cancel Booking action, the provider-status cascade (before Check In), or the provider-fault transfer; when an admin moves an In Progress booking to Aftercare after a provider fault (FR-006 Alternative Flow B7), the record keeps what was documented and provider documentation stays blocked; cause and `supportRequired` are held on the booking
attrs.rationale: From Key Entities, Entity 1. Overlaps Rule 2 on record creation; possible duplicate within this FR. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 986.

nodes.title: Progress summary and current day status calculated from day statuses

attrs.statement: Overall Progress: Summary of treatment completion (e.g., "2 of 3 days complete") (Display only; auto-calculated from day statuses) Days Status Summary: Completion summary e.g., "2 / 3 days complete" Current Day Status: Status of the most recent active day
attrs.rationale: Screens SCR-010-01, SCR-010-03 and SCR-010-07. How the most recent active day is chosen is not stated. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 275, 330, 331.

nodes.title: Plan day position shown as a relative position, never a calendar date

attrs.statement: Plan Day Position: Relative position of this day in the treatment plan (e.g., "Day 2 of 4") (Display only; relative day number only, never converted to or shown as a calendar date)
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 298.

nodes.title: Provider In Progress listing: own clinic only, live search and filters, sorted by procedure date

attrs.statement: List shows only cases in "In Progress" status for the provider's clinic. Search and filters apply in real-time without page reload. Default sort: procedure date ascending.
attrs.rationale: Screen SCR-010-03. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 335, 337, 338.

nodes.title: Admin In Progress listing: all providers, opens the case in editable mode

attrs.statement: Admin listing shows all providers' In Progress cases — platform-wide visibility. Clicking a row or the Action button opens Screen 8: In Progress Case Detail in editable mode. Default sort: procedure date ascending.
attrs.rationale: Screen SCR-010-07. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 472, 473, 474.

nodes.title: End Treatment enabled only when every day record is in a terminal status

attrs.statement: The "End Treatment" button is enabled only when ALL day records are in a terminal status (Finished, Need caution/attention, or Cancelled/Deferred). Days remaining in "Not started" or "In progress" block the button. This modal is accessible only after all day records are in terminal status.
attrs.rationale: Screens SCR-010-04 and SCR-010-06. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 386, 438.

nodes.title: Provider may reopen Day Edit at any time while the case is In Progress

attrs.statement: Provider may return to this modal at any time while the case is In Progress.
attrs.rationale: Screen SCR-010-05. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 413.

attrs.statement: System MUST support treatment-linked and standalone aftercare activation paths

nodes.title: Patients complete milestone tasks with reminders and quality validation

attrs.statement: Patients MUST be able to complete milestone tasks (scan uploads, questionnaires) with reminders and quality validation

nodes.title: Providers configure and activate plans from templates

attrs.statement: Providers MUST be able to configure and activate aftercare plans with template customization

nodes.title: Admin oversees cases, reassigns and overrides plans with audit

attrs.statement: Admin MUST be able to oversee cases, reassign providers, and override plans with full audit

nodes.title: Milestones, tasks, progress and adherence tracked as entities

attrs.statement: System MUST track milestones, tasks, progress, and adherence as structured entities

nodes.title: Aftercare artifacts retained per retention policy

attrs.statement: System MUST retain all aftercare artifacts (scans, questionnaires, communications) per retention policy
attrs.rationale: The periods are stated in Data and Privacy Rule 1 (see the retention rule).

attrs.statement: Progress MUST be derived deterministically from plan and task completion
attrs.rationale: The formula is stated in Milestone and Task Rule 3 and on Screen 1. Workflow 3 step 4 lists further inputs; see the open question on progress inputs.

nodes.title: Aftercare data encrypted in transit and at rest

attrs.statement: All aftercare data MUST be encrypted in transit and at rest
attrs.rationale: Restated by Data and Privacy Rule 3 and Security Considerations (Data Encryption).

attrs.statement: Access MUST be role-based (patient, provider, admin) and fully audited
attrs.rationale: Restated by Security Considerations (Access Control, Audit Logging).

attrs.statement: PII visibility MUST follow payment-confirmation policy and admin exemptions
attrs.rationale: Detail in General Module Rule 3 and Data and Privacy Rule 2.

nodes.title: Notification Service for reminders and alerts

attrs.statement: System MUST integrate with Notification Service for reminders/alerts
attrs.rationale: Cross-FR: notification delivery is owned by FR-020 (Dependencies, prd.md lines 1477-1479).

nodes.title: Media stored in secure storage with controlled access

attrs.statement: System MUST store media artifacts in secure storage with controlled access
attrs.rationale: Restated by Data and Privacy Rule 3 (scan media stored securely with access controls).

attrs.statement: System MUST reference questionnaires managed in FR-025 for aftercare context
attrs.rationale: Restated on Screens 3, 10 and 16; content ownership stays with FR-025.

nodes.title: Provider suspension or deactivation does not cancel standalone aftercare

attrs.statement: When a provider's suspension or deactivation becomes effective, System MUST NOT cancel that provider's non-terminal standalone aftercare cases; it MUST record cause `ProviderSuspended` or `ProviderDeactivated` and an independent `supportRequired` marker and route them to Screen 19 reassignment (treatment-linked cases follow REQ-011-015), retain the completion milestone and aftercare records, and route recovery continuity to admins for resolution through the existing reassignment/recovery workflow, without automatic reassignment or restoration on reactivation (Workflow 4 D4; FR-015 A5/Screen 4)
attrs.rationale: Restated by Workflow 4 D4, General Module Rule 4 and the mid-aftercare suspension edge case. The treatment-linked behaviour is stated in D4 and Rule 4 and recorded as its own Rule.

nodes.title: Admin reassigns aftercare provider or team on Screen 19

attrs.statement: System MUST let an admin reassign the aftercare provider or team on Screen 19 with a mandatory reason, confirmation, audit entry, and the mandatory `aftercare.provider_reassigned` notice to the patient and the new aftercare provider or assigned team member (no admin alert); for a treatment-linked case the booking MUST stay `Aftercare` and the treatment record MUST stay unchanged, with no new quote, acceptance, or payment
attrs.rationale: Restated by Workflow 4 D5 and the Screen 19 business rules.

nodes.title: Aftercare has exactly two entry routes

attrs.statement: Aftercare has exactly two entry routes: treatment-linked aftercare (starts from the patient's accepted Hairline quote whose treatment was performed, covering the Workflow 1 setup and the Workflow 2b post-treatment add-on bought within 90 days) and standalone aftercare (bought directly by patients treated at an outside clinic, with no inquiry or quote). Admin assignment is a step inside these routes, not a separate route.
attrs.rationale: Entry Points, prd.md line 64 onward.

nodes.title: Treatment-linked aftercare activates automatically at treatment completion

attrs.statement: Treatment-linked aftercare activates automatically upon treatment completion.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 1. Workflow 1 step 1: the provider marks the treatment completed, the system moves the patient status to Aftercare and prompts the provider to configure the aftercare plan. The booking transition itself is owned by FR-006.

nodes.title: Standalone aftercare requires payment before activation

attrs.statement: Standalone aftercare requires payment before activation. Payment is required before service activation for both standalone and post-treatment add-on aftercare.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 1 and Payment Rule 4 (payment timing).

nodes.title: Admin can manually activate aftercare for special cases

attrs.statement: Admin can manually activate aftercare for special cases.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 1.

nodes.title: Standard duration 6-12 months, extensions need provider and admin approval

attrs.statement: Standard aftercare duration is 6-12 months, determined by treatment type and complexity. Extensions require provider and admin approval.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 2.

nodes.title: Data access limited by role: own, assigned, all

attrs.statement: Patients can only access their own aftercare data. Providers can only access assigned patients. Admin has full access to all aftercare data.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 3 and Data Access Rule 2; repeated on Screens 8, 9 and 12 (provider sees only assigned patients).

nodes.title: Patient data anonymized until payment confirmation

attrs.statement: Patient data is anonymized until payment confirmation; patient anonymization is lifted after payment confirmation. Anonymization rules do not apply to admin.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 3 and Data Access Rule 2; Screen 14 business rules. Screens 8 and 9 state that provider-visible patient details are fully visible because aftercare occurs after payment confirmation.

nodes.title: Milestones progress by time, cannot be skipped, need all tasks done

attrs.statement: Milestones progress automatically based on time elapsed. Patients cannot skip milestones. Milestone completion requires all tasks completed.
attrs.rationale: Milestone and Task Rule 1.

attrs.statement: Scan uploads must meet the quality threshold. Questionnaires must be completed in full. Medication adherence is tracked but not mandatory for milestone completion.
attrs.rationale: Milestone and Task Rule 2; Screen 2 (minimum quality threshold) and Screen 3 (all required fields) business rules.

attrs.statement: Overdue tasks trigger escalation after 48 hours.
attrs.rationale: Milestone and Task Rule 2. Workflow 3 C1 and the overdue flag use 24 hours; see the open question on overdue timing.

nodes.title: Missed task: reminder, Overdue flag after 24 hours, team contacts patient

attrs.statement: When a patient misses a scheduled task, the system sends a reminder notification; after 24 hours the system flags the task as Overdue and the aftercare team contacts the patient.
attrs.rationale: Workflow 3 alternative flow C1.

nodes.title: Progress is completed tasks over total tasks, equally weighted, real time

attrs.statement: Progress = (completed tasks / total tasks) * 100. Tasks are weighted equally. Progress updates in real time.
attrs.rationale: Milestone and Task Rule 3; Screen 1 business rules add that tasks include scan uploads, questionnaires and medication adherence. Workflow 3 step 4 lists milestone completion, task completion and compliance rates as inputs; see the open question on progress inputs.

nodes.title: Concerning responses flag the case Urgent and trigger escalation

attrs.statement: When a patient reports concerning symptoms or a questionnaire response triggers the urgent flag per milestone rules, the system flags the case as Urgent, the aftercare team immediately contacts the patient and the escalation workflow is triggered.
attrs.rationale: Workflow 3 alternative flow C2; Screen 3 business rules (urgent flag raised immediately in real-time validation).

nodes.title: Patient contact 24/7 with 2-hour urgent and 24-hour standard response

attrs.statement: Patients can contact the aftercare team 24/7. Urgent cases receive priority response within 2 hours. Standard cases receive a response within 24 hours.
attrs.rationale: Communication Rule 1.

nodes.title: Provider and aftercare team communication, immediate escalation response, audit logging

attrs.statement: Providers can communicate with the aftercare team about assigned cases. Escalations require immediate response. All communications are logged for audit.
attrs.rationale: Communication Rule 2; Screen 14 (all communications monitored and logged).

nodes.title: Admin communicates with any stakeholder, announcements, emergency bypass

attrs.statement: Admin can communicate with any stakeholder. System-wide announcements are sent to all relevant parties. Emergency communications bypass normal channels.
attrs.rationale: Communication Rule 3.

nodes.title: Retention periods: 7 years data, 2 years scan media, 3 years communication logs

attrs.statement: Aftercare data is retained for 7 years minimum. Scan media is retained for 2 years after aftercare completion. Communication logs are retained for 3 years.
attrs.rationale: Data Retention Rule 1.

nodes.title: Admin access and access attempts logged for audit

attrs.statement: Admin access is logged for the audit trail. Access attempts are logged and monitored.
attrs.rationale: Data Access Rule 2 and Data Security Rule 3.

nodes.title: Admin can edit all aftercare data and override calculated progress

attrs.statement: Admin can edit ALL aftercare data in the system, modify any provider's aftercare plans, change patient assignments and providers, and override any system-calculated progress.
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability Rule 1; Workflow 4 step 2; Screens 8, 13 and 14 (full editability, admin override).

nodes.title: Admin edit capabilities by data area

attrs.statement: Admin can edit aftercare plans (templates, milestones, medications, instructions), patient data (patient information, treatment details, contact info), provider data (assignments, customizations, settings), progress data (progress calculations, milestone completions), communication data (messages, escalations, notifications) and template data (milestone templates, questionnaires, resources).
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability Rule 2. Editing messages and escalations conflicts with immutable communication logs; see the open question on admin edits to logged data.

nodes.title: Admin edits logged with reason, history kept, parties notified

attrs.statement: All admin edits are logged with timestamp and admin identification. A change reason is required for all modifications. Edit history is maintained for the audit trail. Provider and patient are notified of significant changes.
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability Rule 3; Screen 11 business rules.

attrs.statement: Refunds are processed automatically for rejected requests. Rejection requires a reason and triggers a refund.
attrs.rationale: Payment Rule 1; Screens 7 and 15 business rules; Workflow 2 alternative flow B2. Money movement is executed through FR-007.

nodes.title: Payment disputes handled by admin team

attrs.statement: Payment disputes are handled by the admin team.
attrs.rationale: Payment Rule 1.

nodes.title: Provider compensation for aftercare participation, paid monthly

attrs.statement: Providers are compensated for aftercare participation. Compensation is based on case complexity and duration. Payment is processed monthly.
attrs.rationale: Provider Compensation, Payment Rule 2; Workflow 1 A2 (provider receives compensation when the Hairline aftercare team takes over).

attrs.statement: Platform commission is deducted from standalone aftercare payments. The commission rate is 15-25% (configurable). Commission is calculated at time of payment.
attrs.rationale: Platform Commission, Payment Rule 3. Screen 7 shows a Platform Fee of 15-25% to the patient; see the open question on commission versus patient fee.

nodes.title: Templates define their own pricing, per currency, in local currency

attrs.statement: Each aftercare template defines its own pricing (fixed, subscription, or both) in Screen 16. Pricing is configured per currency, and the patient sees the price in local currency based on location.
attrs.rationale: Payment Rule 4 (template-based pricing, multi-currency); Screen 6 and Screen 16 business rules (purchasable templates require pricing for all supported currencies; real-time exchange rates are a baseline with admin override).

nodes.title: Patient chooses fixed or subscription when template offers both

attrs.statement: If a template offers both fixed and subscription pricing, the patient chooses at purchase time.
attrs.rationale: Payment Rule 4; Screens 6 and 16.

nodes.title: Subscription charged monthly, first payment immediate

attrs.statement: Subscription payments are monthly installments charged automatically for the template duration; the first payment is immediate and subsequent payments fall on the monthly anniversary. Total subscription amount = monthly price x template duration in months.
attrs.rationale: Payment Rule 4; Screens 7 and 16.

nodes.title: Post-treatment add-on only within 90 days of Hairline treatment completion

attrs.statement: The post-treatment add-on is available only to Hairline-treated patients within 90 days of treatment completion; the system verifies a completed Hairline treatment within 90 days and auto-populates treatment information from the patient's treatment history.
attrs.rationale: Payment Rule 4; Screen 6; Workflow 2b step 1.

nodes.title: Standalone service available to all patients

attrs.statement: The standalone service is available to all patients regardless of treatment source.
attrs.rationale: Payment Rule 4.

nodes.title: Only templates marked Available for Purchase shown, filtered by treatment type

attrs.statement: Only templates marked "Available for Purchase" are shown, filtered by treatment type compatibility. Templates can be marked "Internal Use Only" (providers only) or "Available for Purchase" (standalone and add-on). The template name is used as the service name for patient-facing display.
attrs.rationale: Payment Rule 4; Screens 6 and 16.

attrs.statement: Patients are locked into the price at the time of purchase; future template price changes do not affect existing patients. Pricing changes to active templates require admin approval.
attrs.rationale: Payment Rule 4 (pricing immutability); Screen 16 business rules.

nodes.title: Paid standalone request goes to Pending Assignment, admin assigns provider

attrs.statement: After a successful payment the standalone request moves to Pending Assignment and appears in the admin dashboard (Screen 15); the admin reviews patient information and treatment details, assigns a suitable provider based on specialization and availability, and the system notifies the assigned provider.
attrs.rationale: Workflow 2 steps 2-3; Screen 15 business rules.

nodes.title: Assigned provider selects template, customizes and activates; patient onboarded

attrs.statement: The assigned provider reviews the patient case, selects the aftercare template (the purchased one or an alternative), customizes the plan and activates it; the patient receives an activation notification and gains access to the aftercare dashboard (Screen 1) and the aftercare team begins monitoring.
attrs.rationale: Workflow 2 steps 4-5 and Workflow 2b steps 4-5. The PRD order is pay, then admin assigns, then provider configures; SRC-MTG-001-W03 lists assign and configure before payment; see the open question on the standalone sequence.

nodes.title: Failed payment can retry; request expires after 48 hours unpaid

attrs.statement: When payment fails the patient receives a failure notification and can retry with a different payment method; the request expires after 48 hours without successful payment.
attrs.rationale: Workflow 2 alternative B1, Workflow 2b B1b; Screen 7 business rules (failed payments allow retry). Screen 15 separately says requests expire after 7 days if not assigned.

nodes.title: Admin rejection marks request Not suitable and notifies patient with reason

attrs.statement: When the admin rejects a request, the admin marks it "Not suitable for aftercare" with a required reason and the patient receives a rejection notification with the reason.
attrs.rationale: Workflow 2 alternative B2; Screen 15. Refund is a separate rule.

nodes.title: No available provider: Awaiting provider availability, admin assigns manually

attrs.statement: When no suitable provider is available, the admin marks the request "Awaiting provider availability", the patient is notified of the delay and the admin manually assigns when a provider becomes available.
attrs.rationale: Workflow 2 alternative B3.

nodes.title: Unassigned standalone requests expire after 7 days

attrs.statement: Requests expire after 7 days if not assigned.
attrs.rationale: Screen 15 business rules. The effect on a paid request is not stated; see the open question on expiry.

nodes.title: Add-on assigned automatically after payment: original provider or Hairline team

attrs.statement: Payment confirmation of a post-treatment add-on triggers automatic assignment: the system assigns the original treatment provider if the provider participates in aftercare, otherwise the Hairline aftercare team; the patient is notified of the provider assignment and the assigned provider receives a notification.
attrs.rationale: Workflow 2b step 3 and alternative B1a.

nodes.title: Provider marks completion, configures plan from admin-created template

attrs.statement: After the provider marks the treatment completed, the provider selects an admin-created milestone template, adds patient-specific instructions and post-operative medications (name, dosage, frequency, special instructions), may modify milestone durations and confirms the plan; the system then generates the plan with milestones, creates the patient aftercare dashboard, sends an activation notification to the patient and sends the aftercare team a case assignment notification.
attrs.rationale: Workflow 1 steps 1-4; Screen 10 business rules.

nodes.title: Paperwork-only aftercare: instructions delivered, no monitoring

attrs.statement: When the provider marks "Paperwork only - no aftercare service" and uploads an aftercare instructions document, the patient receives the instructions but no active monitoring, and the patient status moves to Completed after instruction delivery.
attrs.rationale: Workflow 1 alternative A1.

nodes.title: Provider may hand aftercare to the Hairline aftercare team

attrs.statement: When the provider marks "Assign to Hairline aftercare team", the admin receives a notification for aftercare assignment, the Hairline aftercare team takes over patient monitoring and the provider receives compensation for aftercare participation.
attrs.rationale: Workflow 1 alternative A2.

nodes.title: System sends reminders for upcoming tasks and missed doses

attrs.statement: The system sends notifications for upcoming tasks (scan or photo set, questionnaire), scan and questionnaire reminders, and reminder notifications for missed medication doses.
attrs.rationale: Workflow 3 steps 1-3; Screen 4 business rules.

attrs.statement: The scan is validated for quality with real-time feedback and may be retaken when quality is below the threshold; maximum file size is 50MB; multiple scans within a milestone are supported per the configured scan schedule with one upload allowed per scheduled instance; the stored scan is made available to the aftercare team and previous scans remain accessible for comparison.
attrs.rationale: Workflow 3 step 2; Screen 2 business rules (V1 head scan photo sets; true 3D scanning is V2).

attrs.statement: All required questionnaire fields must be completed before submission. Drafts are saved automatically every 30 seconds. One submission per questionnaire is allowed. The aftercare team reviews responses.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 business rules; Workflow 3 step 3. Questionnaire content is owned by FR-025.

attrs.statement: Medications are prescribed by the provider during aftercare setup. Adherence = (taken doses / total doses) * 100. A dose is shown as missed if not taken within 2 hours, and Mark as Taken is enabled when the dose time is reached. History is available for the entire aftercare period.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 business rules and field validation.

nodes.title: Educational resources are milestone-specific and viewing is tracked

attrs.statement: Educational resources are specific to the current milestone, viewing progress is tracked for compliance, resources remain accessible throughout aftercare and new resources added by admin appear automatically.
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 business rules.

attrs.statement: Payment is processed through FR-007 with multiple payment methods (credit or debit cards, PayPal, local payment methods) and PCI-compliant processing; terms and privacy policy must be accepted; payment confirmation triggers the aftercare request workflow (Workflow 2 or 2b) and a confirmation email. Card number, expiry, CVV, cardholder name and billing address are entered in the payment form and are not stored by FR-011.
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 business rules and fields. Payment processing is owned by FR-007.

nodes.title: Provider list limited to assigned patients with overdue indicator

attrs.statement: The provider case list shows only patients assigned to this provider, with overdue cases shown with amber indicators; progress is calculated automatically by the system.
attrs.rationale: Screens 8 and 12 business rules.

nodes.title: Case details keep full history for Hairline-treated and standalone cases

attrs.statement: The provider case details screen displays all historical data from the patient's entire journey without removing older data: for Hairline-treated patients the complete lifecycle (inquiry, quote, treatment details, aftercare), for standalone patients only aftercare data and the intake information from the request. All activities are logged with timestamps, the provider can modify the plan only for assigned patients and an escalation creates an audit trail.
attrs.rationale: Screen 9 business rules.

nodes.title: Setup wizard needs all steps; admin can edit after activation

attrs.statement: All setup steps must be completed before activation, the provider can go back to previous steps, the system validates all required fields, the admin can edit any step after activation and the patient receives a notification upon activation.
attrs.rationale: Screen 10 business rules.

nodes.title: Plan edits are logged; major changes need admin approval

attrs.statement: Provider changes are logged and tracked, admin changes override provider settings, major changes require admin approval, all changes are logged with reason and timestamp, the patient is notified of approved changes and change history is maintained for the audit trail.
attrs.rationale: Screen 11 business rules.

nodes.title: Admin list shows all cases, overdue amber, actions logged

attrs.statement: The admin case list shows all aftercare cases across all providers, any case data is editable, overdue cases are shown with amber indicators, progress is calculated automatically and all actions are logged for the audit trail.
attrs.rationale: Screens 13 and 14 business rules.

nodes.title: Provider assignment based on specialization and availability

attrs.statement: Provider assignment is based on specialization and availability; the admin sees available providers with name, specialization and availability.
attrs.rationale: Screen 15 business rules and fields.

nodes.title: Template lifecycle: not deletable in use, approval for active changes, tested first

attrs.statement: Templates cannot be deleted if in use, changes to active templates require approval, new templates must be tested before activation and resource files are limited to 100MB each.
attrs.rationale: Screen 16 business rules.

nodes.title: Questionnaire sets selected per milestone from FR-025 Aftercare context

attrs.statement: Screen 16 selects among existing Questionnaire Sets and configures schedule and frequency per milestone; each milestone independently selects one Questionnaire Set; only sets with context type Aftercare are surfaced, plus multi-context sets flagged as compatible. Sets and questions are not authored in FR-011.
attrs.rationale: Screen 16 business rules; content ownership is FR-025.

attrs.statement: When a provider withdraws from aftercare, the admin receives a notification and reviews the case, and can reassign it to another suitable provider, assign it to the Hairline internal aftercare team or mark the aftercare as cancelled with a reason; all changes are logged and the patient is notified of the new arrangement or cancellation.
attrs.rationale: Workflow 4 alternative D1. Provider performance reassignment (D2) and template and process updates (D3) are admin actions covered by the admin override and reassignment rules.

nodes.title: Treatment-linked cases are not cancelled on provider suspension or deactivation

attrs.statement: For treatment-linked cases the aftercare case is not cancelled and the booking stays Aftercare when the assigned provider is suspended or deactivated; the cause and the supportRequired marker are recorded and an admin reassigns the aftercare provider or team on Screen 19.
attrs.rationale: Workflow 4 D4 and D5, General Module Rule 4. The standalone behaviour is REQ-011-014.

nodes.title: Suspension and withdrawal handling keeps records read-only and removes provider actions

attrs.statement: On provider suspension, deactivation or reassignment the provider loses aftercare actions on the case; the completion milestone, plan, milestones, scans, questionnaire responses, medications and communication history are retained read-only; the cancellation is not a patient cancellation or a provider withdrawal; a later deactivation does not overwrite an earlier ProviderSuspended cause; no refund occurs automatically.
attrs.rationale: Workflow 4 D4 and D5; General Module Rule 4.

nodes.title: Reassignment keeps the case and the previous provider read-only history

attrs.statement: A reassignment changes only the aftercare provider or team; the plan, milestones, scans, questionnaire responses, medications and communication history stay with the case, the new assignee gets the aftercare actions from the moment of confirmation, the previous provider loses them and keeps read-only access to history it recorded, and money effects, if any, follow the FR-006 payment placeholder.
attrs.rationale: Workflow 4 D5 and Screen 19 business rules.

nodes.title: Reassignment saved only after confirmation, with audit and optional marker resolution

attrs.statement: The reassignment is saved only after confirmation, is recorded in the audit trail with admin identity, timestamp, reason, previous assignee and new assignee and, when selected, records the audited resolution of the supportRequired marker; the new provider must be an Active provider other than the current one; the reason is 10 to 1000 characters.
attrs.rationale: Screen 19 fields and business rules.

attrs.statement: Provider performance scores are calculated monthly, poor performance triggers a review process, provider suspension requires admin approval and performance data is retained for 2 years.
attrs.rationale: Screen 17 business rules. The screen is Backlog (post-MVP analytics).

nodes.title: Admin progress overview updates in real time, metrics daily (backlog)

attrs.statement: The admin progress overview shows all cases across all providers with real-time updates, performance metrics calculated daily, alerts generated automatically for issues and all actions logged with admin identification.
attrs.rationale: Screen 18 business rules. The screen is Backlog (post-MVP analytics).

nodes.title: Scan media is V1 photo sets

attrs.statement: In V1 all references to 3D scans in this FR refer to standardized head scan photo sets (multiple 2D views); true 3D scanning (ARKit/ARCore) is deferred to V2.
attrs.rationale: Executive Summary note on scan media.

nodes.title: Out of scope: patient and provider chat, payment flows beyond activation

attrs.statement: Direct patient to provider chat is out of scope (FR-012 backlog) and payment flows beyond standalone activation are out of scope (Payment FR).
attrs.rationale: Communication Structure, Out of Scope.

nodes.title: Admin Communication Monitoring Center with simultaneous filters

nodes.title: Admin Message Thread View with monitoring and emergency states

nodes.title: Real-time message notifications and unread badge updates

nodes.title: Complete conversation history with timestamps and read receipts

nodes.title: Message lifecycle events and emergency interventions logged for audit

nodes.title: Admins flag conversations manually with flag type and optional notes

nodes.title: Conversation metadata kept per patient-provider pair and searchable

nodes.title: Attachments stored securely with access controls and metadata

nodes.title: Messaging enabled only after the provider sent a quote

attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary, prd.md line 956.

nodes.title: Messages and media encrypted in transit and at rest, access by role

nodes.title: Medical communications retained at least 7 years with audit export

nodes.title: Admin monitoring access to all conversations; intervention emergency-only

nodes.title: Intervention restricted to authorized admin roles; frequency under 5 percent

nodes.title: Quote submission creates or updates the conversation

nodes.title: Message events alert through the Notification Service; manual flags never notify

nodes.title: Attachments use the Media Storage Service with secure retrieval

nodes.title: Eligible patients submit reviews with ratings, feedback and photos

attrs.rationale: Restated by the Executive Summary, Main Flow steps 1 and 2 and Screen 1. General Module Rules: "Eligibility check required: only patients with a completed procedure may review."

nodes.title: Review needs 3 months since completion; one review per procedure

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce time gating (≥ 3 months) and single review per completed procedure.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Module Scope, Entry Points, Main Flow prerequisites and General Module Rules ("Time gating: review invitation and entry allowed ≥ 3 months post-procedure."). Change Log 1.13 records the 3-month gate as a product-owner additional requirement that needs no client-transcription evidence.

nodes.title: Reviews publish immediately; no pre-publication moderation

attrs.statement: System MUST publish reviews immediately upon patient submission (no pre-publication moderation gate).
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Executive Summary, the Main Flow outcome, Screen 1 rules ("The save action persists the current review payload and immediately publishes valid patient submissions.") and Screen 2 rules (Submitted is not a review status in V1). Change Log 1.2 records the removal of the moderation gate.

nodes.title: Patient submitted-review list and review detail across cases

attrs.statement: System MUST provide patient submitted-review list and review-detail views across treatment cases.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 rule: "Includes all submitted reviews for the logged-in patient across all completed treatment cases." Screens 2 and 3.

nodes.title: Patient takedown request flow; no direct patient deletion

attrs.statement: System MUST provide patient takedown request flow (submit -> pending -> admin decision -> notification), and MUST NOT allow direct patient deletion of submitted reviews.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Executive Summary, Module Scope, Screen 3 ("Patient cannot directly delete a submitted review."), General Module Rules ("Patient cannot directly delete submitted reviews; takedown requires admin decision workflow.") and workflows A3 and A4.

nodes.title: Published reviews shown on patient-facing provider surfaces

attrs.statement: System MUST display published reviews on patient-facing provider/clinic profile and offer-evaluation surfaces with ratings summary, review list, provider responses, public-safe media, and `Verified Off-platform` markers when applicable.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 rules: the embedded section uses the same review data model as patient-submitted reviews, provider responses and admin management; admin-seeded reviews display the Verified Off-platform marker; the provider response displays with the review when available.

nodes.title: Admin inserts, edits, removes reviews and decides takedowns with audit

attrs.rationale: Restated by the Admin Platform scope, workflows A1, A2 and A4, and Screens 8 and 9.

nodes.title: Provider average rating, count and distribution calculated

attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 5 (Ratings summary: average rating, count, distribution), Screen 4 (rating summary teaser, cached summary allowed) and Main Flow step 3. Scalability Considerations: caching of ratings summary and distribution per provider (technical, not migrated).

nodes.title: Provider list, filter and detail screens across treatment cases
