attrs.rationale: Restated by the Provider Platform scope and Screens 5 and 6. The filter criteria themselves are owned by FR-022 (REQ-022-092, REQ-022-042).

nodes.title: Reviews linked to patient, provider and completed procedure

attrs.statement: System MUST link reviews to patient, provider, and completed procedure records.
attrs.rationale: Key Entities Review links (patient, procedure, provider, treatment_id) and Data Dependencies (completed procedure records with completion date and provider association).

nodes.title: Review photos stored and retrieved securely with metadata

attrs.statement: System MUST securely store and retrieve review photos with metadata.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Shared Services (S-05 handles secure photo storage and retrieval) and Screen 1 Photos. Media handling in Implementation Notes (thumbnails, access protection) is technical and not migrated.

nodes.title: Takedown request records persisted with decision data

attrs.statement: System MUST persist takedown request records including reason, status, decision note, requester, decider, and timestamps.
attrs.rationale: Key Entities TakedownRequest; workflows A3 and A4.

nodes.title: One canonical review schema across Patient, Provider and Admin

attrs.statement: System MUST preserve a single canonical review schema across Patient, Provider, and Admin platforms (`overall_rating`, `facility_rating`, `staff_rating`, `results_rating`, `value_rating`, `feedback_text`, `photos[]`, plus read-only clinic/treatment context fields).
attrs.rationale: Screen 9 note: "Admin tooling must read/write the same canonical review schema as patient/provider surfaces to prevent cross-tenant drift." Screen 4 context note says the embedded section connects to the same review data model.

nodes.title: Reviewer identity aliased by default; no PII in public views

attrs.statement: System MUST alias reviewer identity by default and prevent exposure of PII in public views.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Data & Privacy Rules ("Patient display name uses aliasing by default; see canonical reviewer alias algorithm below."), Screen 4 ("Reviewer identity is aliased by default and must not expose patient PII.") and the reviewer alias rows of Screens 5 and 6 (no PII exposure). Algorithm: see the reviewer alias rule.

nodes.title: Review data and photos encrypted; auditable logs

attrs.statement: System MUST encrypt review data and photos in transit and at rest and maintain auditable logs.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Security Considerations (encrypt data in transit and at rest; signed URLs for media; full audit trail for all state changes). The mechanics are technical and not migrated.

nodes.title: Unpublish and archive for compliance removals and takedowns

attrs.statement: System MUST support unpublish + archival for compliance removals and approved takedown requests.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 8 ("Removed reviews are unpublished + archived (not hard deleted)."), Screen 9 ("Approve decision: review unpublished + archived."), Security Considerations (soft-delete (unpublish) for takedowns) and the approved-takedown edge case.

nodes.title: Invite, reminder and status notifications via Notification Service

attrs.statement: System MUST send invite/reminder and status notifications (new published review to provider, provider reply, admin removal, takedown decision) via Notification Service.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Main Flow step 4(d), workflows A3 step 4, A4 step 4 and B1 outcome, the Provider Platform scope (receive notification on new published reviews) and Shared Services. Invite and reminder timing is owned by FR-030.

nodes.title: Ratings summary endpoints for provider profiles with caching

attrs.statement: System MUST provide ratings summary endpoints for provider profiles with caching.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4: rating summary teaser is read-only and a cached summary is allowed. Scalability Considerations: caching of ratings summary and distribution per provider.

nodes.title: Patient review detail shows response, removal reason, edit flow

attrs.statement: Patient Review Detail MUST display provider response (when available), admin removal reason (when removed), and support pre-filled edit flow for published reviews.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 rules: "`Edit Review` opens pre-filled form fields; saved edits are published immediately (no moderation gate)."

nodes.title: Takedown modal with required reason and 7-year retention notice

attrs.statement: Takedown request submission MUST use a confirmation modal/bottom-sheet with required patient reason and explicit 7-year retention-policy notice before submission.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 rules: the takedown request is submitted from a bottom sheet/modal with required reason and mandatory retention-policy notice. The notice text is display-only policy text: "Review content will be removed from public view but archived for a 7-year minimum (medical-records retention). Audit records of this takedown are retained for 10 years (audit-log policy)." Change Log 1.14 makes the reason required.

nodes.title: Provider inline response composer with validation and cancel

attrs.statement: Provider Review Detail MUST include a documented inline response-composer model/state (not separate screen navigation) with validation, cancel/confirm behavior, and immutable post-publish response rendering.
attrs.rationale: Screen 6 rules: the composer is an inline state of the screen, not a separate navigation screen; Cancel response asks for confirmation if unsaved content exists; Submit response is enabled only when validation passes.

nodes.title: Admin review settings and restricted export; cadence owned by FR-030

attrs.statement: Admin Review Settings MUST support review category labels, photo guidelines, removal reason catalog, reviewer display policy, restricted flagging/SLA settings, and RBAC-restricted export actions with audit logging. Review invitation and reminder cadence are owned by FR-030 (Notification Rules & Configuration); Screen 10 provides link-outs only.
attrs.rationale: Screen 10 and its rules. Change Logs 1.12 and 1.14 move invitation and reminder cadence to FR-030 and leave Screen 10 with read-only link-outs.

nodes.title: Per-treatment sub-scores endpoint for FR-014 (PRD id REQ-013-018a)

attrs.statement: System MUST additionally expose a per-treatment aggregated sub-scores endpoint that returns, for a given provider, `{treatment_id → {avg_overall, avg_facility, avg_staff, avg_results, avg_value, review_count, distribution}}` over Published reviews only. This endpoint is the data contract consumed by FR-014 "review sub-scores per treatment" analytics; cache invalidation MUST be triggered on every review publish, edit republish, removal, and approved takedown.
attrs.rationale: Renumbered from REQ-013-018a because Rule ids carry digits only. Change Log 1.13 item 4; Dependencies FR-014.

nodes.title: Entry points to reviews, takedown requests and review settings

attrs.statement: Time-gated invite after confirmed procedure completion (≥ 3 months) triggers review flow. Patient navigates to “Write a Review” from provider history. Patient views published reviews from provider profile/offer evaluation surfaces. Patient navigates to “Submitted Reviews” to view review history and request takedown from detail page. Providers access “Reviews” in dashboard to list/filter/detail reviews and respond. Admins access “Review Management”, “Takedown Requests”, and “Review Settings” from Admin platform navigation.

nodes.title: Submission validated; ineligible attempts blocked with clear messaging

attrs.statement: System validates inputs (rating ranges, feedback length, file type/size) and verifies eligibility. Ineligible attempts (too early/no completed procedure) are blocked with clear messaging.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 2 and the Edge Cases list. Rating ranges and lengths are in the rating and feedback rule; file limits in the photo rule.

nodes.title: Overall and four category ratings required; feedback 100-2000 characters

attrs.statement: Overall rating and the four category ratings (facility, staff, results, value) are required integers 1-5. Feedback is required and must be 100-2000 characters.
attrs.rationale: Composed from the Screen 1 data field table (Overall, Facility, Staff, Results, Value Rating, Feedback). Screen 1 notes: the 100-character minimum ensures reviews contain enough substance to be useful to other patients; the 2000-character ceiling deters off-topic walls of text and reduces spam/abuse surface area without truncating genuine narrative experience. Rating rows use a row-select interaction pattern (tap row to set/update score) and display selected values in X/5 star format.

nodes.title: Eligibility logic, text lengths and rating scale fixed in code

attrs.statement: Fixed in Codebase (Not Editable): Eligibility logic requires completed procedure and time threshold. Minimum and maximum lengths for text fields and rating scale bounds.
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability Rules, Fixed in Codebase list. Statement is the two list items verbatim under the list heading.

nodes.title: Review photos optional, up to 5 files; over-limit uploads prevented

attrs.statement: Photos are optional: up to 5 files, jpg/png, max 10MB each. Photos exceed limits: user informed, upload prevented until compliant.
attrs.rationale: Composed from the Screen 1 Photos row (Up to 5 files; jpg/png; max 10MB each) and the Edge Cases line (Photos exceed limits: user informed, upload prevented until compliant.).

nodes.title: Photo guidelines shown; display policies and removal right disclosed

attrs.statement: Clear photo guidelines; sensitive/identifying content discouraged. Disclose display policies and admin's right to remove for violations.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 business rule and notes. The guideline text is the admin setting photo guidelines text.

nodes.title: Patient may edit a published review at any time; edits publish immediately

attrs.statement: Patient can edit their published review at any time. `Edit Review` opens pre-filled form fields; saved edits are published immediately (no moderation gate).
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 rule ("One review per completed procedure; patient can edit their published review at any time.") and Screen 3 rule (`Edit Review` opens pre-filled form fields; saved edits are published immediately (no moderation gate).). Edit availability by status is in the Screen 3 actions rule.

nodes.title: Publish and edit republish recalculate provider rating metrics

attrs.statement: System publishes (or republishes, on edit) the review immediately and recalculates provider rating metrics (average, count, distribution) with associated cache invalidation. Recalculation applies whether the action is an initial submission or an edit to an already-published review.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 3. The takedown decision rule repeats the recalculation on approval.

nodes.title: Patient edit re-runs flagging, tracks edits, audits and notifies provider

attrs.statement: On edit (republish), system also: (a) re-runs B2 automated flagging (keyword/duplicate/rate-limit checks) against the new payload, (b) sets `last_edited_at` and increments `edit_count`, (c) writes a full audit record (before/after values, actor=patient), and (d) notifies the provider that an existing review they may have responded to was edited so they can re-evaluate their response.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 4 (Change Log 1.13 item 5). last_edited_at and edit_count are calculated by this rule.

nodes.title: Edited reviews show an Edited relative-time marker on public surfaces

attrs.statement: Edited reviews surface an "Edited {relative_time}" marker on all public surfaces (Patient list, Patient detail, Provider list/detail, Provider Profile Reviews Section) so readers can distinguish current content from the original publish.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 5, second sentence.

nodes.title: Patient sees confirmation; review live and listed

attrs.statement: Patient sees confirmation; review is live on provider profile and appears in Patient “Submitted Reviews” list.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 5, first sentence.

nodes.title: Admin-seeded reviews flagged Verified Off-platform and published directly by admin

attrs.statement: Admin-imported authenticated reviews must be flagged as "Verified Off‑platform" with verification source and date. These are published directly by admin (no patient submission flow).
attrs.rationale: Admin-Seeded Review Policy. Restated by workflow A1 (step 2: System validates fields and stores source provenance; step 3: System publishes review flagged as "Verified Off-platform"; outcome: seeded review with explicit provenance marker and full audit record), Screen 8 rules (Admin-seeded reviews must be flagged as "Verified Off-platform" with verification provenance) and Screen 4 rules (Admin-seeded reviews must display the Verified Off-platform marker).

nodes.title: Admin-seeded review needs complete source verification metadata

attrs.statement: Admin-seeded reviews require structured `source_metadata`; all required sub-fields must be provided. Source platform is one of Google, Trustpilot, Doctolify, Provider Website, Email Testimonial, Other, and "Other" requires a free-text platform name. Source URL must be a valid URL and is required unless `source_platform` = Email Testimonial. Evidence files: 1-5 files, jpg/png/pdf, max 10MB each, stored via S-05. Capture date is an ISO date and not in the future.
attrs.rationale: Composed from the Screen 8 Source verification group rows (Source platform, Source URL, Evidence file(s), Capture date). Change Log 1.13 item 2 introduces the structured source_metadata payload, persisted to Review.source_metadata.

nodes.title: Seeded review needs a permission record and admin attestation

attrs.statement: Admin-seeded reviews require a permission record: either a file upload or a text reference, plus a mandatory admin attestation checkbox confirming consent was obtained. The reviewer display name is admin-entered, PII-safe, with no full last name and no contact info.
attrs.rationale: Composed from the Screen 8 rows Permission record and Reviewer display name. The alias and display-name policy is in the reviewer alias rule.

nodes.title: Admin add, edit and remove record identity, time, reason and before/after

attrs.statement: Every admin add/edit/remove action records admin identity, timestamp, reason, and before/after changes.
attrs.rationale: Screen 8 rule. Restated by workflow A2 step 2 (System records before/after values, reason, and admin identity.).

nodes.title: Admin edit and remove need a reason; removal reason at least 10 characters

attrs.statement: Insert authenticated reviews and edit/remove existing reviews with mandatory reasons. Removal reason must be at least 10 characters.
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability Rules, Editable by Admin list, plus the Screen 8 rows Edit fields (Reason required for edit), Remove review (Removal reason min 10 chars) and Removal/edit reason (Reason catalog plus optional details; required for edit/remove). The insert case is covered by the source verification rules, which the PRD calls the provenance inputs.

nodes.title: Review status labels Published and Removed; takedown state shown separately

attrs.statement: Review status badge uses app-facing labels: `Published`, `Removed`. `Submitted` is not a review status in V1; successful review submission immediately creates a `Published` review. Takedown request state is displayed separately from review status when applicable (`Pending`, `Approved`, `Rejected`). `Removed` means no longer publicly visible due to admin action or approved takedown.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules. Key Entities add an admin-internal Flagged state; see the Flagged question in the migration report. Change Log 1.10.

nodes.title: My Reviews list newest first, paginated, with empty-state message

attrs.statement: Default list sort is latest submission date descending. The list is paginated and shows the empty state "No reviews yet - complete a treatment to leave a review" when the patient has no submitted reviews.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 rule plus the Review list row (sorted by newest first; paginated), the Sort option row (Default: Most recent first) and the Empty state row ("No reviews yet - complete a treatment to leave a review", shown when the patient has no submitted reviews).

nodes.title: Edit and takedown actions only while a review is Published

attrs.statement: For `Published` status, both `Edit Review` and `Request Takedown` actions are available. For `Removed` status, detail is read-only and shows admin removal reason; edit/takedown actions are hidden.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 business rules and the Edit review and Request takedown rows (visible only when status = Published).

nodes.title: Review stays published while a takedown request is pending

attrs.statement: While request status is `Pending`, review remains `Published` unless manually removed by admin.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 rule. Restated by workflow A3 outcome (review remains visible until decision) and the Screen 9 note on the reject decision.

nodes.title: Takedown request recorded as Pending, linked to review and case; admin queue notified

attrs.statement: System records patient reason, creates takedown request with `Pending` status, and links it to review/case. System notifies admin takedown queue.
attrs.rationale: Workflow A3 steps 3 and 4.

attrs.statement: The patient takedown reason is required and must be 10-1000 characters.
attrs.rationale: Composed from the Screen 3 Takedown reason row. Change Log 1.14 replaced the optional message with this required reason.

nodes.title: Admin approves or rejects takedown with note; approval unpublishes, recalculates, notifies

attrs.statement: Admin reviews request reason, review content, and compliance context. Admin approves or rejects request with decision note. System applies decision: approved -> review unpublished/archived and provider rating metrics recalculated; rejected -> review remains published. System notifies patient of decision and reason.
attrs.rationale: Workflow A4. Edge Cases add that on a rejected request the review stays published and the decision reason is visible to the patient.

nodes.title: Takedown decision note required; admin removal reason stored on removed review

attrs.statement: The takedown decision note is required, 10-1000 characters. Approved takedown must persist `Admin removal reason` on the removed review so Patient Review Detail (Screen 3) can display the same reason consistently. Admin removal reason is required when approving takedown.
attrs.rationale: Composed from the Screen 9 rows Decision note and Admin removal reason and the Screen 9 note (Approved takedown must persist `Admin removal reason` on the removed review so Patient Review Detail (Screen 3) can display the same reason consistently.).

nodes.title: Review content retained at least 7 years; takedowns archive, never hard-delete

attrs.statement: Review content (review record + photos + provider responses + takedown requests) retained for minimum 7 years (medical-records baseline, Constitution §III.A); approved takedown requests are processed by unpublish + archival with restricted access — never hard-deleted.
attrs.rationale: Data & Privacy Rules. Screen 3 retention notice repeats it to the patient.

nodes.title: Audit records immutable and retained at least 10 years

attrs.statement: `AdminAction` and all audit-log records (patient self-edits, admin edits/removals/seeded reviews, takedown decisions, settings changes, provider responses) are immutable and retained for minimum 10 years per Constitution §VI (Audit Trail). The 10-year audit-log retention is independent of and longer than the 7-year review-content retention.
attrs.rationale: Data & Privacy Rules; Change Log 1.13 item 1. Independent of, and longer than, the 7-year review content retention.

nodes.title: All review mutations fully auditable with actor type and prior values

attrs.statement: All review mutations are fully auditable (who, when, what, before/after, reason where applicable), including patient self-edits to published reviews, admin actions (edits, removals, seeded reviews, takedown decisions, settings changes), and provider response creation. Audit records preserve actor type (patient / provider / admin) and prior field values to satisfy constitution Auditability requirements.
attrs.rationale: Data & Privacy Rules. Restated by Screen 8 (audit trail preview, full audit retained) and Screen 7 (review visibility/filter results must preserve complete audit traceability).

nodes.title: Photos and text must not expose sensitive personal information

attrs.statement: Photos and text must not expose sensitive personal information; admin may redact or remove post-publication.
attrs.rationale: Data & Privacy Rules.

nodes.title: Reviewer alias algorithm; seeded display name; alias-only default

attrs.statement: Reviewer alias algorithm (canonical, applied uniformly across Patient, Provider, and Admin public surfaces): `{first_name} {last_initial}.` (e.g., "Sarah M."); collisions within the same provider's review list are deduplicated with a numeric suffix (`Sarah M. 2`, `Sarah M. 3`, …). Admin views may unmask to full identity per RBAC. Admin-seeded reviews use an admin-entered `reviewer_display_name` field (free text, subject to the same PII-safety policy — no full last name, no contact info) instead of the algorithmic alias; the `Verified Off-platform` badge accompanies the display name. Patients have no opt-in to expose full name in V1; reviewer display policy toggle on Screen 10 governs only future policy expansion and MUST default to alias-only.
attrs.rationale: Data & Privacy Rules, canonical alias, whole bullet verbatim (Change Log 1.13 item 6). Includes the admin-seeded reviewer_display_name rule and the alias-only default of the reviewer display policy setting.

nodes.title: Ratings use a 1-5 scale; averages may display half stars

attrs.statement: Ratings use 1–5 scale with half‑stars display allowed for averages.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rules.

attrs.statement: The provider response text is required and must be 50-1000 characters. The character counter updates live and submit is blocked outside the limits.
attrs.rationale: Composed from the Screen 6 rows Response text, Character counter and Submit response. Screen 6 notes: the 50-character minimum prevents single-word or non-substantive replies that erode trust; the 1000-character ceiling keeps public responses scannable on review surfaces and discourages defensive long-form rebuttals.

nodes.title: Provider responses public and immutable while published

attrs.statement: Provider responses are public and immutable while published; admins may remove a response for policy violation. After an admin removal, the provider may submit exactly one replacement response (see one-active-response rule below) — outside of that single replacement, posted responses cannot be edited or re-posted by the provider.
attrs.rationale: Screen 6 rule; Change Log 1.13 item 8 re-worded it from immutable once posted.

nodes.title: One active provider response per review; one replacement after admin removal

attrs.statement: Provider may have at most one active public response per review in V1. If admin removes a prior response for policy violation, provider may submit one replacement response; both the removed and replacement responses are retained in the audit trail (`AdminAction` for the removal, `ProviderResponse` history for the lifecycle).
attrs.rationale: Screen 6 rule; Change Log 1.12 item 2.

nodes.title: Respond action only on published reviews without a response; submission recorded and patient notified

attrs.statement: Respond as Provider is visible only when the review is published and no response exists. Submission records provider identity and timestamp and triggers patient notification.
attrs.rationale: Composed from the Screen 6 row Respond as Provider (Visible only when review is published and no response exists) and the Screen 6 rule (Submission records provider identity and timestamp and triggers patient notification.).

nodes.title: Provider detail and list keep treatment-case context and support case filtering

attrs.statement: Detail view must preserve treatment-case context so provider can differentiate multi-case patient histories. One patient may have multiple treatment cases; list must support case-specific filtering.
attrs.rationale: Screens 5 and 6 business rules.

nodes.title: Only Published reviews shown on patient profile and provider list surfaces

attrs.statement: Only `Published` reviews are visible on patient-facing provider/clinic profile surfaces. Only published reviews appear in provider list surfaces.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 and Screen 5 business rules.

nodes.title: Embedded review section inherits provider identity from the host profile

attrs.statement: The embedded preview must not redefine or duplicate the full provider profile layout; it inherits provider identity and navigation from the host provider profile screen.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 business rule and context note (it is not a standalone provider profile screen; non-review profile content belongs to the provider profile and quote-review specifications).

nodes.title: View all opens the full review list of the same provider

attrs.statement: `View all` opens the complete review list for the same provider without changing review ownership or source rules.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 business rule.

nodes.title: Profile review preview limited; full list paginated, newest first, sort and rating filter

attrs.statement: The provider profile review preview shows a limited count of Published reviews before View all. The full reviews list is paginated, newest first by default, with sort by recency or rating and filter by rating.
attrs.rationale: Composed from the Screen 4 rows Review preview list, Full reviews list state and Sort/filter controls.

nodes.title: Provider review list paginated, newest first by default; sort by recency or rating

attrs.statement: The provider review list is paginated, newest first by default, and can be sorted by recency or rating (default: recency).
attrs.rationale: Composed from the Screen 5 rows Review list and Sort. Filter criteria are owned by FR-022 (REQ-022-092).

nodes.title: Public review photos follow the media privacy and removal rules

attrs.statement: Review photos shown publicly must follow the same media privacy and removal rules as submitted review photos.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 business rule.

nodes.title: Admin list covers patient-submitted and admin-seeded reviews with audit traceability

attrs.statement: Admin list includes patient-submitted and admin-seeded reviews. Review visibility/filter results must preserve complete audit traceability.
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 business rules.

nodes.title: Settings changes are admin-only and audit logged

attrs.statement: Settings changes are admin-only and audit logged.
attrs.rationale: Screen 10 business rule.

nodes.title: Settings must not weaken fixed eligibility, rating, length, retention or privacy rules

attrs.statement: Settings must not weaken fixed eligibility, rating scale, text length, retention, or privacy rules.
attrs.rationale: Screen 10 business rule.

nodes.title: Export preserves RBAC, PII handling and audit traceability

attrs.statement: Export actions must preserve RBAC, PII handling, and audit traceability.
attrs.rationale: Screen 10 business rule. REQ-013-022 states the export is RBAC-restricted and audit logged.

nodes.title: Flagging thresholds and takedown SLA configurable within policy bounds

attrs.statement: Configurable with Restrictions: Flagging thresholds and auto-flag rules for admin review (within safe bounds approved by policy). Takedown decision SLA/queue prioritization parameters (within policy bounds).
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability Rules. Screen 10 rows Flagging thresholds (restricted safe ranges only) and Takedown SLA settings (restricted policy range).

nodes.title: Admin edits review labels, photo guidelines, removal reasons and display-name policy

attrs.statement: Editable by Admin: review category labels (canonical keys remain fixed); photo guidelines text; removal reasons catalogue; visibility rules for display name (alias/full name toggle policy).
attrs.rationale: Composed from the Admin Editability Rules (Editable by Admin) and the Screen 10 row Review categories/labels (Admin-editable labels; canonical keys remain fixed). The PRD list also names "invitation cadence and reminders"; that item is left out because REQ-013-022, Screen 10 and Change Logs 1.12 and 1.14 assign cadence to FR-030 (see the cadence question in the migration report).

nodes.title: Photo guidelines text required; edits audit-logged through AdminAction

attrs.statement: Photo guidelines text is required. All edits are captured via AdminAction with before/after values; there is no formal version model.
attrs.rationale: Composed from the Screen 10 row Photo guidelines text; Change Log 1.12 item 4.

nodes.title: Removal reason catalog holds at least one active reason

attrs.statement: The removal reason catalog must hold at least one active reason.
attrs.rationale: Composed from the Screen 10 row Removal reason catalog.

nodes.title: System-automated flagging queues content for admin review post-publication

attrs.statement: Trigger: Content flagged by system-automated detection (keyword matching, duplicate submission patterns, rate-limit triggers). User-initiated flagging is a future enhancement. Steps: System queues flagged content for admin review; Admin may redact, unpublish, or uphold. Outcome: Policy-compliant content remains; violations are removed with audit record.
attrs.rationale: Workflow B2. Edge Cases: "Duplicate or spam reviews: auto‑flag for admin review post-publication." Implementation Notes (technical, not migrated) add that anti-abuse covers duplicate detection, keyword flags and rate limits for submissions and responses. User-initiated flagging is a future enhancement (Change Log 1.11).

nodes.title: RBAC enforced for submit, moderate and respond actions

attrs.statement: Enforce RBAC for submit/moderate/respond actions.
attrs.rationale: Security Considerations, promoted as a business rule.

attrs.statement: Review content will be removed from public view but archived for a 7-year minimum (medical-records retention). Audit records of this takedown are retained for 10 years (audit-log policy).
attrs.rationale: Verbatim from the frozen PRD: Screen 3 Retention notice (PRD line 246). REQ-013-020 requires the notice; this Rule carries its text, including the 10-year audit sentence.

attrs.statement: The takedown request queue is filterable by status and date.
attrs.rationale: Paraphrase of Screen 9 Request queue Validation cell 'Filterable by status/date' (PRD line 436); wording awaits user review.

nodes.title: Screen 1 layout locked; current definitions and shared rules apply

attrs.statement: Screen 1 layout, sections, widget count, chart types, filters, and responsive behavior remain locked. Its TTFQ, four-stage Confirmed-booking funnel, and active accepted-but-unpaid aging MUST use the current Screen 1 definitions and shared analytics rules under the approved CR-FR014-20261007-01 metric-only exception; the v2.0 formulas are superseded where explicitly revised.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1654 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-001). Range statement in the PRD covering REQ-014-001 through REQ-014-032; the PRD cites no individual id between 002 and 032 (see report). Restated by the Screen 1 lock notice (line 125: PO formula/metric-label-only exceptions, Qualified stage removed, TTFQ from distribution, only the New row badge kept).

attrs.statement: System MUST display cumulative distinct-inquiry funnel conversion trend ending in Confirmed booking as a multi-line chart with weekly/monthly toggle
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1658 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-033).

attrs.statement: System MUST display conversion breakdown by treatment type as a grouped bar chart
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1659 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-034).

attrs.statement: System MUST display conversion breakdown by patient country as a ranked horizontal bar
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1660 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-035).

attrs.statement: System MUST display parent-quote acceptance rate trend using accepted parents and submitted parents from the same first-submission cohort
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1661 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-036).

nodes.title: TTFQ p50/p90 trend from distribution to first send (Screen 2)

attrs.statement: System MUST display TTFQ p50 and p90 trend, measured from the inquiry's distribution to the provider to the `first_sent_at` of the provider's earliest parent quote for the inquiry per inquiry/provider pair (never changed by a re-send or new version), with SLA reference line
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1662 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-037).

attrs.statement: System MUST display cancellation and no-show rate KPI tiles with sparklines
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1663 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-038).

attrs.statement: System MUST display an anonymised platform benchmark comparison table (TTFQ, booking conversion, parent-quote acceptance rate, avg rating) with percentile bands and the same per-metric counting definitions for provider and peer values
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1664 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-039).

nodes.title: Benchmark pool of at least 5 providers

attrs.statement: Benchmark pool MUST require minimum 5 providers; display explanatory message if pool is insufficient
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1665 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-040). Restated by Data Quality Rule 9 (line 1457) and Implementation Notes (line 1628: benchmark outputs only above the minimum peer count).

nodes.title: Full patient location table and donut (Screen 3)

attrs.statement: System MUST display full patient location table (all countries, sortable) and linked donut chart
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1669 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-041).

attrs.statement: System MUST display new vs. returning patient rate as donut and monthly trend line
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1670 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-042).

attrs.statement: System MUST display patient journey time (p50 and p90 days inquiry → first successful booking-confirming payment) with distribution histogram, without failed-attempt or later-installment duplication
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1671 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-043).

attrs.statement: System MUST display review sub-scores (overall, results, staff, facility, value) per treatment type
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1672 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-044).

attrs.statement: System MUST display treatment preference distribution (quoted inquiry count vs. Confirmed booking count per treatment, by the parent quote's treatment)
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1673 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-045).

attrs.statement: System MUST display aftercare activation rate KPI with trend sparkline
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1674 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-046).

attrs.statement: Removed in v3.11. No patient age distribution widget is included in this version; the ID is kept so later numbering stays stable
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1675 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-047). Restated by Screen 3 Business Rules (line 457: no patient age distribution widget is included in this version).

attrs.statement: System MUST display revenue trend with weekly/monthly/quarterly toggle
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1679 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-048).

attrs.statement: System MUST display revenue by treatment type — full list (not capped at 8)
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1680 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-049).

attrs.statement: System MUST display revenue by patient country
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1681 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-050).

nodes.title: Commission deducted and net income from confirmation-time snapshot (Screen 4)

attrs.statement: System MUST display commission deducted and net income (gross income minus commission deducted) per period using each booking's confirmation-time commission snapshot: percentage per completed payment in range; flat rate once per procedure completed in range (FR-015 REQ-015-022)
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1682 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-051).

nodes.title: Refund volume and refund rate trend (Screen 4)

attrs.statement: System MUST display refund volume and refund rate trend
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1683 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-052).

nodes.title: Installment vs full payment split and adoption rate (Screen 4)

attrs.statement: System MUST display installment vs. full payment split and a monthly installment adoption rate (bookings first confirmed in the month with an FR-007B installment plan divided by all bookings first confirmed in the month)
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1684 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-053).

nodes.title: Cash-at-risk summary of accepted selections under valid holds (Screen 4)

attrs.statement: System MUST display cash-at-risk summary of distinct accepted selections awaiting initial payment under valid holds, linking to Screen 1 Section C3; expired/cancelled/superseded selections MUST be excluded
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1685 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-054).

attrs.statement: System MUST display full payout history (column bar + paginated table covering all history)
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1686 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-055).

nodes.title: Average accepted subquote price by treatment (Screen 5)

attrs.statement: System MUST display average accepted subquote price by treatment type with acceptance-time trend overlay
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1690 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-056).

attrs.statement: System MUST display accepted-price distribution histogram with provider and platform accepted-price median reference lines
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1691 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-057).

nodes.title: Accepted price vs parent-quote acceptance rate scatter (Screen 5)

attrs.statement: System MUST display a descriptive accepted-price vs. parent-quote acceptance-rate scatter using the same first-submission cohort for both axes (one point per treatment), without offered-price conversion or causal claims; replace with text insight if fewer than 3 treatment types have both coordinates
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1692 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-058).

nodes.title: Platform benchmark comparison with accepted-price-only amounts (Screen 5)

attrs.statement: System MUST display platform benchmark comparison table with percentile bands, consistent units/cohorts/FX basis, and accepted-price-only amount observations; require minimum 5 eligible providers for each benchmark metric
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1693 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-059).

nodes.title: Provider selects screens to include in an export

attrs.statement: System MUST allow providers to select which analytics screens to include in the export
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1697 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-060).

nodes.title: PDF and CSV exports use the screens' metric definitions

attrs.statement: System MUST support PDF and CSV exports using the same approved metric definitions, samples, eligibility, and cutoff as the included screens, with authorized accepted-selection provenance in detailed rows
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1698 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-061).

nodes.title: Scheduled recurring exports for the previous full period

attrs.statement: System MUST support scheduled recurring exports (weekly/monthly/quarterly) covering the previous full period in the provider's timezone, with recipient limits, retry, and edit/pause/resume/delete as defined on Screen 6
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1699 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-062).

nodes.title: Generated reports stored 7 days for re-download

attrs.statement: System MUST store generated reports for 7 days for re-download
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1700 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-063). Restated by Screen 6 Business Rules (line 697: generated reports stored 7 days for re-download from Report History section) and S-05 dependency (line 1578).

attrs.statement: System MUST display three-section overview (Operations, Performance, Finance) with platform-wide aggregations
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1704 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-064).

attrs.statement: System MUST display provider TTFQ health distribution donut (Green/Amber/Red counts)
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1705 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-065).

nodes.title: Engagement rate, Dormant and Non-responding provider counts (Screen 7)

attrs.statement: System MUST display provider engagement rate, activity-based Dormant provider count, and separately labelled Non-responding provider count (0 first-submitted parent quotes in 30 days)
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1706 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-066).

nodes.title: Platform funnel and TTFQ from underlying observations (Screen 7)

attrs.statement: System MUST display a cumulative distinct-platform-inquiry Confirmed-booking funnel and TTFQ bullet chart computed from underlying inquiry/provider first-response observations, not summed provider funnels or averaged provider percentiles
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1707 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-067).

attrs.statement: System MUST display platform GMV, commission earned, upcoming payout obligations, and cash-at-risk as financial summary tiles
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1708 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-068).

attrs.statement: System MUST display provider league table (sortable by TTFQ, booking conversion, parent-quote acceptance rate, rating, distinct-inquiry response rate) with platform variance column
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1712 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-069).

attrs.statement: System MUST display provider performance scatter plot (TTFQ vs. conversion rate, one point per provider)
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1713 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-070).

nodes.title: Provider activity table with engagement status (Screen 8)

attrs.statement: System MUST display provider activity table with last active date, distinct first-submitted parent quote count, distinct-inquiry response rate, and engagement status (Active/At Risk/Dormant)
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1714 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-071).

nodes.title: New provider ramp chart from parent first submissions (Screen 8)

attrs.statement: System MUST display new provider ramp chart (distinct parent first submissions vs. days since onboarding), not draft/option creation or version counts
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1715 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-072).

attrs.statement: Engagement status thresholds MUST be admin-configurable
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1716 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-073). Restated by Screen 8 Business Rules (line 935: thresholds 7d / 30d configurable by admin) and Admin Editability (line 1502).

nodes.title: Inquiry volume trend with prior period (Screen 9)

attrs.statement: System MUST display inquiry volume trend (area line with prior period overlay)
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1720 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-074).

attrs.statement: System MUST display cumulative distinct-platform-inquiry funnel trend ending in Confirmed booking as a multi-line monthly chart
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1721 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-075).

attrs.statement: System MUST display new vs. returning patient rate as stacked monthly bar + KPI tiles
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1722 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-076).

attrs.statement: System MUST display platform patient journey time distribution (p50, p90, histogram) using one first successful booking-confirming payment per inquiry
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1723 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-077).

attrs.statement: System MUST display inquiry seasonality month × weekday heatmap (rolling 12-month view; index = weekday average ÷ month daily average × 100)
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1724 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-078).

attrs.statement: System MUST display affiliate acquisition KPI tiles and ranked table; display limitation note that tracking begins when the affiliate code or referral link is captured in the booking journey, not at the inquiry stage; attribution follows FR-018 Rule 11 even when another discount set the final price
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1725 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-079).

attrs.statement: System MUST display patient demand by country (choropleth map OR ranked table — implementation choice)
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1729 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-080). Restated by Screen 10 Business Rules (line 1110: a map needs a separate rendering library; ranked table is the functional fallback) and External dependency Map Rendering Library (line 1587).

attrs.statement: System MUST display provider coverage by country (ranked bar)
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1730 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-081).

nodes.title: Demand vs supply gap table, 5-inquiry minimum (Screen 10)

attrs.statement: System MUST display demand vs. supply gap table with gap flag; only show countries with ≥5 inquiries in period
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1731 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-082). Restated by Screen 10 Business Rules (line 1109: gap table only shows countries with at least 5 inquiries in the selected period to avoid statistical noise).

attrs.statement: System MUST display conversion rate by patient country (ranked bar with platform median reference)
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1732 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-083).

attrs.statement: System MUST display emerging patient origins table (countries with >20% inquiry growth vs. prior period and >10 inquiries in current period)
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1733 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-084).

attrs.statement: System MUST display treatment completion rate per type (bar chart with platform average reference)
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1737 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-085).

nodes.title: Cancellation and no-show rate per treatment (Screen 11)

attrs.statement: System MUST display cancellation and no-show rate per treatment type
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1738 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-086).

attrs.statement: System MUST display treatment volume trend as stacked area chart (monthly)
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1739 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-087).

nodes.title: Counting definitions apply to all widgets, drill-downs, aggregates, benchmarks and exports

attrs.statement: These definitions apply to all provider/admin widgets, drill-downs, aggregates, benchmarks, and exports. A chart's "Quoted" inquiry stage is not the same unit as a submitted-parent volume metric.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1424. Analytics Counting & Time Basis preamble.

attrs.statement: Count a stable FR-004 Parent Quote ID once on its first successful submission. Multiple parent quotes from one provider are separate responses; drafts, edits, resends, aggregate versions, Quote Options, and Option/Date-Price Records are not extra responses. Child-volume or comparison telemetry, when reported, MUST be separately labelled as Quote Option or Subquote counts and never substituted into parent metrics.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1426.

nodes.title: Admin-authored replacement quotes are not provider responses

attrs.statement: A quote that an admin authors for a replacement provider during an FR-006 provider-fault transfer (FR-004 Workflow 7, `authorType = admin`) is not a provider response. It is excluded from every provider quote count (parent response volume, inquiry response rate, parent-quote acceptance rate), from booking conversion and the inquiry funnel for the replacement provider, and from TTFQ, together with its replacement acceptance and booking. Admin views report these quotes only as a separate count of provider-fault replacements.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1427.

nodes.title: Acceptance grain is the immutable AcceptanceEvent

attrs.statement: FR-005's immutable AcceptanceEvent identifies the selected Subquote, its Quote Option and Option/Date-Price Record, inherited parent context, and accepted aggregate revision. Deduplicate redelivery of the same acceptance and count each accepted parent once. `acceptedSubquoteVersion = acceptedParentQuoteVersion`; neither a changed package preset nor an unselected alternative may replace the accepted snapshot. Historical acceptance measures patient selection and is retained after cancellation or payment-window expiry; it is not proof of a confirmed booking or captured revenue.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1428.

nodes.title: Parent-quote acceptance rate cohort and formula

attrs.statement: Numerator = distinct parents in the selected first-submission cohort with an AcceptanceEvent by the reporting cutoff. Denominator = all distinct submitted parents in that same cohort, including unaccepted, expired, withdrawn, or later-cancelled parents. Use the parent's `first_sent_at` (set by FR-004 on first send; never changed by a re-send) to assign each parent to its cohort; do not divide acceptance events occurring in one period by unrelated submissions in another. This is a parent-level rate, not accepted subquotes divided by available subquotes.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1429.

nodes.title: Inquiry response rate cohort and formula

attrs.statement: Denominator = distinct `(providerId, inquiryId)` distribution records first assigned to that provider within the selected distribution period. Numerator = those same pairs with at least one submitted parent response by the cutoff. Retries of distribution and multiple parent responses do not multiply either side. Missing authoritative distribution data yields an unavailable metric, not a proxy based on platform inquiries or quote volume.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1430.

nodes.title: Inquiry funnel and booking conversion cohort

attrs.statement: Use inquiry `created_at` to select the inquiry cohort. Provider views count distinct `(providerId, inquiryId)` pairs assigned to that provider; platform views count distinct Inquiry IDs across providers, not the sum of provider totals. Quoted means at least one parent was submitted; Accepted means an AcceptanceEvent exists for that inquiry and, in provider views, that provider; Confirmed booking means FR-006 recorded successful deposit or first installment confirmation. Each inquiry contributes at most once to each reached stage and cumulatively to preceding stages. Inquiries have no treatment (the provider chooses it in the parent quote), so treatment segments start at Quoted and use the parent/accepted booking's treatment; unquoted inquiries count only in all-treatments views. Deduplicate within each segment. Later cancellation does not erase a reached milestone; cancellation and no-show metrics remain separate. `In Progress` is a procedure-start milestone, never a synonym for payment confirmation.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1431.

attrs.statement: Historical funnel/acceptance/response cohorts are evaluated through the earlier of the selected period end and the pipeline's data-as-of time. Current cohorts show that cutoff and indicate that outcomes may still be pending. A zero denominator is N/A, not 0% or 100%. Tooltips/exports state the unit, cohort timestamp, numerator/denominator, cutoff, and relevant sample sizes; rates based on these distinct-record sets cannot exceed 100%.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1432.

attrs.statement: TTFQ uses the same inquiry-created cohort and reporting cutoff as the funnel, which differs on purpose from the distribution-period cohort of the inquiry response rate; screens that show both (such as Screen 8) and exports MUST state each metric's cohort basis in the tooltip and export definition. TTFQ contributes one observation per inquiry/provider pair whose first parent response occurred by that cutoff, from the inquiry's distribution to that provider (`inquiry_providers.distributed_at`) to the `first_sent_at` of the provider's earliest parent quote for the inquiry; a re-send or new version never changes it. Pairs without an authoritative distribution timestamp have no TTFQ observation. Unanswered inquiries remain in funnel/response denominators but have no completed TTFQ observation. Provider distributions pool those observations; platform p50/p90 pool the underlying observations, not provider percentile averages. Journey time instead uses the successful initial payment that first confirms a booking, selects the confirmation-time cohort, and counts the inquiry once. Later installments or failed payment attempts do not create new journey observations.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1433.

attrs.statement: Count one immutable accepted total price per accepted parent, including the accepted package/date-price and promotion. Standalone price metrics use `AcceptanceEvent.acceptedAt` to select their cohort; Screen 5's scatter uses its expressly stated parent first-submission cohort. Unaccepted parents have a price range, not one amount, and remain excluded from all amount observations while included in parent volume/rate metrics. Cancellation, hold expiry, package-library edits, quote revisions, or later financial adjustments do not rewrite the historical acceptance-price observation. Show accepted selection counts and distinguish these statistics from captured revenue.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1434.

attrs.statement: At the displayed snapshot time, include only Accepted FR-006 pending bookings with a non-superseded AcceptanceEvent, valid exclusive slot hold, and no successful initial payment. Scope the time filter by acceptance time, calculate age from immutable `acceptedAt`, and validate the actual configured hold deadline. Remove cancelled, expired-hold, and `Payment Window Expired` selections even before stale quote status caches update; do not restart age on payment retries. Sum each eligible accepted total price once as potential accepted booking value, not deposit receivables, captured revenue, or outstanding installment balances.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1435.

attrs.statement: Payments, refunds, commission deductions, installments, and payouts retain their existing owning-record accounting rules. Aggregate those records before attaching read-only AcceptanceEvent/Booking/quote provenance; joining several packages or date options MUST NOT multiply financial totals. This change does not redefine fund release, fees, payout routing, or travel responsibility.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1436. Restated by Screen 4 Business Rules (line 599) and Screen 12 Business Rules (line 1319).

attrs.statement: Refunds are counted only from refund rows (`payments.payment_type = 'refund'` with `payment_status = 'completed'`); refund amount, refund count, and Net GMV use these rows alone. An original payment whose `payment_status` later becomes `refunded` stays in gross income/GMV and captured payment counts (`payment_type ≠ 'refund'` and `payment_status IN ('completed', 'refunded')`) and is never counted as a second refund. This prevents a refund from being removed from gross figures and subtracted again.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1437. Restated by Screen 4 Business Rules (line 595: Income excludes refund rows; refunds reported in Widget 5).

attrs.statement: All provider benchmark comparisons (Screen 2 Widget 7 and Screen 5 Widget 4) use one peer pool: active providers with ≥30 inquiries in the same rolling 12-month window, minimum 5 eligible providers per metric (price metrics additionally require accepted-price observations). Provider identities stay anonymised (Rule 13). Colour is direction-aware: for higher-is-better metrics (conversion, parent-quote acceptance, ratings) Green = at or better than median, Amber = up to 10% worse, Red = more than 10% worse; for TTFQ p50 lower is better, so worse means above median. Average accepted price is neutral: variance and percentile are shown without colour. Benchmarks refresh at the FR-026 benchmark refresh frequency.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1438. Restated by Screen 5 Business Rules (line 666: provider identity fully anonymised in benchmark calculations).

attrs.statement: A filter applies only to widgets whose source records carry that dimension. Inquiries carry no treatment (the provider chooses it in the FR-004 Parent Quote), so the Treatment filter applies from Quoted onward: quoted inquiries, parent quotes, acceptances, bookings, accepted prices, payments and refunds attributed through the accepted parent (Screen 4 Widget 2 attribution), reviews, and aftercare. Funnel and conversion widgets with a treatment selected follow the Screen 2 rule: the Inquiries stage shows "— (inquiries have no treatment)" and conversion is measured from Quoted. Widgets built on inquiries, patient registrations, provider counts, or payout statements are not filtered by a dimension their records lack; they keep rendering unfiltered data with a visible note such as "Not filtered by treatment". This covers: Screen 4: Widget 8 payout history is filtered by neither treatment nor patient country, because payout statements are per provider period (likewise Screen 1 C4 for the country filter); Screen 9: Widgets 1 (inquiry volume), 3 (new vs. returning), and 5 (seasonality) are not treatment-filtered; Widget 2 measures from Quoted; Widgets 4 (journey time) and 6 (affiliate bookings) filter by the accepted parent's treatment; Screen 10: Widgets 1 (demand map), 2 (provider coverage), 3 (demand vs. supply gap), and 5 (emerging origins) are not treatment-filtered; Widget 4 measures conversion from Quoted

nodes.title: Daily FX rates, locked at transaction date, 48-hour fallback cap

attrs.statement: All currency amounts converted using daily FX rates cached from the currency conversion API; rates locked at the transaction date for historical data. On API failure, fall back to the previous day's cached rate up to a maximum of 48 hours; beyond 48 hours, affected widgets show "FX data unavailable" instead of rendering with stale rates; Accepted-price observations preserve the FR-005 acceptance snapshot's original currency, total price, locked exchange rate, and acceptance time. If a different reporting currency needs an additional conversion, use a historical acceptance-date reporting rate and retain its provenance; do not replace the commercial locked rate with today's rate. Payment/payout records retain their own existing historical financial FX basis. Missing historical provenance yields an unavailable affected amount metric, not an inferred currency, current package price, or current FX value.

attrs.statement: Values are owned by the FR-026 Analytics Configuration Manager (Screen 5e); FR-014 reads the active version at calculation time. nodes.title: TTFQ formula: first send minus distribution per provider/inquiry

attrs.statement: TTFQ formula: `Parent Quote.first_sent_at` of the provider's earliest parent quote for the inquiry `− inquiry_providers.distributed_at` per `(providerId, inquiryId)` (elapsed wall time from the inquiry's distribution to that provider; display in provider timezone). This is the same clock as the FR-020/FR-030 `inquiry.ttfq_sla_breached` alert, so a provider who receives an inquiry later (for example after an FR-003 exclusive-provider decline releases it to normal distribution) is not penalised for time before distribution. Missing `distributed_at` yields no TTFQ observation for that pair, not a fallback to `inquiry.created_at`. `first_sent_at` is set by FR-004 on the parent quote's first send; a re-send or new version never changes it. Draft creation, option/date-price creation, later parent quotes, edits, and resends do not reset the first-response timestamp. Exclude auto-acks; calls/messages do not stop the clock.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 158. Fixed in codebase (line 1509). Shares its clock with the SLA-breach alert.
