Action types of the audit entry (create, edit, publish, revert) are in Key Entities (line 365).

attrs.statement: Legal document entities MUST include: type, locale (for translation only, no regional content variants), version, status (draft/current/archived), effective date, change summary
attrs.rationale: Fields of the Legal Document entity are in Key Entities (line 358) and Screens 1 to 3.

attrs.statement: Acceptance records MUST include: user, document type, version, timestamp, locale, and acceptance channel
attrs.rationale: Fields of the Acceptance Record are in Key Entities (line 362) and Screen 4A (lines 257-258).

nodes.title: Version comparisons as human-readable change summaries

attrs.statement: Version comparisons MUST present human‑readable change summaries (no raw diffs required for end‑users)
attrs.rationale: Restated by Admin Platform scope (line 44: compare versions, diff summary) and Screen 3 Version Diff Summary (line 197: key changes against the prior version, must be generated from the draft); Screen 3 also shows it before publish.

nodes.title: Authorized Admin roles only; publication needs explicit confirmation

attrs.statement: Only authorized Admin roles can create/edit/publish legal documents; publication actions require explicit confirmation
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 1 business rule (line 146: only authorized Admin roles can access this list).

nodes.title: Full content readable before acceptance; consent records retained

attrs.statement: Users MUST have clear access to read the full content prior to acceptance; records are retained to demonstrate consent
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 2 of User Accepts New Version (line 101: user reviews content and accepts). No retention period is stated.

nodes.title: Audit trail immutable and reviewable by authorized Admins

attrs.statement: Audit trail MUST be immutable and reviewable by authorized Admins
attrs.rationale: Audit Entry in Key Entities (line 365).

nodes.title: Prompts and reminders for pending acceptance within rate limits

attrs.statement: Users SHOULD receive clear prompts and reminders for pending acceptance respecting rate limits
attrs.rationale: Restated by Communication Structure (lines 58, 60: in-app prompts to accept new versions; user reminders rate-limited), CL-1 (line 349: show rate-limited reminders) and Screen 4 business rule (line 234: reminders respect rate limits). The rate limit value is not stated.

nodes.title: Legal content and acceptance prompts available in Patient and Provider apps

attrs.statement: Legal content visibility and acceptance prompts MUST be available across Patient and Provider applications
attrs.rationale: Restated by Patient and Provider Platform scope (lines 23-24) and Entry Points (lines 70-71).

attrs.statement: Admin: Settings → Legal Content → Documents (T&C, Privacy, Consent, Cancellation Policy) → Draft/Preview/Publish. Patient: First-run or on change → Acceptance prompt; Settings → Terms & Conditions; Settings → Privacy & Security → Privacy Policy. Provider: First-run or on change → Acceptance prompt; Settings → Legal → View documents.
attrs.rationale: Entry Points (lines 69-71). Patient Settings paths match FR-001 Screens 15c and 15d.

nodes.title: Patient views latest T&C, Privacy Policy, Cancellation Policy and relevant Consent forms

attrs.statement: Patient can view the latest Terms & Conditions, Privacy Policy, Cancellation Policy, and relevant Consent forms.
attrs.rationale: Patient Platform breakdown (line 32).

attrs.statement: Patient can view their prior acceptances (history) for personal reference.
attrs.rationale: Patient Platform breakdown (line 34). The PRD specifies no screen for this (open question).

nodes.title: Provider users view and accept latest legal content

attrs.statement: Provider users can view and accept the latest legal content.
attrs.rationale: Provider Platform breakdown (line 38) and Executive Summary (line 13: patients and providers accept the latest terms where applicable).

nodes.title: Providers see acceptance status of their organization's users, read-only

attrs.statement: Providers can review the acceptance status of their organization's users (read-only).
attrs.rationale: Provider Platform breakdown (line 39). The PRD specifies no screen for this (open question).

nodes.title: Admin configures acceptance rules: who must accept and when enforcement applies

attrs.statement: Admin configures acceptance rules: who must accept, and when enforcement applies.
attrs.rationale: Admin Platform breakdown (line 45), Main Flow step 3 (line 87: acceptance requirement scope), Edge Cases (line 311: rules configurable) and Success Criteria (line 388: when enforcement enabled). The PRD gives no screen or setting key for it (open question).

attrs.statement: System notifies the Admin when publication succeeds.
attrs.rationale: Communication Structure (line 59) and Main Flow step 5 (line 89).

nodes.title: Admin notified when acceptance thresholds are unmet

attrs.statement: System notifies the Admin when acceptance coverage thresholds are unmet.
attrs.rationale: Communication Structure (line 59). The threshold value is not stated.

nodes.title: Warning banner on the document list when pending acceptance is below threshold

attrs.statement: Screen 1 (Admin Legal Documents List, SCR-027-01) shows warning banners for pending acceptance coverage below threshold.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 notes (line 154).

nodes.title: Out of scope: real-time chat, legal counsel workflows, external e-signature

attrs.statement: Out of scope: real-time chat or legal counsel workflows; external e-signature platforms (future consideration).
attrs.rationale: Communication Structure, Out of Scope (lines 64-65). Boundary recorded as the PRD states it.

nodes.title: Cancellation Policy is read-only information and never needs acceptance

attrs.statement: Cancellation Policy is a read-only informational document that does NOT require user acceptance or consent confirmation. It is managed through the same versioning and publishing pipeline as other legal documents but the `Requires Acceptance` flag is always `No`. It is surfaced to patients in the quote acceptance context (FR-005) for transparency.
attrs.rationale: Executive Summary note (line 15) and Key Entities note (line 360). FR-005 owns the quote acceptance screens that surface it.

nodes.title: Requires Acceptance is tied to the Material Change flag

attrs.statement: Requires Acceptance indicates whether material change gating applies and is tied to the Material flag from the draft.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 Requires Acceptance field (line 140). Computes ENT-legal-document.requires_acceptance.

attrs.statement: Material includes changes to obligations, data use/sharing, user rights, or liability; Minor includes formatting, typo fixes, or clarifications without policy change. Only material changes require re-acceptance; Admin marks the publish accordingly.
attrs.rationale: CL-2 (line 350) and Edge Cases (line 311: non-material edits may not require re-acceptance; material changes do; rules configurable).

nodes.title: One Current version per document type; publishing archives the prior Current

attrs.statement: Only one Current version per document type at a time; publishing a new version auto-archives the prior Current.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 business rules (line 147) and Screen 1 Status validation (line 138). Restated by Main Flow step 4 (line 88: previous version archived) and Screen 3 business rule (line 204). Key Entities (line 359) says current version per locale (open question).

nodes.title: Scheduled effective date activates the version and starts prompts

attrs.statement: When Admin sets a future effective date, System schedules activation; on the effective date the new version becomes current and prompts begin.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A1 (lines 107-113) and Screen 3 business rule (line 204: publish sets status to Current on Effective Date). The status of a published version before its effective date is not stated (open question).

nodes.title: Admin can revert to the previous version with prompts updated and an audit entry

attrs.statement: When Admin reverts to the previous version due to an error, System marks the previous version current again, prompts update accordingly, and an audit entry is recorded.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B1 (lines 115-121). Revert is an audit action type (Key Entities line 365).

attrs.statement: Reverting a version preserves existing acceptance records; users accepted to the reverted version remain valid per policy.
attrs.rationale: Edge Cases (line 314). Which version 'the reverted version' names, and which policy decides validity, is not stated (open question).

nodes.title: Core actions blocked until acceptance; read-only where safe

attrs.statement: Block core actions until acceptance; allow read-only access where safe. Show rate-limited reminders. Gating occurs at sign-in and before core transactional flows.
attrs.rationale: CL-1 (line 349). Restated by Main Flow trigger and outcome (lines 95-96), User Story 2 scenario 1 (prompt before accessing core features), Success Criteria (line 388) and Assumptions (line 397).

nodes.title: Users with pending procedures keep read-only access until acceptance

attrs.statement: Existing users with pending procedures: allow read-only access until acceptance; surface prompts at safe checkpoints.
attrs.rationale: Edge Cases (line 312).

nodes.title: No further prompts after acceptance until the next required version

attrs.statement: After the user accepts, System resumes normal access without further prompts until the next required version.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 4 of User Accepts New Version (line 103) and User Story 2 scenario 2.

nodes.title: Missing localized version falls back to the primary language with a notice

attrs.statement: If a localized version is unavailable, default to the primary language and display a discreet notice.
attrs.rationale: CL-3 (line 351), Edge Cases (line 313: default to primary language if localized version not available) and Assumptions (line 398: missing locales default to primary language until added). Screen 3 names English (en-US) as the fallback. Meeting 3 item D06 (English is the default presentation language) is consistent with this.

nodes.title: Missing locale logs a task for the Admin

attrs.statement: Log a task to add the missing locale; log gaps for Admin.
attrs.rationale: CL-3 (line 351) and Edge Cases (line 313).

nodes.title: Acceptance using the fallback locale is valid

attrs.statement: Acceptance using the fallback is considered valid.
attrs.rationale: CL-3 (line 351).

nodes.title: Publishing needs complete English (en-US) content; other locales fall back to it

attrs.statement: When a version is published globally, the system validates that at least the English (en-US) locale content is complete. If other locales are configured for this version, the Admin UI will provide a summary of their completeness, but publishing will proceed using the English (en-US) version as the mandatory default fallback if a specific locale is missing or incomplete (as per CL-3).
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 business rule (line 207).

nodes.title: Version label unique per document type

attrs.statement: Version must be unique per document type.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 Version (line 137) and Screen 2 Version Label (line 172: must be unique per type).

nodes.title: Effective date cannot be in the past

attrs.statement: Effective Date must be today or in the future; it cannot be in the past.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 Effective Date (line 139: must be today or future) and Screen 2 Effective Date (line 171: cannot be in the past).

attrs.statement: Content must have at least 200 and at most 50,000 characters.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 Content (line 168: Min 200 chars; max 50k chars).

nodes.title: Change summary required, at most 500 characters

attrs.statement: Change Summary is required and is at most 500 characters.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 Change Summary (line 169).

nodes.title: Document type locked after version creation

attrs.statement: Document Type is locked after version creation.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 Document Type (line 166).

nodes.title: Material Change flag required to set acceptance gating

attrs.statement: Material Change is required to set acceptance gating.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 Material Change (line 170).

nodes.title: Locale must be a supported locale

attrs.statement: Locale must be a supported locale.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 Locale (line 136), Screen 2 Locale (line 167: multiple locales can exist for a single version) and Screen 4A Locale (line 256). Locale is for translation only, not regional content (REQ-027-008).

nodes.title: Drafts autosave; warn on unsaved changes

attrs.statement: Autosave drafts; warn on unsaved changes before exit.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules (line 176).

nodes.title: Effective date controls activation; content stays Draft until published

attrs.statement: Effective Date controls activation; content remains Draft until published.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules (line 178).

nodes.title: Edit opens only Draft versions; Current and Archived are view-only

attrs.statement: Edit action opens the Draft/Edit screen for Draft versions; Current/Archived versions are view-only (preview/history).
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 business rules (line 149). The Screen 1 Actions field (line 142) says Edit is shown for Draft/Archived versions (open question); the graph follows the business rule.

nodes.title: Publish disabled until the draft passes validation

attrs.statement: Publish is disabled unless the draft passes validation; the preview shows the effective date and Material Change exactly as set in the draft, and the version diff summary must be generated from the draft.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 Actions (line 142), Screen 3 Effective Date, Material Change, Version Diff Summary and Publish Button (lines 197-200).

nodes.title: Editor limits: headings, lists, links, tables; block quotes disabled

attrs.statement: Editor supports toolbar for headings, lists, links, tables; allows paste with cleanup; block quotes disabled to avoid nesting signatures.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 notes (line 184).

nodes.title: Preview shows how many users must re-accept

attrs.statement: Preview & Publish shows an acceptance impact summary (number of users who must re-accept).
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 notes (line 211). Computes ENT-legal-document.reaccept_user_count.

nodes.title: Acceptance Rate computed from the ledger; Pending Users are those who have not accepted

attrs.statement: Acceptance Rate is the % accepted, computed from the acceptance ledger; Pending Users are the users who haven't accepted.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 Acceptance Rate and Pending Users (lines 228-229). The population counted is not stated. Computes ENT-legal-document.acceptance_rate and pending_user_count.

nodes.title: Acceptance dashboard and detail data is read-only

attrs.statement: Acceptance dashboard and acceptance detail data is read-only.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 business rules (line 234), Screen 4 Published/Eff. Dates, Material Change and Reminders Sent (lines 226-230) and Screen 4A Acceptance Timestamp, Channel and Reminder Status (lines 257-259).

nodes.title: CSV export of pending users and the filtered acceptance list, limited by role and rate

attrs.statement: Admin can export the pending users list and the current filtered acceptance set as CSV; export is constrained by role permissions and rate limits.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 notes (line 239), Screen 4 Pending Users (line 229: supports pagination/export), Screen 4A Export (line 260) and business rules (line 266). The rate limit value is not stated.

nodes.title: Detail list mirrors dashboard filters and defaults to Pending

attrs.statement: Acceptance Detail List mirrors the filters from Screen 4, inherits the selected version and type, and defaults the status filter to Pending to focus on outstanding users.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4A Status Filter (line 255) and business rules (lines 264-265). Reached by drilldown from Pending Users or a View Details link (line 270); paginated and sortable by acceptance timestamp and user ID (line 271). Search and filter criteria are owned by FR-022 (REQ-022-111).

attrs.statement: User filter input (name, email or user ID) is sanitized.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4A User Filter (line 254).

nodes.title: Admin creates regional groupings with name, countries and location order

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to create regional groupings by selecting group name, countries, and location presentation order
attrs.rationale: Restated by Main Flow step 2-7 (113-124) and Screen 1 (331-347).

nodes.title: Admin configures starting price per location per currency

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to configure starting price estimates per location per currency
attrs.rationale: Restated by Main Flow: Admin Configures Starting Prices Per Location (185-213) and Screen 2 (367-384).

nodes.title: Regional grouping applied to the patient destination list by patient location

attrs.statement: System MUST apply regional grouping to patient destination list based on patient's location from profile or IP geolocation
attrs.rationale: Restated by Patient Entry Point (94-99) and Main Flow: Patient Views Personalized Location Recommendations, steps 2-6 (281-290). The patient screen is FR-003 Screen 2 (SCR-003-02). Overlaps REQ-003-032.

nodes.title: Starting price in the patient's currency, else the location's default currency converted

attrs.statement: System MUST display starting prices in patient's preferred currency, falling back to location's default currency with conversion if specific currency not configured
attrs.rationale: Restated by Main Flow step 7 (291-296), A6 (316-325) and the second edge case (748). The lookup order is REQ-028-039 and REQ-028-040. Overlaps REQ-003-033.

nodes.title: Configuration changes reach patient APIs within 1 minute by cache invalidation

attrs.statement: System MUST propagate configuration changes to patient-facing APIs within 1 minute via cache invalidation
attrs.rationale: Restated by Communication Structure (78), Entry Points (92), Main Flow step 10-11 (127-128), Screen 1 Cache Propagation (353), General Module Rule 4 (459: cache TTL = 60 seconds) and SC-009, SC-013. The system clears the location presentation cache on every save (step 10, A1 step 6, A2 step 4).

nodes.title: A country belongs to at most one regional grouping, enforced at configuration time

attrs.statement: System MUST prevent overlapping regional groupings by enforcing one-to-one mapping between country and regional grouping at configuration time
attrs.rationale: Restated by General Module Rule 1 (456: groupings MUST NOT overlap; blocks saves that would assign a country to two groupings), Main Flow step 4 (117-118), Screen 1 Unique Membership (351), the first edge case (746), SC-010 and the Change Log entry that removed overlapping-grouping priority logic (819). The error text is REQ-028-021.

nodes.title: Fallback pricing when the patient's currency is not configured

attrs.statement: System MUST support fallback pricing for locations when patient's specific currency is not configured
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 2 Fallback Priority (391: fallback prices apply when the patient's location-currency combination is not configured), A3 (217-228), A5 (306-314) and User Story 3 (694-706). Configuration steps are REQ-028-056.

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to preview how configurations will appear to patients from different regions before saving
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 2 Preview Mode (394), Screen 3 (419-448: Test Mode toggle) and User Story 5 (727-740: preview of unsaved changes, then Save and Apply turns the panel into Live Configuration).

nodes.title: Regional grouping stored with name, country list, location order and status

attrs.statement: System MUST store regional grouping configuration with grouping name, country list, location ordering, and status (active/inactive)
attrs.rationale: Restated by Key Entities, Entity 1 (800-802) and Screen 1 data fields (337-347).

nodes.title: Starting price stored with location, currency, amount, dates and fallback flag

attrs.statement: System MUST store starting price configuration with location, currency, amount, effective date, expiry date, and fallback flag
attrs.rationale: Restated by Key Entities, Entity 2 (804-806) and Screen 2 data fields (373-384).

nodes.title: Audit trail of every configuration change

attrs.statement: System MUST maintain audit trail of all configuration changes with admin user, timestamp, change reason, and change details
attrs.rationale: Restated by Data & Privacy Audit Rule (469), Main Flow step 12 (129) and 12 (213), Screen 1 Audit Trail (354: added/removed countries, reordered locations), Key Entities Entity 3 (808-810) and User Story 1 scenario 5 (671: admin views the audit log).

attrs.statement: System MUST retain pricing history for 3 years for trend analysis and compliance audit
attrs.rationale: Stated only here (780). Contradicted by the Retention Rule (470), which keeps pricing history for 10 years; see REQ-028-064. Both kept as written, conflict raised as a question.

nodes.title: Regional configuration restricted to admins with the System Configuration role

attrs.statement: System MUST restrict regional configuration and pricing management to admin users with "System Configuration" role (per FR-031)
attrs.rationale: Restated by Entry Points (91), Internal Dependencies FR-031 (558-560) and Security Considerations Authentication and Authorization (645-646: read-only roles cannot modify regional groupings or pricing).

nodes.title: Configuration changes logged with user id, timestamp, IP address, reason and details

attrs.statement: System MUST log all configuration changes with admin user ID, timestamp, IP address, change reason, and full change details for audit trail
attrs.rationale: Restated by Security Considerations Audit Trail (648: old value to new value). Extends REQ-028-011 with admin user ID and IP address.

attrs.statement: System MUST validate all admin inputs server-side (country codes, currency codes, positive pricing amounts) to prevent invalid configurations
attrs.rationale: Restated by Security Considerations Input Validation (649).

nodes.title: Admin configuration API rate-limited to 100 requests per minute per admin

attrs.statement: System MUST rate-limit admin configuration API to 100 requests/minute per admin user to prevent abuse
attrs.rationale: Restated by Security Considerations Rate Limiting (650).

nodes.title: Country selection uses the FR-026 country list

attrs.statement: System MUST integrate with FR-026 country list API for country selection in regional grouping configuration
attrs.rationale: Restated by Internal Dependencies FR-026 (542-544), Data Dependencies Entity 2 (572-574) and Integration 3 (630-633).

nodes.title: Currency validation and conversion rates come from FR-029

attrs.statement: System MUST integrate with FR-029 currency API for currency validation and conversion rate retrieval
attrs.rationale: Restated by Internal Dependencies FR-029 (554-556), Data Dependencies Entity 3 (576-578) and External Dependencies (564).

nodes.title: REST API gives patient apps location order and starting prices

attrs.statement: System MUST provide REST API for patient apps to fetch regional configuration (location ordering + starting prices) based on patient location and currency
attrs.rationale: Restated by Integration 1 (620-623).

nodes.title: Admin configuration API with role-based access control

attrs.statement: System MUST expose admin configuration API for CRUD operations on regional groupings and starting prices with role-based access control
attrs.rationale: Restated by Integration 2 (625-628) and Security Considerations Authorization (646).

nodes.title: Conflicting country assignment blocked with the conflicting groupings listed

attrs.statement: System MUST block selection or save of a country that already belongs to another regional grouping and MUST show the error "Each country can only belong to one regional grouping. Remove it from the other grouping first." together with the list of conflicting groupings.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 4 (118), Screen 1 Unique Membership (351) and the first edge case (746). The no-overlap rule itself is REQ-028-006.

nodes.title: Grouping needs at least one country

attrs.statement: System MUST NOT save a regional grouping with no country selected and MUST show "At least one country must be selected for this regional grouping."
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 4 and 8 (117, 125), B1 (156-163) and Screen 1 Countries validation (341).

nodes.title: Grouping needs at least one ordered destination

attrs.statement: System MUST NOT save a regional grouping without a destination order and MUST show "At least one destination must be ordered for this regional grouping."
attrs.rationale: B2 (165-172) and Screen 1 Location Order validation (342).

nodes.title: Every create, update and archive needs a change reason of 10-500 characters

attrs.statement: All create/update/archive actions require a change reason (10-500 chars). System MUST NOT save a regional grouping change or a price change without it and MUST show "Change reason is required (10-500 characters)."
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 7 (462), Main Flow steps 6 and 8 (123, 125), A1 step 4 (140), A2 step 3 (151), B3 (174-181), pricing steps 7 and 9 (204, 210), A3 step 5 (225), A4 step 6 (239), B5 (262-269) and the Change Reason fields of Screen 1 and Screen 2 (344, 384).

nodes.title: Grouping name unique and at most 100 characters; description at most 500

attrs.statement: A regional grouping name is required, MUST be unique and at most 100 characters; the description is optional (internal purpose of the grouping) and at most 500 characters.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 data fields Grouping Name and Description (339-340).

nodes.title: Editing an existing grouping follows the creation steps

attrs.statement: When an admin edits an existing regional grouping, System shows the current countries and location order, requires a change reason, and then validates, saves, clears the cache and confirms as for a new grouping; patients from the affected region see the updated order within 1 minute.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A1 (133-143).

nodes.title: Deleting a grouping warns, needs a reason and confirmation

attrs.statement: Before a regional grouping is deleted, System MUST warn "Deleting this grouping will affect patients from [X countries]. They will fall back to proximity-based destination ordering. Continue?" and the admin MUST enter a change reason and confirm.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A2 steps 2-3 (150-151).

nodes.title: Deleted groupings are archived, never permanently deleted

attrs.statement: Deleting a regional grouping MUST archive it (soft delete), never remove it permanently, so the audit trail stays complete; System clears the cache and confirms "Regional grouping archived. Patients from affected countries will now see proximity-based destination ordering."
attrs.rationale: A2 steps 4-5 (152-154) and Screen 1 Soft Delete (355).

nodes.title: Inactive groupings are retained but not applied

attrs.statement: Inactive regional groupings are retained in system but not applied to patient location presentation.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 6 (461) and Screen 1 Status field (343: Active applies to patients, Inactive is archived).

nodes.title: At most 50 regional groupings; soft limit with admin warning

attrs.statement: Maximum of 50 regional groupings to prevent administrative complexity (soft limit with admin warning).
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 5 (460) and Admin Editability, Fixed in Codebase (488).

nodes.title: Cache timing, currency decimal rules and the grouping limit are fixed in the codebase

attrs.statement: Cache propagation timing (1-minute TTL), currency decimal precision rules (2 decimals for major currencies, 0 for yen and won) and the maximum number of regional groupings (50) are fixed in the codebase and not editable by admin.
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability, Fixed in Codebase (484-488).

attrs.statement: Admins can edit regional grouping names, countries and location ordering; starting price amounts for any location-currency combination; fallback pricing configuration per location; regional grouping active or inactive status; price effective and expiry dates; and the number of locations displayed per regional grouping.
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability, Editable by Admin (475-482). Per-item behaviour is in the rules of this module; Admin Platform scope (61-67).

nodes.title: Number of locations displayed per grouping: default 10, range 5-20

attrs.statement: The number of locations displayed per regional grouping is configurable by admin: default 10, allowed range 5-20.
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability, Editable by Admin (482). No screen of this PRD shows the setting (question raised).

nodes.title: Default location ordering editable but must include every active provider location

attrs.statement: The default location ordering used when no regional grouping matches is editable by admin, but MUST include all active provider locations.
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability, Configurable with Restrictions (492). Conflicts in wording with REQ-028-035 (proximity ordering); question raised.

nodes.title: No matching grouping: destinations ordered by proximity

attrs.statement: If no regional grouping matches the patient's country (or a grouping was deleted or is inactive), System orders destinations by proximity to the patient's location (FR-003 default behavior) and shows all available destinations in that default order.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 Default Fallback (352), A5 steps 1-3 (306-314), A2 outcome (154) and the third edge case (750).

nodes.title: Configured order first; other locations after, by proximity

attrs.statement: System shows destinations in the matched grouping's configured order (first position first, second position second, and so on); locations not in the configured order appear at the end, ordered by proximity to the patient's location.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow: Patient Views Personalized Location Recommendations steps 5-6 (285-290) and Main Flow: Regional Presentation step 5 (119-121).

nodes.title: Destination list shows name, flag, starting price, description and provider count

attrs.statement: System displays each destination to the patient with the location name and flag, the starting price in the patient's currency ("Starting from £2,500"), a brief location description and the number of providers available in the location.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow: Patient Views Personalized Location Recommendations step 8 (297-301). The screen is FR-003 Screen 2 (SCR-003-02); the patient then selects destinations (step 9).

nodes.title: Patient currency from profile, else the location default

attrs.statement: System identifies the patient's currency preference from the patient profile or, when none is set, from the location default.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow: Patient Views Personalized Location Recommendations step 7 (292).

nodes.title: Starting price lookup order: specific, fallback, system-wide default

attrs.statement: For each displayed location System looks up the starting price for the location and currency combination: if specific pricing exists, display that price; if not, display the fallback price for the location (if configured); if there is no fallback, display the default starting price (system-wide default).
attrs.rationale: Main Flow: Patient Views Personalized Location Recommendations step 7 (293-296). Differs from REQ-028-040 and REQ-028-041 on the last step; question raised.

nodes.title: Missing price in the patient's currency: fallback, else converted location default price

attrs.statement: When the patient's currency has no pricing for the location, System checks for fallback pricing in the patient's currency; if none, it displays the price in the location's default currency with a conversion note ("Starting from €2,200 (approx. £2,500)") using the real-time exchange rate from the FR-029 currency service.
attrs.rationale: A6 (316-325) and the second edge case (748).

nodes.title: No price and no conversion: Price available on request, error logged, admin warned

attrs.statement: When no fallback is configured and currency conversion is unavailable, System displays the location without a starting price, shows the text "Price available on request" to the patient and logs an error for admin review; the admin dashboard shows "[Location] missing fallback pricing - patients seeing no price estimate."
attrs.rationale: Sixth edge case (756).

attrs.statement: Location ordering is strictly advisory for patient presentation - it does not restrict which locations patients can select or providers can serve.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 2 (457).

nodes.title: Starting prices are estimates and do not constrain provider quotes

attrs.statement: Starting prices are estimates only and do not constrain provider quote pricing. Providers can quote higher or lower than starting prices.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 3 (458) and Provider Platform scope (57: quote submission pricing is provider-controlled).

nodes.title: Patients only consume the configuration; providers have no interaction with it

attrs.statement: The Patient platform only consumes the admin-configured regional configuration and has no editing capability; the Provider platform has no direct interaction with regional configuration settings.
attrs.rationale: Multi-Tenant Breakdown, Patient Platform and Provider Platform (45-57).

nodes.title: Admin can enable or disable specific destinations for specific patient regions

attrs.statement: Admins can enable or disable specific destinations for specific patient regions.
attrs.rationale: Multi-Tenant Breakdown, Admin Platform (66). No screen, field or other rule of the PRD describes how; question raised.

nodes.title: Admin notified when regional configuration changes are saved

attrs.statement: System sends the admin a system notification when a regional configuration change is saved.
attrs.rationale: Communication Structure, In Scope (77). Whether price saves are included is not stated; question raised.

nodes.title: Out of scope: patient and provider notices and real-time exchange-rate pricing

attrs.statement: This module does not send patients notifications about pricing changes (general notification system), does not notify providers about regional configuration updates (providers are unaffected), and does not update prices in real time from exchange rates (FR-029).
attrs.rationale: Communication Structure, Out of Scope (80-84).

nodes.title: Pricing display only; no payment processing

attrs.statement: FR-028 configures pricing display only, not actual payment processing.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules, Payment & Billing Rules (497).

nodes.title: Entry points to regional configuration and pricing

attrs.statement: Admin reaches the configuration at Settings > General Settings (Location Presentation & Pricing), with the System Configuration permission (per FR-031), and changes take effect on save within the 1-minute cache propagation. Patient reaches it through the "Choose Your Destination" screen of the quote request flow, where System determines the patient's location from profile or IP geolocation, applies the regional configuration to filter and order the destinations, and shows starting prices in the patient's preferred currency.
attrs.rationale: Entry Points (86-99). The PRD names the tab three ways (90, 113, 193); question raised.

attrs.statement: After a successful save System confirms: "Regional grouping saved. Changes will be live for patients within 1 minute." for a grouping; "Starting price for [Location] in [Currency] set to [Amount]." for a price; "Fallback pricing enabled for [Location]. Patients from unconfigured countries will see these prices." for fallback pricing; "[X] currency prices updated for [Location]." for a bulk update.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 11 (128) and 11 (212), A3 step 7 (227), A4 step 8 (241) and Screen 2 bulk modal banner (415).

nodes.title: Pricing view shows configured currencies and marks missing ones Not Set

attrs.statement: After the admin selects a destination, System shows the current pricing configuration for it: the currencies with configured starting prices, with currencies that have no configured price marked "Not Set".
attrs.rationale: Main Flow: Starting Prices step 2-3 (195-198).

nodes.title: Currency list read-only from FR-029; no inline currency creation

attrs.statement: The currency dropdown for starting prices is populated from the FR-029 supported currency list (Settings > Billing Settings > Currency Management); currencies are not created or edited on this screen, and currency support must be configured in FR-029 before location pricing can be configured.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow: Starting Prices step 1 (194), Screen 2 notes (407-408) and Admin Editability, Configurable with Restrictions (493).

nodes.title: Only supported currencies; unsupported currency refused with a pointer to Currency Management

attrs.statement: Only currencies configured in the system can be selected for a starting price; when the admin tries to save a price for an unsupported currency System shows "[Currency] is not currently supported. Add currency to system first via Currency Management." and does not save the price.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow: Starting Prices step 9 (207), B4 (253-260) and Screen 2 Currency Validation (388).

nodes.title: Starting price must be a positive number greater than 0

attrs.statement: A starting price MUST be a positive number greater than 0; for a non-numeric or negative value System shows "Starting price must be a positive number." and does not save it, and shows the format guidance "Enter base starting price (e.g., 2500 for £2,500)".
attrs.rationale: Main Flow: Starting Prices steps 6 and 9 (202-208), B3 (244-251) and Screen 2 Positive Values Only (390).

attrs.statement: System enforces currency-appropriate decimal places for starting prices: 2 for GBP, EUR and USD, 0 for JPY and KRW.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow: Starting Prices step 9 (209), Screen 2 Decimal Precision (389).

attrs.statement: To set fallback pricing the admin goes to Location Pricing > Fallback Pricing, selects the destination, enables the fallback pricing option, enters the fallback price per currency and a change reason; System saves the fallback configuration.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A3 (217-228) and Screen 2 Fallback Price field (381). Application of fallback prices is REQ-028-007.

nodes.title: Bulk price update by percentage or fixed amount

attrs.statement: Admins can update all currency prices of one destination at once by a percentage increase or decrease or a fixed amount adjustment; System shows a preview of the new prices for all currencies, the admin enters a change reason and confirms, and System saves all currency price updates simultaneously.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A4 (230-242), Screen 2 Bulk Update (393) and User Story 4 (710-723).

attrs.statement: The bulk update modal has a method selector (percentage increase or decrease, or fixed amount adjustment), an adjustment value input that is numeric and may be negative for a decrease, an optional rounding rule (round to the nearest 5, 10 or 50 of the currency unit), a preview table of current versus new prices per currency, and a required change reason logged in the audit trail.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 notes, Bulk Update modal (409-415).

nodes.title: Bulk update action available only with a destination or rows selected

attrs.statement: The Bulk Update Pricing action is enabled only when a destination is selected (or at least one pricing row is selected) and requires a change reason inside the modal before apply.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 field Bulk Update Pricing (380) and notes (400).

nodes.title: Future effective date keeps current pricing active until then

attrs.statement: If a price's effective date is in the future, the current pricing remains active until the effective date; without an effective date pricing is effective immediately.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 Effective Dating (395) and field Price Effective Date (378).

nodes.title: Expiry date after effective date; admin warned 7 days before expiry

attrs.statement: A price expiry date, when set, MUST be after the effective date, and System warns the admin 7 days before the price expiry date.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 field Price Expiry Date (379) and Expiry Warning (396).

nodes.title: Price without expiry stays active indefinitely

attrs.statement: When an effective date is set without an expiry date, the pricing remains active indefinitely until the admin updates it or sets an expiry; System shows the info note "No expiry set - pricing active indefinitely." in the pricing table and enforces no automatic expiration.
attrs.rationale: Seventh edge case (758). What happens when a set expiry date passes is not stated; question raised.

nodes.title: Price history kept for audit and trend analysis

attrs.statement: System maintains the history of all price changes for audit and trend analysis.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 Price History (392). Retention periods are REQ-028-012 and REQ-028-064.

nodes.title: Pricing history and configuration audit logs retained 10 years

attrs.statement: Pricing history and configuration change audit logs are retained for 10 years (Constitution compliance).
attrs.rationale: Data & Privacy Retention Rule (470) and the Change Log entry on 10-year audit retention (819). Conflicts with REQ-028-012 (3 years for pricing history); question raised.

nodes.title: Patient location for matching is stored in the patient profile under PHI encryption

attrs.statement: Patient location data used for regional matching is stored in the patient profile, which is already compliant with the PHI encryption requirements (Principle II).
attrs.rationale: Data & Privacy Privacy Rule 1 (466).

nodes.title: Starting price estimates are public data; no encryption required

attrs.statement: Starting price estimates are public data and are not subject to encryption requirements; regional configuration data (location display rules and public pricing estimates) is not sensitive.
attrs.rationale: Data & Privacy Privacy Rule 2 (467) and Security Considerations Data Protection (647).

nodes.title: Pricing history names the admin, never patient-level pricing

attrs.statement: Pricing history includes the admin user who made each change for accountability, but not patient-level pricing data.
attrs.rationale: Data & Privacy Privacy Rule 3 (468).

nodes.title: Patient location data follows FR-001 GDPR requirements

attrs.statement: Patient location data handling follows the existing GDPR requirements of FR-001, with no additional requirements.
attrs.rationale: Data & Privacy GDPR Compliance (471).

nodes.title: Preview updates immediately when patient location or currency changes

attrs.statement: The location display preview updates immediately when the admin selects a different patient location or currency.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 Real-Time Preview (436) and User Story 5 scenarios 2-3 (738-739).

nodes.title: Preview shows which grouping and pricing rules were applied

attrs.statement: The preview shows which regional grouping and which pricing rules were applied for the simulated patient.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 Applied Config Display (437) and field Applied Regional Grouping (431).

nodes.title: Preview highlights locations using fallback pricing

attrs.statement: Locations using fallback pricing are visually distinguished in the preview (for example italic text or an info icon with the tooltip "Using fallback pricing - AUD pricing not configured for this location").
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 Fallback Highlighting (438), field Fallback Indicators (432) and User Story 3 scenario 3 (706).

nodes.title: Preview warns when a location has no price for the preview currency

attrs.statement: If any location has no pricing for the preview currency, the preview displays a warning.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 Missing Price Warning (439).

nodes.title: Preview shows the actual provider count per location

attrs.statement: The preview shows the number of available providers per location, using actual counts from the provider database.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 Provider Count Display (440).

nodes.title: Admin can refresh the preview manually

attrs.statement: The admin can manually refresh the preview to see the latest data after configuration changes.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 Refresh Button (441).

nodes.title: Preview inputs: a valid country and a currency defaulting to the location's currency

attrs.statement: The preview requires a patient country that is valid in the system and a patient currency preference, which defaults to the location's default currency.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 fields Preview Patient Location and Preview Currency (427-428).

nodes.title: Grouping screen aids: drag and drop, preview pane, flags, assigned countries marked

attrs.statement: The regional grouping screen provides a drag-and-drop interface for location ordering, a preview pane showing how patients from the selected countries will see the location list, country flags next to country names, and a disabled or visibly marked state (for example greyed out with the tooltip "Already assigned to [Grouping Name]") for countries already assigned to another grouping.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 notes (359-362) and Main Flow step 5 (120-122).

nodes.title: Grouping screen bulk actions: duplicate, export, import from template

attrs.statement: The regional grouping screen provides bulk actions: duplicate grouping, export configuration, and import from template.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 notes (363).

nodes.title: Pricing table: locations as rows, currencies as columns, missing prices highlighted

attrs.statement: The pricing screen shows a table with locations as rows and currencies as columns, highlights cells without configured pricing in yellow, and shows the last updated timestamp and admin name on hover for each price.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 notes (401-403).

attrs.statement: The pricing screen provides CSV import and export for bulk pricing updates; an export includes all location-currency combinations with their prices and last updated timestamps.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 notes (404) and User Story 2 scenario 6 (690).

nodes.title: Exchange rate reference and price calculator for admins

attrs.statement: The pricing screen displays an exchange rate reference for admin guidance from the FR-029 currency service, and a calculator that suggests prices for other currencies from a price entered in one currency, based on exchange rates.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 notes (405-406).

nodes.title: Preview aids: side-by-side comparison, tooltips, Test Mode, cache status

attrs.statement: The preview screen lets the admin compare two patient locations side by side, shows a tooltip explaining why a location is in its position (the regional grouping rule), provides a Test Mode toggle to see changes without saving them, and shows a cache status indicator with the time patient-facing data was last refreshed.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 notes (445-448).

nodes.title: Concurrent edits: last save wins, with an overwrite warning

attrs.statement: Concurrent admin edits of one regional grouping use optimistic locking: the last save wins, and when the configuration changed since the admin opened the edit screen System warns "This grouping was modified by [Admin Name] at [Time]. Your changes will overwrite theirs. Continue?"
attrs.rationale: Fourth edge case (752).

nodes.title: Provider location changes keep grouping references; permanently removed locations are flagged

attrs.statement: System keeps location references in regional groupings even when a provider is deactivated, and the ordering applies again if the provider reactivates; when a location is permanently removed from the system, the grouping edit screen warns "[Location] is no longer active. Remove from ordering?"
attrs.rationale: Fifth edge case (754).

nodes.title: Deleted grouping: cached sessions served up to 60 seconds, then default ordering, no errors

attrs.statement: When a regional grouping is deleted while patients are viewing destinations, cached data serves existing sessions for up to 60 seconds; after cache expiry patients see the default location ordering, with no errors displayed to patients.
attrs.rationale: Third edge case (750).

nodes.title: Configuration unavailable: default ordering and pricing

attrs.statement: If the regional configuration is unavailable, System falls back to default location ordering and pricing.
attrs.rationale: Integration 1 error handling (623).

nodes.title: Pricing destination must be a valid location in the system

attrs.statement: The destination location chosen for a starting price MUST be a valid location in the system.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 field Destination Location (375).

nodes.title: Allow admins to add, edit, and manage multiple Stripe accounts with API credentials

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to add, edit, and manage multiple Stripe accounts with API credentials (publishable key, secret key, webhook secret)
attrs.rationale: Also stated by the Add Stripe Account flow and Screen 1.

nodes.title: Allow admins to assign Stripe accounts to specific countries or regional groupings

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to assign Stripe accounts to specific countries or regional groupings (multi-select assignment)

nodes.title: Validate Stripe API credentials by testing connection to Stripe API before activating...

attrs.statement: System MUST validate Stripe API credentials by testing connection to Stripe API before activating account
attrs.rationale: Restates Screen 1 rule on credential validation and the Add Stripe Account flow step 5.

nodes.title: Route payment transactions to appropriate Stripe account based on patient's country...

attrs.statement: System MUST route payment transactions to appropriate Stripe account based on patient's country location
attrs.rationale: Routing basis is under product owner decision (patient country selected during booking, profile country, or billing/payment context). Restated by Payment Rule 1.

nodes.title: Support multiple currencies per Stripe account and allow admins to configure supported...

attrs.statement: System MUST support multiple currencies per Stripe account and allow admins to configure supported currencies

nodes.title: Allow admins to manage rate sources

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to manage rate sources (add, edit, delete) where each source bundles a provider type (xe.com, fixer.io) with its API credentials. Source creation requires a successful test connection before saving. Source deletion is blocked if currency pairs reference it; admin must reassign or convert affected pairs first.
attrs.rationale: Deletion of a referenced source is contradicted inside the PRD; see product owner decision.

nodes.title: Allow admins to set a global default markup percentage

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to set a global default markup percentage (0-20% range) and optionally override it per currency pair (0-20% range). If a pair has no per-pair markup, the global default applies.
attrs.rationale: Restated by REQ-029-038 (validation) and Screen 2A, 2B.

nodes.title: Fetch currency conversion rates automatically for each auto-fetch pair on its...

attrs.statement: System MUST fetch currency conversion rates automatically for each auto-fetch pair on its configured sync schedule (per-pair or inherited global frequency). Manual-mode pairs are not synced.

nodes.title: Calculate and display the effective rate for each pair as

attrs.statement: System MUST calculate and display the effective rate for each pair as: Base Rate × (1 + Markup %). This effective rate is applied to patient-facing prices.
attrs.rationale: Calculates the effective rate of a pair.

nodes.title: Allow admins to configure a global rate protection threshold

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to configure a global rate protection threshold (1-50% range). System monitors each auto-fetch pair independently and marks the pair's status as yellow/warning and sends an alert notification when the pair's rate changes more than the threshold within 24 hours.

nodes.title: Require a successful "Test Connection & Fetch Rate" action before saving any new...

attrs.statement: System MUST require a successful "Test Connection & Fetch Rate" action before saving any new auto-fetch currency pair. The Save button is disabled until this test succeeds.

nodes.title: Gracefully handle per-pair rate source failures by keeping the last successfully...

attrs.statement: System MUST gracefully handle per-pair rate source failures by keeping the last successfully fetched rate, marking the pair's status as red/error on the pair list, and alerting admin. If a source is deleted, all pairs referencing it MUST gracefully switch to manual mode with the last fetched rate pre-filled.
attrs.rationale: Retry and backoff are in the sync-retry rule; contradiction on deletion of a source in use is in product owner decision.

nodes.title: Allow admins to configure deposit rate percentage

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to configure deposit rate percentage (20-30% range) globally for all providers

nodes.title: Allow admins to configure provider-specific deposit rates that override global default...

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to configure provider-specific deposit rates that override global default for selected providers

nodes.title: Apply deposit rate changes to new bookings only

attrs.statement: System MUST apply deposit rate changes to new bookings only (existing bookings retain original deposit rate)
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 3 and Screen 4 rules.

nodes.title: Calculate deposit amount by multiplying booking total by configured deposit rate...

attrs.statement: System MUST calculate deposit amount by multiplying booking total by configured deposit rate percentage
attrs.rationale: Restated by Payment Rule 4 (rounded to 2 decimal places).

nodes.title: Allow admins to enable or disable split payment

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to enable or disable split payment (installment) feature globally

nodes.title: Allow admins to select available installment options

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to select available installment options (2-9 installments) via multi-select checkboxes

nodes.title: Allow admins to configure cutoff days

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to configure cutoff days (30-90 day range) requiring full payment completion before procedure date
attrs.rationale: The PRD gives a default of 30 days (Screen 4).

nodes.title: Allow admins to configure minimum booking amount

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to configure minimum booking amount ($100-$10,000 range) required to qualify for installments
attrs.rationale: Stated in USD; see product owner decision on the currency of the minimum.

nodes.title: Automatically calculate available installment options based on booking date, procedure...

attrs.statement: System MUST automatically calculate available installment options based on booking date, procedure date, and cutoff days
attrs.rationale: Restated by Payment Rule 5 and Screen 4.

nodes.title: Generate installment payment schedules using equal-split amounts

attrs.statement: System MUST generate installment payment schedules using equal-split amounts: booking total ÷ installment count (rounded to 2 decimal places; last installment absorbs rounding difference)
attrs.rationale: Restated by Billing Rule 1 and Screen 4. Rounding to 2 decimal places conflicts with currencies of 0 minor units; see product owner decision.

nodes.title: Allow admins to configure late payment grace period

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to configure late payment grace period (0-14 days) before booking cancellation

System MUST persist all payment configuration data (Stripe accounts, rate sources, currency pairs, global conversion settings, deposit rates, commission global default, provider-specific commission scopes, split payment rules) with full audit history

nodes.title: Log all payment configuration changes to audit trail with admin ID, timestamp, IP...

attrs.statement: System MUST log all payment configuration changes to audit trail with admin ID, timestamp, IP address, and before/after state
attrs.rationale: Restates General Rule 2, Audit Rule and the commission audit bullet. The audit configuration type list omits rate sources and currency management; see product owner decision.

nodes.title: Cache payment configuration data with 5-minute TTL to minimize database queries during...

attrs.statement: System MUST cache payment configuration data with 5-minute TTL to minimize database queries during payment processing
attrs.rationale: Restates General Rule 3 and the 5-minute propagation bullets of Screens 1, 3, 4, 5 and REQ-029-036.

nodes.title: Retain payment configuration audit history for minimum 10 years for financial compliance

attrs.statement: System MUST retain payment configuration audit history for minimum 10 years for financial compliance
attrs.rationale: Restates the Data Retention rule.

nodes.title: Encrypt Stripe API secret keys and webhook secrets at rest using AES-256 encryption

attrs.statement: System MUST encrypt Stripe API secret keys and webhook secrets at rest using AES-256 encryption
attrs.rationale: Restates Privacy Rule 1.

nodes.title: Never log Stripe secret keys in plain text to audit logs or error logs

attrs.statement: System MUST never log Stripe secret keys in plain text to audit logs or error logs (mask all but last 4 characters)
attrs.rationale: Restates Privacy Rule 2.

attrs.statement: System MUST require elevated admin permissions ("PaymentConfigAdmin" role) to access payment configuration functionality
attrs.rationale: Restates Privacy Rule 3 and the Authorization security note.

attrs.statement: System MUST use TLS 1.3 for all connections to Payment Configuration API (no plain HTTP allowed)

nodes.title: Comply with PCI DSS Level 1 requirements for payment data handling

attrs.statement: System MUST comply with PCI DSS Level 1 requirements for payment data handling
attrs.rationale: Restates the Compliance Rule.

nodes.title: Provide RESTful API for Payment Processing Service to query payment configuration

attrs.statement: System MUST provide RESTful API for Payment Processing Service to query payment configuration (Stripe accounts, currency pair effective rates, deposit rates, effective commission settings, installment rules)

nodes.title: Integrate with external currency conversion rate APIs

attrs.statement: System MUST integrate with external currency conversion rate APIs (xe.com, fixer.io) via HTTP GET requests, using credentials stored per rate source

nodes.title: Send email notifications to admins for payment configuration changes and rate...

attrs.statement: System MUST send email notifications to admins for payment configuration changes and rate protection alerts

nodes.title: Propagate payment configuration changes to Payment Processing Service within 5 minutes...

attrs.statement: System MUST propagate payment configuration changes to Payment Processing Service within 5 minutes maximum (cache TTL)

nodes.title: Validate deposit rate percentage is within allowed range

attrs.statement: System MUST validate deposit rate percentage is within allowed range (20-30%) and display error if out of range
attrs.rationale: Restated by Alternative flow B3 and Screen 3.

nodes.title: Validate markup percentage is within allowed range

attrs.statement: System MUST validate markup percentage is within allowed range (0-20%) and display error if out of range

nodes.title: Validate cutoff days is within allowed range

attrs.statement: System MUST validate cutoff days is within allowed range (30-90 days) and display error if out of range

nodes.title: Prevent deletion of Stripe accounts with transactions in last 90 days

attrs.statement: System MUST prevent deletion of Stripe accounts with transactions in last 90 days (archive instead)
attrs.rationale: Restates General Rule 5, the Screen 1 delete rule and the edge case on deletion with recent transactions. The Screen 3 deposit-rate delete rule (provider-specific rate with active bookings) and Rule 5 for split rules are folded into REQ-029-041.

nodes.title: Prevent modification of deposit rates or split payment rules for bookings with active...

attrs.statement: System MUST prevent modification of deposit rates or split payment rules for bookings with active references (changes apply to new bookings only)
attrs.rationale: Restates Screen 3 and Screen 4 rules on bookings with active references, Rule 5 and the Screen 3 rule on deleting a provider-specific rate with active bookings (archive instead).

nodes.title: Display warning if admin configures aggressive cutoff date that may limit installment...

attrs.statement: System MUST display warning if admin configures aggressive cutoff date that may limit installment availability
attrs.rationale: Restated by alternative flow B4 and the Screen 4 warning for cutoff over 60 days.

nodes.title: Allow admins to configure both the platform commission global default

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to configure both the platform commission global default (percentage only, allowed range 15-25%) and provider-specific commission scopes (Percentage model 0-100% or Flat Rate model with a fixed amount > 0 per completed procedure) in Screen 5; changes apply to new bookings only and existing bookings retain the commission snapshot captured at booking confirmation

System MUST lock currency conversion rates (including markup) at FR-005 subquote acceptance, store them in the acceptance snapshot, and copy them to the booking and its transactions (no rate fluctuation after subquote acceptance)
attrs.rationale: Restates Rule 1(a) and Currency Rule 2. Likely duplicate of REQ-005-017 (FR-005).

nodes.title: Snapshot the effective commission model and value

attrs.statement: System MUST snapshot the effective commission model and value (and Flat Rate currency), with the source configuration ID and scope type, at booking confirmation and store it per booking/transaction for payout and reconciliation consistency; Flat Rate snapshots are deducted once per completed procedure
attrs.rationale: Restates the Commission Rule of Payment and Billing Rules.

nodes.title: Verify Stripe webhook signatures for all incoming webhook events using the configured...

attrs.statement: System MUST verify Stripe webhook signatures for all incoming webhook events using the configured webhook secret
attrs.rationale: Restates Privacy Rule 4.

attrs.statement: System MUST validate commission values by model: global default and provider Percentage within allowed ranges (15-25% global, 0-100% provider) and provider Flat Rate amount greater than 0 with an enabled currency, displaying an error and rejecting the save otherwise (client-side and server-side)

nodes.title: Keep each provider in at most one active provider-specific commission scope with at...

attrs.statement: System MUST keep each provider in at most one active provider-specific commission scope with at most one pending future-dated configuration (a new one replaces it); an FR-015 Tab 7 edit to a provider in a shared scope MUST split that provider into its own single-provider scope without changing the other providers
attrs.rationale: Restated by the one-active-scope-per-provider and scheduled configuration rules of Screen 5.

nodes.title: Lock payment configuration only at its named lock points

attrs.statement: System MUST lock payment configuration only at its named lock points: the currency conversion rate at FR-005 subquote acceptance; the commission configuration, deposit rate, and split payment settings at FR-006 booking confirmation; nothing at quote creation or sending
attrs.rationale: Near duplicate of the lock-points rule (Rule 1) and REQ-029-044.

nodes.title: Calculate the Percentage commission, deposit amount, and installment split from the...

attrs.statement: System MUST calculate the Percentage commission, deposit amount, and installment split from the booking total, defined as the accepted subquote price after promotion, in the quote currency, read from the acceptance snapshot and never recomputed from the live quote

System MUST present any pre-confirmation commission (including the FR-004 quote screen) as an indicative model and value labelled "indicative, final at booking confirmation"; only the booking-confirmation snapshot is authoritative
attrs.rationale: Indicative commission also stated by the Indicative Commission Rule. The FR-004 quote screen is owned by FR-004.

nodes.title: Block disabling a currency while any non-terminal sent quote, unpaid accepted booking,...

attrs.statement: System MUST block disabling a currency while any non-terminal sent quote, unpaid accepted booking, or open booking or instalment plan uses it, and MUST show the admin the count of records still using that currency.
attrs.rationale: Overlaps the warn-and-resolution-path rule of Screen 6.

nodes.title: Create a new FR-026 Quote Configuration version whenever the Default Currency changes

attrs.statement: System MUST create a new FR-026 Quote Configuration version whenever the Default Currency changes; open quote drafts MUST keep their typed numbers, switch to the new currency without conversion, and require the provider to acknowledge a currency-change banner (FR-004 quote screen) before send.

nodes.title: Calculate commission on the price after promotion for every discount type, including...

attrs.statement: System MUST calculate commission on the price after promotion for every discount type, including discounts funded only by Hairline.

nodes.title: Support an optional Stripe account marked as Global Fallback used only when no...

attrs.statement: System MUST support an optional Stripe account marked as Global Fallback used only when no country/regional grouping mapping exists (at most 1 Global Fallback account)
attrs.rationale: Restated by Payment Rule 2 and Screen 1 Global Fallback validation.

nodes.title: Allow admins to create and manage currency pairs

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to create and manage currency pairs (CRUD), where each pair has USD as the mandatory base currency and a configurable rate mode: auto-fetch (from a configured source) or manual input (admin-entered base rate).

nodes.title: Allow admins to set a global default sync frequency

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to set a global default sync frequency (1h, 3h, 6h, 12h, 24h) and optionally override it per auto-fetch currency pair. If an auto-fetch pair has no per-pair sync frequency, the global default applies. Each pair's sync schedule is calculated from the time it was saved (e.g., saved at 12:36 with 6h interval → next sync at 18:36).
attrs.rationale: Calculates the next scheduled sync of an auto-fetch pair from the save timestamp plus the configured interval.

nodes.title: For any currency not configured as a pair, the system MUST fall back to collecting...

attrs.statement: For any currency not configured as a pair, the system MUST fall back to collecting payment in USD (no conversion attempted). The admin dashboard MUST display a note informing admins of this fallback behavior.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 2A rules and Payment Rule 3 context.

nodes.title: Keep provider-specific commission models and values synchronized between FR-029 Screen...

attrs.statement: System MUST keep provider-specific commission models and values synchronized between FR-029 Screen 5 and FR-015 Tab 7 because both screens are valid admin management surfaces for the same provider-specific commission data

Admin-initiated: Admin accesses "Payment Configuration" section from admin dashboard settings menu System-triggered: Payment Processing Service queries payment configuration during every booking transaction API-accessed: External integrations (if authorized) can query currency conversion rates via read-only API Scheduled jobs: Currency conversion rate sync runs on scheduled intervals (e.g., every 6 hours) to update cached rates Alert-triggered: Rate protection system alerts admins when currency fluctuations exceed configured thresholds
attrs.rationale: Entry points to FR-029 (PRD Entry Points).

nodes.title: Patients and providers cannot configure payments

attrs.statement: Patients cannot view or modify payment system configuration settings Providers have no direct interaction with payment system configuration

nodes.title: Patient payments collected into the regional Stripe account

attrs.statement: Patient payments are collected into the Stripe account mapped to the patient’s region; provider payouts are later executed in FR-017 using those funds (provider bank details in FR-032). Providers do not configure Stripe accounts here.
attrs.rationale: Payout execution is owned by FR-017; provider bank details by FR-032.

attrs.statement: Email notifications to admins when payment configuration changes are published System alerts when currency conversion rates exceed configured thresholds (rate protection) Admin dashboard notifications for Stripe account connection failures or API errors Audit log notifications for payment configuration changes requiring compliance review

Patient notifications about payment configuration changes (handled by P-03: Booking & Payment module) Provider notifications about payout schedule changes (handled by separate provider payout module) SMS notifications for payment failures or processing issues (handled by S-03: Notification Service; no SMS is sent in MVP and this channel is reserved for future implementation once S-03 SMS delivery is enabled) In-app chat or support messaging (handled by separate support module)

nodes.title: Email to affected providers on provider-specific deposit change

attrs.statement: System sends email notification to affected providers (if provider-specific change)

System displays confirmation message: "Deposit rate updated. New bookings will use [X]% deposit rate." System displays confirmation message: "Commission settings updated. New bookings will use the new effective commission configuration." System displays confirmation message: "Split payment options updated. Patients will see [X] installment options."

nodes.title: Stripe credential failure shows error and highlights fields

attrs.statement: Admin must choose "Override" to replace existing assignment (no secondary accounts; one account per country/regional grouping)
attrs.rationale: Edge case (PRD line 1140): if the admin overrides, the most recently configured account serves the overlapping country; the conflict resolution is logged to the audit trail.
