nodes.title: Cases auto-created with Patient App source and Patient submitter

attrs.statement: System MUST automatically create support cases in FR-034 with Ticket Source = "Patient App" and Submitter Type = "Patient" on form submission (FR-034 REQ-034-021, REQ-034-024)
attrs.rationale: Restated by General Module Rule 3 (line 455), Screen 1 rules (249), Screen 3 rules (372), A3 step 5 (161) and the Submit Button (435).

nodes.title: Cases linked to the patient by session

attrs.statement: System MUST link patient-submitted cases to patient records using logged-in patient session (FR-034 REQ-034-024)
attrs.rationale: A3 step 6 (162) and the Submit Button (435: links to the patient record via session). Patient session provides the patient ID (Dependencies FR-001, 543-545).

attrs.statement: System MUST display 8 patient-visible categories: Technical Issue, Account Access, Payment Question, Booking Issue, General Inquiry, Feature Request, Bug Report, Feedback (FR-034 REQ-034-030; "Provider Support" and "Patient Support" excluded as admin-internal)
attrs.rationale: Provider Support and Patient Support are admin-internal categories and are not shown to patients (372, 431). Business assumption: eight categories are sufficient for launch (600). Category visibility and fixed-list wording are in dispute, see REQ-035-076.

attrs.statement: System MUST support file attachments up to 10 MB per file, maximum 5 files per case, formats: JPG, PNG, PDF, DOC, DOCX (FR-034 REQ-034-036/037)
attrs.rationale: Fixed in the codebase (482). Screen 5 Attachments (434: thumbnail preview with remove option) and Screen 4 Attachment Button (403) carry the same limits. Per-submission versus per-case counting is open, see REQ-035-032.

attrs.statement: System MUST virus-scan all patient-uploaded files before acceptance
attrs.rationale: Restated by Privacy Rule 4 (line 464), Screen 5 Attachments (434) and the Virus Scanning dependency (558-561). Mechanics: REQ-035-058 to REQ-035-060.

attrs.statement: System MUST display patient's submitted support tickets with case ID, title, status (Open/In Progress/Resolved/Closed), priority, submitted date, and last updated timestamp
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 Ticket Card (359-365): case ID in subdued style, bold title truncated to 1-2 lines, colour-coded status badge (Open blue, In Progress amber, Resolved green, Closed grey), colour-coded priority badge (Low grey, Medium blue, High orange, Urgent red), short submitted date, relative last-updated time. Main A4 step 2 (175).

attrs.statement: System MUST support ticket filtering by status: All, Open, In Progress, Resolved, Closed
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 Filter Chips (358) and rules (371): All is the default; Resolved and Closed are separate chips because Resolved cases still accept patient replies during the 7-day auto-closure window while Closed cases are read-only (FR-034 REQ-034-003). All shows every status.

nodes.title: Full communication thread with sender labels

attrs.statement: System MUST display full communication thread for each ticket showing all messages from patient and admin with sender labels and timestamps
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 Communication Thread (397-400): chronological, scrollable, newest message at the bottom, sender label You for patient messages and Support Team for admin replies, plain-text body, relative or absolute timestamp; attachments are viewable full-size or downloadable (401). Empty thread shows Your case has been submitted. Our team will respond within 24 hours. (406).

nodes.title: Reply allowed unless the case is Closed

attrs.statement: System MUST allow patients to reply to admin messages when case is Open, In Progress, or Resolved (FR-034 REQ-034-026); reply input hidden only for Closed cases
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 4 Reply Input Field (402), Screen 4 rules (410) and Send Reply Button (404: hidden for Closed cases). Critical for healthcare: patients must be able to report that a resolved issue has recurred (410).

nodes.title: Reply to a Resolved case reopens it

attrs.statement: System MUST automatically reopen Resolved cases to Open status when patient sends a reply
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 4 Reply Input Field (402), rules (411) and A5 steps 4-6 (192-194): the patient sees the status badge update immediately and the admin receives support.case_user_reply.

attrs.statement: System MUST display auto-closure countdown on Resolved tickets showing remaining days before automatic closure (FR-034 REQ-034-061)
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 Auto-Closure Countdown (394): text This case will close in X days if no further reply, shown only when status is Resolved, hidden for Open, In Progress and Closed; period is configurable 3, 7 or 14 days, default 7 (FR-034 REQ-034-061). A5 step 2 (190). Governed by SET-support-case-auto-closure-period.

attrs.statement: System MUST display resolution summary when admin has provided one (FR-034 REQ-034-059, REQ-034-060)
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 Resolution Summary (395): read-only, shown only when status is Resolved or Closed and the admin entered a summary, displayed prominently above the thread under a Resolution header; also emailed on the change to Resolved (see REQ-035-070).

nodes.title: Feedback Resolution shown for feedback cases

attrs.statement: System MUST display Feedback Resolution status (Implemented, Planned, Declined, Under Review) for feedback/feature request/bug report cases when set by admin (FR-034 REQ-034-006)
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 Feedback Resolution (396) and rules (415): shown only for feedback, feature request or bug report categories and only when the admin has set a value; values Implemented, Planned, Declined, Under Review.

nodes.title: Internal admin notes hidden from patients

attrs.statement: System MUST hide internal admin notes from patient view — only messages explicitly sent to the patient are visible (FR-034 REQ-034-013, REQ-034-046)
attrs.rationale: Restated by Privacy Rule 2 (line 462) and Screen 4 rules (414).

attrs.statement: System MUST require patient authentication to access Help Center content, submit support requests, and view tickets
attrs.rationale: Security Considerations Authentication (639) and Dependencies FR-001 (544).

nodes.title: Patients see only their own cases

attrs.statement: System MUST ensure patients can only view their own support cases — no access to other patients' cases
attrs.rationale: Security Considerations Authorization (640). See also REQ-035-072 for the wider access statement (Privacy Rule 3, 463).

nodes.title: Encryption in transit and at rest

attrs.statement: System MUST encrypt all patient data in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest
attrs.rationale: Security Considerations Encryption (641) and Privacy Rule 4 (464: file attachments are encrypted at rest).

nodes.title: Helpfulness feedback stores no patient identity

attrs.statement: System MUST aggregate "Was this helpful?" feedback without storing individual patient identity (FR-033 Privacy Rule 2)
attrs.rationale: Privacy Rule 1 (line 461) and Screen 2 rules (339: feedback responses do not store individual patient identity). Near-duplicate of REQ-035-007, kept as both are PRD lines.

nodes.title: Content from FR-033 API within 1 minute

attrs.statement: System MUST consume patient-specific Help Center content from FR-033 REST API with content updates reflected within 1 minute of admin publishing
attrs.rationale: Restated by General Module Rule 4 (line 456), Screen 2 rules (340), Dependencies FR-033 (533) and Implementation Notes caching (609: cache invalidation respects the 1-minute propagation SLA).

nodes.title: Cases created through the FR-034 API

attrs.statement: System MUST create support cases via FR-034 Ticketing API on patient form submission
attrs.rationale: Dependencies FR-034 (536-537) and A3 step 5 (161).

nodes.title: Status updates, replies and resolutions received from FR-034

attrs.statement: System MUST receive and display case status updates, admin replies, and resolution summaries from FR-034
attrs.rationale: Communication Structure (79) and Dependencies FR-034 (537): the patient views case status, thread and replies within FR-035 screens; all case management stays in FR-034.

attrs.statement: System MUST trigger patient notifications via FR-020/S-03 for case status changes, admin replies, and case closure
attrs.rationale: Shared Services (66-70): email on status changes Open to In Progress, In Progress to Resolved and Resolved to Closed, on admin replies and on closure when the auto-closure period expires; push and email per Screen 4 rules (416); events support.case_status_changed, support.case_resolved, support.case_closed and support.case_user_reply routed through FR-020/S-03 (541). Patient reply notifies the admin (REQ-035-065).

attrs.statement: System MUST support file attachments with [NEEDS CLARIFICATION: FR-034 REQ-034-036 specifies "maximum 5 files per case" — confirm whether the 5-file limit is per-submission or cumulative across the entire case lifecycle (initial submission + all replies)]
attrs.rationale: Marked [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] in the PRD; the same open point is flagged on Screen 4 Attachment Button (403) and Screen 5 Attachments (434). The fixed-in-codebase list says max 5 files per case (482).

nodes.title: Entry points to the patient Help Center

attrs.statement: Patient navigates to "Help & Support" from Settings screen (FR-026 / P01.2-S1); in-app deep link from other screens (e.g., contextual help links from booking, payment, or aftercare screens); push notification tap (e.g., tapping a case status change notification navigates to Ticket Detail).
attrs.rationale: Entry Points (lines 96-98). Also Multi-Tenant Breakdown (48) and Dependencies FR-026 (547-549: the Settings screen has a Help & Support menu item linking to Screen 1).

nodes.title: Provider and admin platforms have no patient Help Center screens

attrs.statement: Provider Platform: not applicable (providers access help via FR-032). Admin Platform: not applicable (admins manage content via FR-033, manage tickets via FR-034).
attrs.rationale: Multi-Tenant Architecture (40-41) and Multi-Tenant Breakdown (59, 63). Admin actions that reach the patient: publishing or unpublishing content (FR-033), responding to cases and updating status (FR-034) (64). Ownership boundary recorded as stated.

nodes.title: Timestamps in the user's local timezone

attrs.statement: All timestamps displayed in user's local timezone
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 5 (line 457).

nodes.title: Help search covers published patient-audience content, ranked by relevance

attrs.statement: Search covers all published patient-audience articles and FAQs; results are ranked by relevance; if no results match, show a "Contact Support" prompt. Full-text search is required for P1 and must not be downgraded to browse-only behavior.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 rules (247), Screen 1 Search Bar (236), Screen 2 rules (338), Alternative Flow A1 (134-136). Scope of searched content is described differently on Screen 1 (FAQ and articles) and Screen 2 and A1 (all four content types): see product owner decision list.

nodes.title: Help search suggests results while typing

attrs.statement: Full-text search, relevance ordering, and inline suggestions are required for the patient Help Center MVP scope.
attrs.rationale: Implementation Notes Search (611), promoted. Screen 2 Search Bar (264): auto-suggests results while typing, scoped to the patient audience, required for P1. Results appear inline or on a separate results screen (236).

nodes.title: Contact Support offered when help does not answer

attrs.statement: Patient taps No on Was this helpful? or sees no search results; System displays Still need help? Contact Support CTA; Patient taps Contact Support; System displays Contact Support form (Screen 5).
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A2 (141-148), Screen 2 Article Detail Contact Support CTA (295: conditional on tapping No), General Content List No Results State (331: No results for '[query]'. Try different keywords or Contact Support.) and Screen 2 rules (338: empty search results must always surface a Contact Support path).

nodes.title: Emergency Contact Section always visible on the Hub

attrs.statement: Emergency contact section is a healthcare UX best practice for post-procedure patient safety; it must always be visible — it cannot be hidden or require scrolling past it. The section must remain visible regardless of scroll position (sticky or always rendered); emergency phone is read-only with tap-to-call on mobile and emergency email is read-only with tap-to-compose on mobile.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 rules (248, marked [Design Addition: not in FR-033/FR-034]) and Screen 1 fields Emergency Contact Section, Emergency Phone, Emergency Email (240-242). Main Flow step 2 (114) lists the section on the Hub.

nodes.title: Emergency phone and email configured by admin

attrs.statement: Emergency phone and email values should be configurable by admin via FR-026 (App Settings) or a future dedicated FR.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 rules (248), Admin Editability (474: configurable via FR-026) and Business Process Assumption 3 (599: values are configured by admin before FR-035 goes live). Owner of the two settings is FR-026 as the PRD names it; wording allows a future dedicated FR, see product owner decision list.

nodes.title: My Support Tickets badge counts open and in-progress tickets

attrs.statement: "My Support Tickets" badge count reflects open + in-progress tickets only; hidden when count is 0
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 rules (250) and My Support Tickets row (239: badge shows count of open and in-progress tickets).

nodes.title: Four fixed content types; visibility toggle only; no Service Status for patients

attrs.statement: 4 content types for patient platform: FAQs, Articles, Resources, Videos (FR-033 REQ-033-003); admin can toggle content type visibility in FR-033 but cannot add new content types for patients; no Service Status for patients.
attrs.rationale: Fixed in Codebase (479), Configurable with Restrictions (488), Screen 2 Content Type Cards (265) and Out of Scope (88: Service Status page is a provider-only feature per FR-033).

nodes.title: Empty content type shown greyed out with an empty-state message

attrs.statement: Content type card is shown but greyed out / disabled with label "No content available yet"; tapping shows empty state message "No [content type] available yet. Check back later or Contact Support." Item count badge is hidden if count is 0.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 Empty Content Type State and Item Count Badge (268-269), General Content List Empty Content State (332) and Edge Cases (736: first launch before admin populates content).

attrs.statement: Featured / Popular Articles [Design Addition]: curated shortlist of popular or featured articles, up to 5 items; not defined in FR-033; requires admin curation mechanism or auto-generation based on view analytics (FR-033 REQ-033-018).
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 field Featured / Popular Articles (270), optional (Required: No). The mechanism (curated or view-analytics) is not decided: see product owner decision list.

nodes.title: Help Center unavailable: cached content or retry message

attrs.statement: When Help Center content is unavailable (API down), display cached content if available or show "Help Center temporarily unavailable" with a retry option
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 rules (343), Content Unavailable State (271: Help Center temporarily unavailable. Please try again later., retry button) and Alternative Flow B2 (212-219: patient may navigate to Contact Support as fallback). Implementation Notes Caching (609) and Integration 1 error handling (618); Technology Assumption 2 (591: cached content available offline where feasible); Media Storage failure handling (556).

attrs.statement: Tickets are ordered by most recently updated (newest activity at top) within each filter tab
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 rules (370). Last Updated uses relative format such as 2h ago or Yesterday (365).

nodes.title: Ticket cards always open the full thread

attrs.statement: Ticket cards are always tappable regardless of status — patients can view the full thread even for Closed cases
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 rules (374) and Ticket Card (359).

nodes.title: Resolved ticket cards show an auto-closes indicator

attrs.statement: Resolved cases display a subtle "Auto-closes in X days" indicator to set expectations about the closure window (FR-034 REQ-034-061)
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 rules (375).

nodes.title: Submit stays disabled until required fields are valid

attrs.statement: All fields except Attachments are mandatory; the Submit button remains disabled until Title (>= 10 chars), Category, Description (>= 20 chars), and Priority are all valid
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 rules (440) and Submit Button (435: disabled until all required fields pass validation). Conflicts with Alternative Flow B1 (REQ-035-050): see product owner decision list.

nodes.title: Invalid fields highlighted inline on Submit

attrs.statement: Patient taps Submit on Contact Support form with incomplete data; System validates required fields: title (min 10 chars), category, description (min 20 chars), priority; System highlights invalid fields with inline error messages; Patient corrects validation errors and resubmits.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B1 (198-208). Cannot be reached when Submit is disabled (REQ-035-049): both kept, see product owner decision list.

nodes.title: Priority picker default Medium with self-triage descriptions

attrs.statement: Priority Picker options: Low, Medium, High, Urgent; default: Medium. Brief inline descriptions help patients self-triage: Low = "General question", Medium = "Something isn't working right", High = "Blocking my care or booking", Urgent = "Critical issue needing immediate attention".
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 Priority Picker (433) and rules (444: patients in distress tend to over-select Urgent without guidance, which degrades response quality for truly urgent cases).

attrs.statement: Brief inline description per category to help patients select correctly: Feature Request = "Suggest a new feature or improvement", Bug Report = "Report something that is broken or not working as expected", Feedback = "Share general feedback about your experience".
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 Category Picker (431) and rules (445, marked [Design Addition]: all three appear in FR-034 REQ-034-030 without patient-facing guidance).

attrs.statement: Category selection drives downstream admin routing — this is transparent to the patient but important for response time
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 rules (443).

nodes.title: Submission confirmation shows the case ID and 24-hour message

attrs.statement: Upon successful submission, the system displays a confirmation screen showing the assigned Case ID (CASE-YYYY-#####) and the message "We will respond within 24 hours" (FR-034 SC-003), then navigates to My Support Tickets (Screen 3)
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 rules (441), Alternative Flow A3 steps 8-9 (164-165) and Screen 3 Create New Ticket Button (357: confirmation then return to the ticket list).

nodes.title: Confirmation email with the case reference number

attrs.statement: Patient receives a confirmation email with the case reference number upon submission (FR-020, FR-034 A5 step 11)
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 rules (373), Alternative Flow A3 step 7 (163) and Screen 5 Submit Button (435). The PRD names no event for this email.

attrs.statement: Case ID format: CASE-YYYY-##### (fixed in the codebase, not editable by admin)
attrs.rationale: Fixed in Codebase (481), Screen 3 Case ID (360), Screen 4 Case ID (389) and A3 step 5 (161).

nodes.title: Discard confirmation on leaving the form

attrs.statement: Back Navigation prompts "Discard draft?" confirmation if the form has unsaved input; Cancel / Discard prompts "Discard this request?" if any field has input; no data saved on cancel.
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 Back Navigation (429) and Cancel / Discard (436).

nodes.title: Attachments validated on the device and on the server

attrs.statement: File uploads are validated client-side (format + size) before upload and server-side (virus scan + format whitelist) before acceptance (FR-034 REQ-034-036/037)
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 rules (442).

nodes.title: Failed virus scan rejects the file with a generic message

attrs.statement: A file that fails virus scanning is rejected with the message: "This file could not be attached. Please try a different file." No details about the scan failure are exposed to the patient.
attrs.rationale: Edge Cases (735).

nodes.title: Virus scanning service failure: quarantine and notify admin

attrs.statement: Virus Scanning Service failure handling: quarantine uploads and notify admin; do not attach files to case until scan completes.
attrs.rationale: External Dependencies (558-561). Whether this covers an infected file, a scanner outage, or both is not stated; REQ-035-059 covers the rejection message: see product owner decision list.

nodes.title: Media storage failure: uploads queued and patient told of delay

attrs.statement: Media Storage Service failure handling: for file uploads, queue for retry and notify patient of delay.
attrs.rationale: External Dependencies (553-556).

nodes.title: Support request submitted offline is queued

attrs.statement: A support request submitted while offline is queued locally and submitted when connectivity is restored, with clear indication to the patient.
attrs.rationale: Edge Cases (734) and Integration 2 error handling (623: queue submission locally if offline; retry with exponential backoff on 5xx errors).

nodes.title: Rate limit on ticket submission and replies

attrs.statement: Rate limiting on ticket submission and reply endpoints (max 10 submissions/hour/patient).
attrs.rationale: Security Considerations Threat mitigation (643), promoted. Whether replies count toward the same 10 per hour is not stated.

nodes.title: Notification failures never block case operations

attrs.statement: Notification delivery failures do not block case operations; retry asynchronously.
attrs.rationale: Integration 3 error handling (628), promoted.

nodes.title: Patient reply joins the thread and notifies the assigned admin

attrs.statement: Patient replies are added to the shared communication thread and the assigned admin receives a notification via FR-020 (support.case_user_reply event)
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 rules (413), A4 steps 6-7 (179-181) and Send Reply Button (404).

nodes.title: Send Reply enabled only with text

attrs.statement: Send Reply Button is enabled when reply input is non-empty; hidden for Closed cases.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 Send Reply Button (404).

nodes.title: Resolved cases auto-close after the closure period

attrs.statement: Cases auto-close after 7 days in Resolved status if no patient reply (configurable: 3/7/14 days per FR-034 REQ-034-061/062); the patient receives a support.case_closed notification.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 rules (412), Admin Editability (473: configured via FR-034), User Story 4 scenario 2 (711) and Shared Services (70). The countdown is visible in Ticket Detail to set expectations. Governed by SET-support-case-auto-closure-period.

nodes.title: Closure while the patient is viewing updates in real time

attrs.statement: When the auto-closure countdown reaches 0 while the patient is actively viewing the ticket, the status should update to Closed in real-time and the reply input should be replaced with the Closed Case Banner.
attrs.rationale: Edge Cases (738).

nodes.title: Closed Case Banner offers new ticket or reopen request

attrs.statement: Closed Case Banner: "This case is closed. If you still need help, you can create a new ticket or contact support to request this case be reopened." with "Create New Ticket" link to Screen 5 and "Contact Support" link (email/phone from Emergency Contact Section in Screen 1). Both paths: new ticket creation (in-app) and case reopening via admin (FR-034 Workflow B3, REQ-034-063, REQ-034-017).
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 Closed Case Banner (405) and User Story 4 scenario 3 (712). The reply input is hidden for Closed cases (REQ-035-018).

nodes.title: Resolution summary emailed when the case becomes Resolved

attrs.statement: The resolution summary is also sent to the patient via email notification on status change to Resolved.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 Resolution Summary (395).

attrs.statement: Support case lifecycle workflow: Open -> In Progress -> Resolved -> Closed (fixed in the codebase, not editable by admin).
attrs.rationale: Fixed in Codebase (480) and Screen 3 filter chips (358).

nodes.title: Support case data visible only to the patient and authorized admin staff

attrs.statement: Patient support case data is accessible only to the submitting patient and authorized admin staff
attrs.rationale: Data & Privacy Privacy Rule 3 (463). Complements REQ-035-025.

nodes.title: Support case lifecycle events audited in FR-034

attrs.statement: All support case lifecycle events (creation, status changes, messages, attachments) are logged with timestamp and user ID in FR-034 case timeline
attrs.rationale: Audit Rule (465) and Security Considerations Audit trail (642: timestamp, patient ID and action type, managed by FR-034).

nodes.title: Patient support data follows HIPAA and GDPR requirements

attrs.statement: Patient support data handling follows the same HIPAA/GDPR compliance requirements as all patient data in the platform
attrs.rationale: Security Considerations Compliance (644), promoted.

nodes.title: Account deletion with active support cases

attrs.statement: Open/In Progress cases should be flagged for admin review; patient identity is anonymized per data retention policy (FR-023).
attrs.rationale: Edge Cases (737): a patient deleting their account while support cases are active. Applies at the patient Deleted stage.

nodes.title: Patient-visible support categories are a fixed list

attrs.statement: Patient-visible support categories (admin cannot add or remove categories from the fixed list but may update labels in future)
attrs.rationale: Configurable with Restrictions (487). Editable by Admin (475) says patient-facing category descriptions and category visibility are managed via FR-033, which sits uneasily with a fixed list and with FR-033 being the help content module: see product owner decision list. Business assumption 4 (600).

attrs.statement: Empty State shown when the patient has no tickets (or none match the filter): "No support tickets yet. Need help? Tap 'Create New Ticket'."
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 Empty State field (PRD line 366).

nodes.title: One active hair-loss monitoring case per patient

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce one active hair-loss monitoring case per patient.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 1 (one active case per monitoring type; the FR-038 non-blocking half is REQ-037-032), Screen 1 business rules (only one active case; a self-monitoring patient must complete the case before starting an advice-mode case) and the Business Workflows duplicate-creation gate. Also fixed in code per Admin Editability.

nodes.title: Mode chosen at activation and fixed for the case

attrs.statement: Patient MUST select self-monitoring or provider-advice mode before activation, and the mode MUST remain fixed for that case.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 2, Screen 1 (Monitoring Mode immutable after activation; mode cannot change after activation), Communication Structure out of scope (no switching from self-monitoring to advice mode) and Admin Editability fixed in code.

nodes.title: Optional dated logs with severity, notes, photos and head scan

attrs.statement: System MUST provide optional dated logs with severity 1 to 10, notes, photos, and V1 head scan photo sets.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 3 and the Executive Summary. Assumption: severity 1 means least severe and 10 most severe. The patient records optional entries on any date.

nodes.title: Logging allowed during pending assignment and reassignment

attrs.statement: System MUST allow logging during pending provider assignment and pending reassignment.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 4, Screen 2 business rules, the Patient Platform scope and the Business Workflows (logging stays available in every assignment state).

nodes.title: Advice mode requires the active Inquiry medical questionnaire

attrs.statement: Advice mode MUST require the active FR-025 Inquiry medical questionnaire before provider access.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 1 (Medical Questionnaire conditional, required for provider advice mode), the Patient Platform scope and the Business Workflows medical gate (missing or invalid answers shown; patient completes before activation).

nodes.title: Admin assigns advice providers; reassignment distinguished

attrs.statement: Admin MUST assign advice providers and clearly distinguish reassignment after withdrawal.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Admin Platform scope (assigns an eligible provider, reassigns withdrawn cases, distinguishes first assignment from reassignment in queues and case history), Screens 8 and 12 (Assignment Type badge) and the assumption that Admin selects providers manually.

nodes.title: Provider withdrawal with reason ends access and returns case to Admin

attrs.statement: Provider MUST be able to withdraw with a reason, ending access and returning the case to Admin.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 11 (mandatory reason 1 to 1000 characters, confirmation of immediate loss of access; withdrawal does not end the patient's case; case returns to Admin as Pending Reassignment labelled as a reassignment), Screen 8 (case leaves the queue immediately after confirmation) and the Business Workflows (Admin and patient notified).

nodes.title: Global advice cadence weekly or bi-weekly, captured per case at creation

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce a single global Admin-configurable weekly or bi-weekly advice cadence. Each case MUST capture the active cadence at creation and keep it for the case lifetime; a cadence change MUST apply only to cases created after the change.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rules 5 and 5a (minimum intervals of 7 or 14 days; one global value with no per-case, per-provider or per-patient override; the case keeps its creation-time cadence through reassignment; a patient with an active case gets the new cadence on the next case), Screen 13 Advice Cadence, Admin Editability (approved weekly and bi-weekly values only) and the Edge Cases (cadence change while a window is partly elapsed).

nodes.title: Complete case and export a date-to-date PDF summary

attrs.statement: Patient MUST be able to complete the case and export a date-to-date PDF summary.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Business Workflows (completion preview, then PDF with logs, severity summary, advice when applicable and scan photos) and Screens 5 and 6. The workflow names advice in the PDF; Screen 6 rules and REQ-037-023 do not (see the report).

nodes.title: Convert an active case into a distinct FR-003 inquiry

attrs.statement: Patient MUST be able to convert an active case into a distinct FR-003 inquiry.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Executive Summary, Business Rule 6 (a converted monitoring case remains distinct from the inquiry), Screen 5 and Screen 7.

nodes.title: Conversion starts with a read-only summary step

attrs.statement: Conversion MUST present a read-only summary step showing the monitoring recap, all carried-over data, the summary PDF, and remaining inquiry-only items before any editable inquiry form is opened, and leaving that step MUST NOT alter the monitoring case.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 7 Step A business rules (Step A is read-only; no inquiry record exists yet; leaving Step A never completes, converts or alters the monitoring case).

nodes.title: No reminders, cadence, milestones or overdue state

attrs.statement: System MUST NOT provide patient logging or scan reminders, cadence, milestones, or overdue/compliance state; those belong to the aftercare package, not to this self-service FR.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 8, the Service Boundary table (cadence, scan reminders, overdue and compliance state, milestone entities are aftercare mechanics), the Communication Structure out of scope list (nudges, streaks, adherence notifications), Screen 2 (no daily frequency; missing dates neutral, never overdue) and the assumption that patients may log irregularly without penalty.

nodes.title: Advice window opens on start date, open until submitted or superseded

attrs.statement: Each advice window MUST open on its calculated start date and remain actionable without an ordinary deadline until its single advice is submitted or a successor window opens; a successor MUST expire only the older unsubmitted window and become the sole actionable window.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 5b, Screen 10B (each window opens on its calculated start date; both windows stay visible with distinct states), Screen 9 Advice Window Summary, the Provider Platform scope and the Edge Cases (unsubmitted window expires when the next opens).

nodes.title: Advice is a separate provider-authored calendar record

attrs.statement: Submitted provider advice MUST create a separate provider-authored case-calendar record and MUST NOT attach to or modify any patient log record.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 5c, Screens 2, 10A, 10B, 13, 14A and 14B business rules and the Edge Cases (same-date log and advice show as two authored records). Admin sees both as separate record types.

nodes.title: Submitted advice editable with immutable versions and edited cue

attrs.statement: Provider MUST be able to edit submitted advice while the system preserves immutable versions and displays an edited cue plus latest-edit timestamp to patient, provider, and Admin users.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 5c, Screen 10B (edit saves a new version; patient, Provider and Admin views show edited cue and latest-edit time), Screen 2 and the Business Workflows edit-advice step.

nodes.title: Provider and Admin lists: search, filters, sorting, pagination, Admin mode tabs

attrs.statement: Provider and Admin listing screens MUST support scoped search, filters, sorting, and pagination; the Admin list MUST provide separate All Cases, Self-Monitoring, and Provider Intervention tabs with operational case, activity, and assignment summaries.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 8 (search by anonymized patient ID or case ID; search, filters, sorting and pagination compose without exposing cases assigned to another provider) and Screen 12 (mode tabs; counts and selected tab stay synchronized with filters; status, provider, advice-state and date filters).

nodes.title: Case overviews with full dashboard and calendar; dedicated detail screens

attrs.statement: Provider and Admin case overviews MUST include the full patient-visible monitoring dashboard and calendar, while each patient daily log and provider-advice record MUST open in its dedicated role-specific detail screen with the authorized fields and actions defined in Screens 10A, 10B, 14A, and 14B.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screens 9 and 13 (overview only; no inline expansion of a daily log or inline advice editing), Screens 10A, 10B, 14A and 14B, and Screen 13 (Admin sees every field and dated record in the patient view plus assignment, advice-window, audit, preview, export and conversion controls).

nodes.title: Admin read-only pre-assignment preview link, revocable, expiry chosen at share time

attrs.statement: Admin MUST be able to generate and revoke a read-only pre-assignment case-preview link for a candidate provider, MUST select its expiry at share time, and preview access MUST NOT create an assignment or ongoing case access.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 5d, Screen 12 (expiry chosen each time Share is used; read-only; scoped to the minimum information for an acceptance decision; audited; revocable; does not grant assignment access), the Business Workflows and the Edge Cases (preview revoked or expired without assignment; candidate opens a valid preview but is never assigned).

nodes.title: No embedded chat for pre-assignment communication

attrs.statement: FR-037 MUST NOT add an embedded chat screen for pre-assignment communication; the preview link is shared through an existing external communication channel.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 5d, the Communication Structure (in scope: link shared through an existing external channel; out of scope: FR-037 chat screen) and Screen 12 (Admin shares the link through an existing channel and records the eventual assignment decision on the screen).

nodes.title: Submission timestamp stored; latest entry on a date sets that date's severity

attrs.statement: Every entry MUST store a submission timestamp, and derived severity for a date MUST use the latest-timestamped entry on that date.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 9 and Screen 3 (earlier entries stay visible and auditable; latest timestamp supplies the date's severity for the trend, latest-severity and summary calculations).

nodes.title: Conversion pre-fills compatible information; all copied fields editable

attrs.statement: Conversion MUST pre-fill compatible information and allow the patient to edit all copied fields.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Executive Summary (the patient must not repeat information already supplied merely because they are changing services) and Screen 7 Step B (every copied field remains editable before submission).

nodes.title: Conversion selects the latest valid scan by default

attrs.statement: Conversion MUST select the latest valid scan by default and allow another scan or retake.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Business Workflows scan-choice step, Screen 7 Step B (Selected Head Scan) and the Edge Cases (latest scan fails quality validation; patient selects an earlier valid scan).

nodes.title: Conversion attaches a generated summary PDF

attrs.statement: Conversion MUST attach a PDF containing logs, scan photos, logged-day count, and severity summary.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Business Workflows (monitoring-summary PDF generated, then pre-fill), Screen 7 Steps A and B and the Integration Points note.

nodes.title: Previous monitoring history links to an inquiry only through conversion

attrs.statement: Previous monitoring history MUST link to the FR-003 inquiry only through conversion and MUST NOT be attached to a newly created monitoring case.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 3 and Screen 1 business rules (a new monitoring case starts with its own intake; previous monitoring-case history is not attached to it).

nodes.title: Patient, assigned provider and authorized Admin access only

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce patient, current assigned provider, and authorized Admin access boundaries.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Data and Privacy Rules (access limited to the patient, authorized Admin users and the currently assigned provider for advice-mode cases), the Provider Platform scope and Screen 4 (providers view scans only while assigned).

nodes.title: Medical-data access, advice, preview, export, assignment, withdrawal and conversion audited

attrs.statement: System MUST audit all medical-data access, advice submissions and edits, preview-link creation/access/expiry/revocation, exports, assignments, withdrawals, and conversions.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Data and Privacy Rules (every view, export, edit, assignment, withdrawal and conversion of medical data is audited) and Screen 13 Audit History.

nodes.title: Admin edits keep version history and need a reason

attrs.statement: Admin edits MUST preserve version history and require a reason.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Admin Editability (edits require permission, a reason and version history; edits cannot delete audit evidence) and Screens 13, 14A and 14B (Edit Reason required before save; before and after values, actor, reason, time).

nodes.title: Providers see only an anonymized patient identifier for the whole case

attrs.statement: Provider-facing FR-037 screens MUST show an anonymized patient identifier for the entire case lifetime and MUST NOT expose patient full name or contact details.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Data and Privacy Rules, Screen 9 (FR-037 advice involves no payment, so no de-anonymization trigger exists here; any later de-anonymization happens only in the FR-003/FR-004 flow created by conversion; Admin retains full identity visibility) and the Implementation Notes.

nodes.title: Exclusive routing to the assigned provider; decline falls back to normal distribution

attrs.statement: If an assigned advice provider exists at conversion, only that provider MUST initially be selected to quote. If that provider explicitly declines before quote creation, FR-003 MUST audit the reason, remove exclusive routing, and execute normal distribution exactly once. If no provider is assigned at conversion, FR-003 normal distribution MUST apply immediately. Expiry MUST remain governed by FR-003/FR-004 rather than this decline fallback.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 7 (decline fallback needs no patient release action; expiry stays governed by FR-003/FR-004), Screen 7 Step B (exclusive provider is the only initial quote recipient; transition occurs on the resulting inquiry), Screen 7 Step A routing notice, the Business Workflows provider-route gate and the Edge Cases. Overlaps FR-003 and FR-004 rules (see the report).

nodes.title: Monitoring stays active if submission fails; ends only on commit or completion

attrs.statement: Monitoring MUST remain active if FR-003 submission fails and MUST terminate only after successful conversion commit or explicit completion.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 6 (completion and conversion are terminal outcomes), Screen 5 (conversion not committed until the FR-003 inquiry is submitted), Screen 7 Step A (leaving never alters the case) and the Edge Cases (exit before submission leaves monitoring active).

nodes.title: Conversion is idempotent; no duplicate inquiries

attrs.statement: Conversion MUST be idempotent and MUST NOT create duplicate inquiries.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Shared Services scope (idempotent transfer of compatible fields and attachments), Admin Editability (conversion identity and idempotency fixed in code), the Technology Assumptions (idempotency key) and the Edge Cases (retry after a network timeout).

nodes.title: Active hair-loss case does not block an active FR-038 case

attrs.statement: A patient may have one active case per monitoring type; an active FR-037 case does not block an active FR-038 case.
attrs.rationale: Business Rule 1 (prd.md line 585); Internal Dependencies FR-038 (both reuse shared monitoring entities discriminated by case type).

nodes.title: Starting monitoring with an active case opens it

attrs.statement: System blocks duplicate creation and opens the existing active case.
attrs.rationale: Business Workflows main flow, active-case gate (Duplicate step).

nodes.title: Entry points to Monitor Your Hair Loss

attrs.statement: Patient selects Monitor Your Hair Loss from FR-003 Screen 1: Service Selection, opens the active case from the patient home/dashboard monitoring card, or opens conversion from the active case actions or from the completion flow. Provider opens Hair Loss Monitoring Advice from the provider dashboard. Admin opens Monitoring Cases or the pending assignment/reassignment queue.
attrs.rationale: Entry Points (five bullets, joined). Screen names are as written in the PRD.

attrs.statement: Hair-loss monitoring intake captures Nature of Concern (required, 1 to 2000 characters), Duration (required, FR-003 Duration enum with an identical value set so conversion copies without remapping), Previous Treatments or "None" (required, maximum 2000 characters), Current Severity (required, integer 1 to 10), Lifestyle Factors and Additional Notes (optional, maximum 2000 characters each), Initial Photos (optional, FR-003 image limits) and an Initial Head Scan (optional, FR-002 quality contract).
attrs.rationale: Assembled from the Screen 1 field table (prd.md lines 220-229); the PRD has no prose statement.

nodes.title: Advice-mode case activates as Pending Assignment and Admin is notified

attrs.statement: System activates the case as Pending Assignment and notifies Admin once the required medical answers are complete and valid.
attrs.rationale: Business Workflows medical gate and ActivateAdvice step; Executive Summary (advice-mode cases wait for Admin assignment while the patient continues logging).

nodes.title: Self-monitoring case has no provider workflow

attrs.statement: No provider workflow is available for a self-monitoring case. Admin supports self-monitoring cases without adding a provider.
attrs.rationale: Business Workflows NoProvider step; Admin Platform scope; Provider Platform scope (does not manage self-monitoring cases); Communication Structure out of scope (provider advice for self-monitoring cases).

nodes.title: Providers see only their assigned advice-mode cases

attrs.statement: Provider sees only advice-mode cases currently assigned to the provider. Self-monitoring and unassigned cases never appear in the provider queue.
attrs.rationale: Provider Platform scope; Screen 8 business rules.

attrs.statement: Log Date must not be in the future; Severity is an integer 1 to 10; Notes are at most 3000 characters; Photos follow the secure image limits; a Head Scan must meet the FR-002 quality contract.
attrs.rationale: Assembled from the Screen 3 field table (Validation Rules column); Admin Screen 14A repeats the 1 to 10 and 3000-character limits.

nodes.title: Patient edits and deletes own entries while active; all versions auditable

attrs.statement: The patient may create, edit, or delete their own entries while the case is active; all versions remain auditable.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 business rules.

nodes.title: Multiple entries per date; logged days count a date once

attrs.statement: Multiple entries on one date are allowed, but Logged Days counts the date once.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 business rules; Screen 2 Logged Days (unique dates with at least one entry).

nodes.title: Calendar in patient-local time; authors and types distinguishable

attrs.statement: The monitoring calendar uses the patient-local timezone and shows patient logs, scans, and separate provider-advice entries so that the event author and type are distinguishable.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 Calendar field; Screens 9 and 13 (provider and Admin calendars show the same dated events).

nodes.title: Patient sees advice as its own entry; no reply; edited cue without prior versions

attrs.statement: Advice is shown chronologically as its own provider-authored calendar entry, never inside a patient log, and cannot be replied to as a chat thread. Edited advice shows a clear edited cue and latest-edit timestamp without exposing prior versions to the patient.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules; Provider Advice Detail is read-only to the patient.

nodes.title: Scan capture links to the log date; guidance, validation and retake

attrs.statement: Scan capture opens the head scan capture screen and links the resulting scan to the log date. The capture shows front, top, left, and right guidance, validates quality and completeness, and lets the patient retake a failed-quality scan before saving.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 business rules; Screen 4 (Capture Guidance, Photo Set validation, retake rule).

nodes.title: V1 head scan is a standardized multi-view photo set

attrs.statement: In V1, all references to a "3D head scan" mean the standardized multi-view head scan photo set defined by FR-002. True 3D reconstruction is not required in V1; true 3D capture and viewing remain V2 scope.
attrs.rationale: Executive Summary V1 scan terminology; Screen 4 business rules; Technology Assumptions.

nodes.title: Provider access ends immediately; scans visible only while assigned

attrs.statement: Provider access ends immediately on withdrawal, reassignment away, case completion, or conversion. Providers can view scans and media only while assigned to the advice case.
attrs.rationale: Data and Privacy Rules; Screen 4 business rules; Security Considerations (revoke provider media access when assignment ends).

nodes.title: Monitoring data encrypted in transit and at rest

attrs.statement: Monitoring entries, medical answers, scans, advice, assignments, and exports are medical data and require encryption in transit and at rest.
attrs.rationale: Data and Privacy Rules.

nodes.title: Case records retained 7 years after completion or conversion

attrs.statement: Case records, entries, advice, assignment history, conversion provenance, and PDF exports are retained for 7 years after completion or conversion.
attrs.rationale: Data and Privacy Rules (prd.md line 605).

attrs.statement: Raw monitoring scan media is medical data and is retained for 7 years after completion or conversion, matching the medical-record retention minimum. No shorter raw-media lifecycle applies.
attrs.rationale: Data and Privacy Rules (prd.md line 606); Technical Considerations (cold storage may not delete earlier). Compare FR-003 REQ-003-040 (see the report).

nodes.title: Generated PDF links expire and are authorization-checked

attrs.statement: Generated PDF links must be expiring, authorization-checked links.
attrs.rationale: Data and Privacy Rules; Screen 6 Download PDF (signed access link); Security Considerations (recheck authorization on every PDF request).

nodes.title: Preview link token, expiry, revocation, approved dataset, event record

attrs.statement: Pre-assignment preview links must use an unguessable token, expire at the Admin-selected time, support revocation, expose only the approved preview dataset, and record creation, access, expiry, and revocation events.
attrs.rationale: Data and Privacy Rules.

nodes.title: End Monitoring previews the case and needs a confirmed choice

attrs.statement: End Monitoring shows the patient a preview of date range, logged-day count, scan count, and severity trend. The patient makes a single completion choice (complete and export, or Request Treatment) and selects a confirmation that acknowledges monitoring will end; declining returns to the active case.
attrs.rationale: Business Workflows completion preview and gate; Screen 5 field table (Completion Choice single selection; Confirmation must be selected).

nodes.title: Completion or successful conversion ends the case and any advice assignment

attrs.statement: Completing or successfully converting ends the active case and any advice assignment.
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 business rules; Business Workflows Complete step.

nodes.title: Completed case is read-only except Admin audited correction

attrs.statement: A completed case is read-only except for Admin audited correction.
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 business rules.

attrs.statement: Summary PDFs are generated asynchronously and the generated artifact is retained; the patient is notified when the PDF is ready. A failed generation is retryable without altering the completed case.
attrs.rationale: Shared Services scope (asynchronous generation, retained artifact); Screen 6 business rules; Technology Assumptions (notify when ready); Edge Cases (generation fails after completion and succeeds on retry).

nodes.title: PDF versioned and regenerated after Admin correction

attrs.statement: When Admin corrects a value after PDF generation, for example a severity value, the PDF is versioned and regenerated.
attrs.rationale: Edge Cases (last bullet); Key Entities MonitoringExport (report version).

nodes.title: Monitoring summary values derived from valid entries

attrs.statement: Monitoring summary values are derived from valid entries: monitoring period (first through final case date), logged-day count, scan count, advice count when applicable, and severity first, latest, minimum, maximum, average, and trend.
attrs.rationale: Assembled from Screens 2, 5, 6 and 7 Step A (Derived columns); per-date severity follows REQ-037-020.

nodes.title: Conversion blocked while an FR-003 inquiry is active

attrs.statement: System blocks conversion when the patient already has an active FR-003 inquiry, explains the conflict, and preserves the active monitoring case.
attrs.rationale: Business Workflows inquiry gate.

nodes.title: Conversion summary shows PDF status; continue when ready or retry

attrs.statement: If PDF generation has not finished, the conversion summary step shows generation status and allows the patient to continue once it is ready or retry on failure.
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 Step A business rules.

nodes.title: Conversion summary states the provider routing

attrs.statement: The conversion summary step states, when an advice provider has an active assignment, that the assigned advice provider will be the only initial quote recipient.
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 Step A Provider Routing Notice field.

nodes.title: Patient answers only missing information and reconfirms medical answers

attrs.statement: The patient answers only missing or newly required information and reconfirms existing medical answers during conversion review.
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 Step B business rules and Medical Answers field.

nodes.title: Monitoring case and inquiry linked by immutable conversion provenance

attrs.statement: The monitoring case and the inquiry remain distinct records linked by immutable conversion provenance.
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 Step B business rules; Business Workflows CommitConversion step.

nodes.title: Conversion hands off to FR-003 screens for inquiry-only information

attrs.statement: Completing conversion review hands the patient into the standard FR-003 inquiry screens for the inquiry-only information (destinations, dates, provider selection rules, terms). FR-037 does not duplicate those screens; it supplies pre-filled values and the summary PDF to them.
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 Step B business rules and Inquiry-Only Handoff Target field.

nodes.title: Failed conversion preserves the case and the draft

attrs.statement: When FR-003 data is invalid or submission fails, System preserves the monitoring case and the conversion draft and shows corrections or a retry option.
attrs.rationale: Business Workflows PreserveDraft step.

nodes.title: FR-003 accepts the generated PDF as an additional document

attrs.statement: FR-003 must accept the system-generated monitoring-summary PDF as an additional document even if its ordinary patient upload UI remains image/video-only.
attrs.rationale: Integration Points (promoted from the technical section; the behaviour is FR-003's, stated here by the PRD).

nodes.title: Withdrawal reasons hidden from other providers

attrs.statement: Withdrawal reasons are never exposed to another provider unless Admin includes an appropriate operational note.
attrs.rationale: Security Considerations (promoted from the technical section); Screen 11 (reason visible to Admin).

nodes.title: Reassignment shows history to Admin and replacement provider

attrs.statement: Reassignment cases display the withdrawal reason and prior assignment history to Admin; the replacement provider receives the case history and the next eligible advice date.
attrs.rationale: Screen 12 business rules; Business Workflows Reassign and Replacement steps.

nodes.title: Assignment eligibility and Admin permissions validated before save

attrs.statement: Assignment eligibility and Admin permissions are validated before an assignment is saved.
attrs.rationale: Screen 12 business rules. The PRD does not define eligibility (see the report).

nodes.title: Provider assigned at conversion assumed eligible

attrs.statement: The provider assigned at conversion is assumed eligible to receive the inquiry; otherwise Admin resolves eligibility before submission or the case follows the no-assigned-provider path.
attrs.rationale: Business Process Assumptions, promoted because it states a business path; Marking Unclear Requirements (provider eligibility to be validated in technical design).

nodes.title: Admin mode tabs partition provider controls from self-monitoring rows

attrs.statement: The Admin mode tabs are a primary partition: provider-intervention controls and advice fields do not appear as applicable on self-monitoring rows, and tab counts stay synchronized with the filters.
attrs.rationale: Screen 12 business rules and Mode Tabs field.

nodes.title: Preview contents reviewed before sharing; contact and audit data excluded

attrs.statement: Admin must review the exact read-only case overview and clinical summary that a candidate provider will receive before sharing a preview; the preview excludes patient direct-contact details and Admin-only audit and assignment data.
attrs.rationale: Screen 12 Preview Contents field.

nodes.title: Admin may edit any case information; no edit erases history

attrs.statement: Admin may edit all patient-supplied monitoring information, logs, severity ratings, scan metadata, assignment state, advice records, conversion links, and status where operational correction is required, but no edit may erase historical values or provenance.
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability (Editable by Admin); Screen 13 business rules.

nodes.title: Fixed in code: encryption, authorization, audit, one case per type, mode, conversion identity

attrs.statement: Encryption, authorization, audit immutability, one-active-case-per-type enforcement, the rule that self mode cannot change mid-case, and FR-003 conversion identity and idempotency controls are fixed in code and not Admin-editable.
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability (Fixed in Codebase).

nodes.title: Admin advice edits keep the provider as author and every prior version

attrs.statement: Admin edits to advice preserve the provider as original author, retain every prior version, and surface the edited cue and latest-edit timestamp.
attrs.rationale: Screen 14B business rules.

nodes.title: Advice is informational, one concise paragraph, no chat or consultation

attrs.statement: Advice is informational and must not be represented as diagnosis or prescription. It is one concise paragraph (maximum 1500 characters); FR-037 has no embedded chat, calls, diagnosis, prescriptions, or full medical consultation.
attrs.rationale: Screen 10B business rules and Advice Paragraph field; Communication Structure out of scope.

attrs.statement: The provider cannot edit patient-authored monitoring data.
attrs.rationale: Screen 10A business rules.

nodes.title: Advice submit and edit need an active assignment

attrs.statement: Advice submit and edit actions require an active assignment.
attrs.rationale: Screen 10B (Advice Paragraph, Submit Advice and Edit Advice validation rules).

nodes.title: Who is notified on assignment, withdrawal, replacement and advice

attrs.statement: The patient is notified when a provider is assigned, withdraws, is replaced, or posts advice; Provider and Admin are notified of assignment and reassignment actions.
attrs.rationale: Communication Structure in scope; Shared Services scope; Business Workflows.

nodes.title: FR-037 notification events; no logging or scan reminder

attrs.statement: FR-037 notifications are limited to assignment, reassignment, advice, withdrawal, completion, export-ready, and conversion events. FR-037 defines no patient-configurable logging or scan reminder.
attrs.rationale: Service Boundary closing paragraph; Integration Points (FR-020 event candidates).

nodes.title: Add Log, Request Treatment and End Monitoring on active cases only

attrs.statement: Add Log, Request Treatment, and End Monitoring are available on active cases only.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 field table (Validation Rules column).

attrs.statement: Advice availability is shown as a future start date, available since date, submitted, or expired-unsubmitted.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 Advice Availability field; Screen 8 and Screen 12 advice filters.

nodes.title: List screens show derived activity values

attrs.statement: Provider and Admin lists show derived activity values: last patient log, logged-day count, latest severity, scan count, last advice, and next or current advice state.
attrs.rationale: Screen 8 (Last Patient Log, Advice Availability) and Screen 12 (Activity Summary).

nodes.title: Provider advice is a limited free service

attrs.statement: Provider advice is a limited free service, not a full consultation; FR-037 advice involves no payment and has no payment event.
attrs.rationale: Business Process Assumptions; Screen 9 business rules; Data and Privacy Rules.

nodes.title: Self-service boundary: aftercare mechanics are not inherited

attrs.statement: FR-037 is a standalone, patient-driven self-service utility; it is not an aftercare package and must never inherit aftercare mechanics. An aftercare capability absent here is correct scope, not a defect.
attrs.rationale: Module Scope, Service Boundary (NON-NEGOTIABLE), including the care-team and milestone-entity rows.

nodes.title: Provider assignment lifecycle events are immutable

attrs.statement: Provider assignment lifecycle events are immutable.
attrs.rationale: Screen 13 Assignment History field (Validation Rules: Immutable events).

nodes.title: One active monitoring case per patient

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce one active transplant-progress monitoring case per patient.
attrs.rationale: Restated by General Rule 1 (one active case per monitoring type), Screen 1 (a patient may have only one active transplant-progress case), Main Flow step 2 (System checks that no active transplant-progress case exists), Alternative Flow B1 and Admin Editability (one-active-case-per-type enforcement is fixed in codebase).

nodes.title: Self-service only: no provider advice, assignment, queue or data access

attrs.statement: FR-038 MUST remain self-service only with no provider advice, assignment, queue, or data access.
attrs.rationale: Restated by General Rule 2, Module Scope (Provider Platform not applicable: no operational surface, no provider assigned, no provider dashboard, advice, chat, review queue or patient-data access), Screen 2 (no provider identity or advice controls appear), Provider Platform Screens (no list, detail, advice, assignment or media-access surface) and Admin Editability (self-service-only restriction and provider-access prohibition are fixed in codebase). Executive Summary and Business Process Assumptions give the reason: avoiding clinic conflicts of interest and preventing a free self-tracking tool from being represented as managed aftercare. Communication Structure puts provider advice, assignment, chat, clinic review, diagnosis and prescriptions out of scope.

nodes.title: Optional dated logs with severity, notes, photos and head scan

attrs.statement: Patient MUST be able to record optional dated logs with severity 1 to 10, notes, photos, and V1 head scan photo sets.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Module Scope (adds optional logs on any date with recovery severity/condition rating, notes, photos and V1 head scan photo sets) and Main Flow steps 6 and 7.

nodes.title: No required cadence, milestones, overdue status or compliance

attrs.statement: System MUST NOT impose required cadence, milestones, overdue status, or compliance obligations.
attrs.rationale: Restated by General Rule 3 (logging frequency is entirely optional; no overdue, missed-task, compliance or milestone state), Screen 2 (the system must not display overdue, missed milestone, compliance or required-frequency states), Executive Summary and Main Flow step 8 (timeline, scan history and severity trend update without overdue states).

nodes.title: Patient completes the case and exports a date-to-date PDF

attrs.statement: Patient MUST be able to complete the case and export a date-to-date PDF summary.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Alternative Flow A1 and Screens 5 and 7.

nodes.title: Convert an active case into a distinct FR-011 standalone request

attrs.statement: Patient MUST be able to convert an active case into a distinct FR-011 standalone-aftercare request.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Alternative Flow A2 and Screens 5 and 6.

nodes.title: Intake captures FR-011-compatible external treatment details

attrs.statement: Initial intake MUST capture FR-011-compatible external treatment details.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Main Flow step 3, Module Scope and Screen 1 purpose (information compatible with FR-011 standalone aftercare).

nodes.title: Conversion pre-fills compatible data; every copied field editable

attrs.statement: Conversion MUST pre-fill compatible information and allow the patient to edit all copied fields.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Alternative Flow A2 steps 3 and 5, Screen 6 (every copied field is editable before standalone request creation; the patient may replace copied documentation) and the Executive Summary.

nodes.title: Latest valid scan selected by default; another scan or retake allowed

attrs.statement: Conversion MUST select the latest valid scan by default and allow another scan or retake.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Alternative Flow A2 step 4, Screen 6 (Selected Head Scan: latest valid scan by default, another scan, or retake) and Edge Cases (latest scan fails quality and an earlier valid scan is selected during conversion).

attrs.statement: Conversion MUST attach a PDF containing treatment summary, logs, scan photos, logged-day count, and severity summary.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Executive Summary (carries the monitoring-summary PDF into the aftercare request) and Integration Points (FR-011 receives the generated PDF and must accept it as treatment documentation or additional case context).

nodes.title: No history attached to a new case; provenance links only source and destination

attrs.statement: Previous monitoring history MUST NOT attach to a new monitoring case; conversion provenance MUST link only the source case and destination FR-011 request.
attrs.rationale: Restated by General Rule 4 (previous monitoring history is not linked to a new monitoring case; conversion links only the source FR-038 case to its destination FR-011 standalone request) and Screen 1 (prior monitoring-case history is not attached when starting a new monitoring case).

nodes.title: Data restricted to the patient and authorized Admin users

attrs.statement: System MUST restrict FR-038 data to the patient and authorized Admin users.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Data & Privacy Rules (access is restricted to the patient and authorized Admin users while data belongs to FR-038), Screen 7 (Head Scan Photos: authorized access only) and Screen 9 (Conversion Link: authorized access only).

nodes.title: All medical-data access, edits, exports and conversions audited

attrs.statement: System MUST audit all medical-data access, edits, exports, and conversions.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Data & Privacy Rules (every view, edit, export and conversion is audited), Module Scope (Admin edits with audit history) and Communication Structure (Admin support actions visible in audit history where appropriate).

nodes.title: Admin edits keep version history and need a reason

attrs.statement: Admin edits MUST preserve version history and require a reason.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Module Scope (Admin edits carry actor, timestamp, reason, before-value and after-value), Admin Editability (edits require permission, a reason and version history) and Screen 9 (Edit Reason: required before save for any mutation).

nodes.title: Case stays active unless conversion commits or the patient completes

attrs.statement: Monitoring MUST remain active if FR-011 request creation fails and MUST terminate only after successful conversion commit or explicit completion.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Alternative Flow A2 step 7 and B2 (no partial conversion is committed), Screen 5 (conversion ends the case only when the FR-011 standalone request is successfully created), Executive Summary and User Story 3 scenario 4.

nodes.title: Conversion is idempotent; no duplicate standalone requests

attrs.statement: Conversion MUST be idempotent and MUST NOT create duplicate standalone-aftercare requests.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Module Scope (idempotent transfer), Admin Editability (conversion idempotency is fixed in codebase), Edge Cases (conversion retried after network timeout) and Implementation Notes (idempotency key on the conversion record).

nodes.title: FR-011 owns everything after a successful handoff

attrs.statement: After successful handoff, FR-011 MUST exclusively own package selection, payment, assignment, activation, milestones, and provider-managed aftercare.
attrs.rationale: Restated by General Rule 6, Alternative Flow A2 step 8, Admin Editability (FR-011 ownership after successful handoff is fixed in codebase) and Executive Summary.

nodes.title: An active FR-038 case does not block an active FR-037 case

attrs.statement: An active FR-038 case does not block an active FR-037 case.
attrs.rationale: Second clause of General Rule 1; the first clause (one active case per monitoring type) is REQ-038-001.

nodes.title: Duplicate creation blocked; Resume Monitoring or End Existing Case offered

attrs.statement: When an active transplant-progress case already exists, System blocks duplicate creation and the patient can Resume Monitoring or End Existing Case.

nodes.title: Intake required and optional fields with validation

attrs.statement: Intake requires treatment date (not in the future), treatment type (an active treatment-type value), treating clinic (1 to 200 characters), initial severity (integer 1 to 10) and the self-service acknowledgment. Treating country (an active FR-028 country), treatment documentation (PDF, JPG or PNG, maximum 10MB each), current concerns (maximum 2000 characters), initial photos (maximum 5, secure image limits) and an initial head scan (FR-002 quality contract) are optional.
attrs.rationale: Digest of the Required and Validation Rules columns of the Screen 1 field table.

attrs.statement: Patient reviews consent and confirms this is self-tracking, not managed aftercare.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 4. Screen 1 Self-Service Acknowledgment (confirms no provider monitoring or required cadence) is required and must be selected before the case is created. Patient profile and consent state are listed under Data Dependencies.

nodes.title: Self-tracking is not medical advice or provider-monitored aftercare

attrs.statement: The system must clearly state that self-tracking is not medical advice or provider-monitored aftercare.

nodes.title: Intake does not purchase aftercare or create an FR-011 request

attrs.statement: This intake does not purchase aftercare and does not create an FR-011 request.

nodes.title: Valid intake creates an active self-service case

attrs.statement: System creates active self-service case.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 5. User Story 1 scenario 1 adds that the case opens without provider assignment.

nodes.title: Severity 1 is least severe, 10 is most severe

attrs.statement: Severity 1 means least severe and 10 means most severe.
attrs.rationale: Promoted from User Behavior Assumptions because it defines the meaning of every severity value stored.

nodes.title: Log required and optional fields with validation

attrs.statement: A log requires a log date (not in the future and not before the treatment date) and a severity (integer 1 to 10). Notes (maximum 3000 characters), photos (secure image limits) and a head scan (V1 photo set, FR-002 quality contract) are optional.
attrs.rationale: Digest of the Required and Validation Rules columns of the Screen 3 field table.

nodes.title: Patient may create, edit or delete own entries while active; versions auditable

attrs.statement: Patient may create, edit, or delete their own entries while active; versions remain auditable.
attrs.rationale: Implementation Notes add append-only versions for patient and Admin edits that affect medical context.

nodes.title: Multiple entries on one date; Logged Days counts a date once

attrs.statement: Multiple entries on one date are allowed, but Logged Days counts that date once.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 defines Logged Days as the unique dates with entries; Edge Cases cover several entries and scans on one date.

nodes.title: No automated clinical advice from a score or image

attrs.statement: No automated clinical advice is generated from a score or image.
attrs.rationale: Communication Structure puts automated clinical interpretation of severity or scan changes, diagnosis and prescriptions out of scope.

nodes.title: Invalid pre-treatment log dates flagged for review, not deleted

attrs.statement: When the treatment date is corrected after several logs, invalid pre-treatment log dates are flagged for review rather than silently deleted.

nodes.title: Reminders are patient-chosen, optional and never mandatory

attrs.statement: Reminders are chosen by the patient and may be disabled without affecting case status; reminders cannot become mandatory milestones or compliance checks.
attrs.rationale: Communication Structure (reminders chosen by the patient), Screen 2 (optional personal reminders may be disabled without affecting case status) and Admin Editability (optional patient reminder defaults may be configured, but cannot become mandatory milestones or compliance checks).

attrs.statement: The calendar shows dates with logs and scans in the patient-local timezone.

nodes.title: Add Log, Switch to Aftercare Package and End Monitoring need an active case

attrs.statement: Add Log, Switch to Aftercare Package, and End Monitoring are available on an active case only.

nodes.title: Severity summary derived from the severity ratings

attrs.statement: Severity Summary shows first, latest, minimum, maximum, average, and trend of the severity ratings.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 Severity Trend is the rating over time (derived); Main Flow step 8 updates the severity trend as entries change; Scalability says trend summaries may be cached while source entries stay authoritative.

nodes.title: Monitoring Period runs from the first to the final case date

attrs.statement: Monitoring Period is the date range from the first through the final case date.

nodes.title: Last Log Date is the most recent patient entry

attrs.statement: Last Log Date is the most recent patient entry.

nodes.title: Conversion State is None, draft or converted

attrs.statement: Conversion State is None, draft, or converted to FR-011.

nodes.title: Completion previews date range, logged days, scan count and severity trend

attrs.statement: Before completion, System previews the monitoring date range, logged-day count, scan count, and severity trend.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A1 step 2 and the Screen 5 Case Summary (derived).

nodes.title: Explicit completion ends the case immediately after confirmation

attrs.statement: Explicit completion ends the case immediately after confirmation.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A1 steps 3 and 4. Screen 5 requires the patient to select the Confirmation checkbox (acknowledges the current monitoring case will end) and a single Completion Choice.

attrs.statement: PDF includes treatment summary, complete date-to-date log, scan photos, logged-day count, and severity summary.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A1 step 5 and User Story 2 scenario 2. REQ-038-010 states the same content for the PDF attached at conversion.

nodes.title: Failed PDF generation can be retried without reopening the case

attrs.statement: Failed generation can be retried without reopening the case.
attrs.rationale: User Story 2 scenario 3 adds that the retry does not duplicate the case.

nodes.title: Export-ready, completion and conversion notifications to the patient

attrs.statement: System sends export-ready, completion, and conversion notifications to the patient.
attrs.rationale: Shared Services (S-03) and Communication Structure (system confirmations, export-ready notifications and conversion status notifications are in scope). Integration Points list the candidate event names; notification copy is left to technical design.

nodes.title: Completed or converted case is read-only except Admin correction

attrs.statement: A completed or converted case is read-only except for Admin audited correction.
attrs.rationale: User Story 2 scenario 1 (the case becomes read-only when completion is confirmed).

nodes.title: Completion and conversion are terminal; source and destination stay distinct

attrs.statement: Completion and successful conversion are terminal outcomes, and source/destination cases remain distinct.
attrs.rationale: Screen 6 (the monitoring record and the FR-011 request remain distinct records linked by conversion provenance), Executive Summary and User Story 3 scenario 3.

nodes.title: Admin correction after PDF generation yields a new report version

attrs.statement: When Admin corrects data after PDF generation, a new report version is generated.

nodes.title: V1 3D head scan means the standardized multi-view photo set

attrs.statement: In V1, all references to a “3D head scan” mean the standardized multi-view head scan photo set defined by FR-002; true 3D capture and viewing remain V2 scope.
attrs.rationale: Executive Summary (V1 scan terminology) and Screen 4 (V1 does not require true 3D reconstruction).

nodes.title: Capture guidance and quality and completeness checks

attrs.statement: Scan capture shows front, top, left, and right guidance, and the standardized multi-view photo set must pass quality and completeness checks under the FR-002 V1 contract.

nodes.title: Failed-quality scan may be retaken before save

attrs.statement: A failed-quality scan may be retaken before save.

nodes.title: Scan history grouped by date, current case only

attrs.statement: Scan history lists prior scans grouped by date, for the current case only.

nodes.title: Provider access to copied data begins only under FR-011 authorization

attrs.statement: Provider access to information copied from FR-038 begins only under FR-011 authorization after assignment and activation.
attrs.rationale: Module Scope (provider access begins only if a converted FR-011 request completes assignment and activation), Screen 4 (scans remain inaccessible to providers unless later transferred into an activated FR-011 case under FR-011 rules) and Data & Privacy Rules.

nodes.title: Medical data encrypted in transit and at rest

attrs.statement: Intake, logs, severity ratings, scans, documentation, exports, and conversion links are medical data encrypted in transit and at rest.
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability lists encryption as fixed in codebase.

nodes.title: Case records and PDF exports retained 7 years

attrs.statement: Case records, entries, conversion provenance, and PDF exports are retained for 7 years after completion or conversion.
Raw monitoring scan media is retained for 2 years after completion or conversion unless legal or consent policy requires longer.

nodes.title: PDF and media download links expire and recheck authorization

attrs.statement: PDF and media download links must expire and recheck authorization.
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 Download PDF uses a signed access link; Security Considerations repeat the recheck.

nodes.title: Admin may edit all case information for operational correction
