attrs.statement: Admin may edit all monitoring intake information, entries, severity ratings, scan metadata, status, exports, and conversion metadata when operational correction is required.
attrs.rationale: Module Scope (Admin Platform: full case visibility and audited editing) and Screen 9 Case Data (permission controlled).

nodes.title: Admin cannot erase version history, exports or conversion provenance

attrs.statement: Admin may edit any information but cannot erase version history, exports, or conversion provenance.

nodes.title: Admin edit validated for permission and value, then saved as a new version

attrs.statement: System validates permission and value before saving a new version of an edited monitoring case.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A3 steps 3 and 4.

nodes.title: Audit history is immutable and records actor, reason, time, before and after

attrs.statement: Audit history is immutable and records actor, reason, time, and before and after values; a saved Admin edit creates an immutable before-and-after audit event.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A3 step 4, Screen 9 Audit History, Admin Editability (audit immutability fixed in codebase).

nodes.title: Admin cannot assign a provider; conversion to FR-011 is the only route

attrs.statement: Admin cannot assign a provider to FR-038; the patient must convert to FR-011 for managed aftercare.
attrs.rationale: Module Scope (Admin cannot turn an FR-038 case into provider-managed monitoring), Screen 8 (no assignment queue or provider field) and Business Process Assumptions (FR-011 standalone aftercare remains the only route from self-tracking to provider-managed aftercare).

nodes.title: Admin visibility implies no clinical monitoring or advice responsibility

attrs.statement: Admin visibility does not imply clinical monitoring or advice responsibility.

nodes.title: Admin case list: all cases, paginated, status filter, permission-scoped search

attrs.statement: Admin Monitoring Cases lists all transplant-progress monitoring cases, paginated, with a status filter (active, completed, converted) and search by patient or case identifier within the Admin's permission scope.
attrs.rationale: Module Scope (Admin views all self-service cases and supports the patient when needed) and Entry Points (Admin filters Type = Transplant Progress). Digest of the Screen 8 field table.

attrs.statement: Patient selects Aftercare: Monitor Transplant Progress from FR-003 Screen 1: Service Selection. Patient opens the active case from the patient home/dashboard monitoring card. Admin opens Monitoring Cases and filters Type = Transplant Progress. Patient selects Switch to Aftercare Package from active-case actions or the completion screen.

nodes.title: No FR-012 messaging; no FR-011 milestone communications before activation

attrs.statement: FR-038 includes no FR-012 secure messaging, and FR-011 milestone/task communications do not begin before standalone aftercare is purchased, assigned, and activated.

nodes.title: Current summary PDF generated when conversion starts

attrs.statement: System generates the current monitoring-summary PDF when the patient selects Switch to Aftercare Package.
attrs.rationale: Screen 6 Monitoring Summary PDF (current date-to-date report, system-generated).

nodes.title: Package availability and compatibility governed by FR-011 templates

attrs.statement: Available aftercare packages and treatment compatibility are governed by FR-011 templates.
attrs.rationale: Screen 6 Available Aftercare Services (FR-011 compatibility and availability). Promoted from Business Process Assumptions.

nodes.title: Package selected and fields valid before checkout

attrs.statement: Patient selects an available aftercare package and continues to FR-011 checkout only when a package is selected and the fields are valid.

nodes.title: Only reviewed data is transferred to FR-011

attrs.statement: Only data explicitly reviewed in the conversion draft is transferred to FR-011.
attrs.rationale: Promoted from Security Considerations; Assumptions say patients review copied external-treatment information before conversion.

nodes.title: Failed or abandoned conversion preserves the case and the conversion draft

attrs.statement: When FR-011 request validation or creation does not complete, System preserves the active monitoring case and the conversion draft, and the patient can correct information, retry, or return to monitoring.
attrs.rationale: REQ-038-015 states the active-case half of this rule.

nodes.title: FR-011 owns payment failure after the request exists

attrs.statement: When FR-011 payment fails after a standalone request is created, FR-011 owns the pending or failed payment state while the FR-038 conversion link remains intact.

nodes.title: FR-011 and FR-007 own pricing, checkout, payment, invoice, subscription, refund

attrs.statement: If the patient converts, FR-011 and FR-007 exclusively own package pricing, checkout, payment status, invoice, subscription, and refund behavior.

nodes.title: FR-038 is free and creates no invoice, charge, subscription or refund

attrs.statement: FR-038 is free and creates no invoice, charge, subscription, or refund.

nodes.title: FR-038 does not price, take payment, assign a provider or activate aftercare

attrs.statement: FR-038 does not calculate price, take payment, assign a provider, or activate aftercare.

nodes.title: Incomplete or failed checkout creates no FR-038 payment record

attrs.statement: An incomplete or failed checkout must not create an FR-038 payment record.

attrs.description: PRD Screen 3 (prd.md line 348). Purpose: Collect patient's first and last name.
PRD Screen 4 (prd.md line 373). Purpose: Create patient account with email and password.
PRD Screen 5 (prd.md line 401). Purpose: Verify patient's email address with OTP.
PRD Screen 6 (prd.md line 421). Purpose: Complete patient profile with additional information.
PRD Screen 7 (prd.md line 447). Purpose: Date selection for date of birth.
PRD Screen 8 (prd.md line 467). Purpose: Collect information about how patient discovered Hairline.
PRD Screen 9 (prd.md line 488). Purpose: Authenticate existing patients.
PRD Screen 10 (prd.md line 513). Purpose: Initiate password reset process.
PRD Screen 11 (prd.md line 534). Purpose: Enter 6-digit password reset verification code.
PRD Screen 12 (prd.md line 556). Purpose: Create new password.
PRD Screen 13 (prd.md line 578). Purpose: Show patient's profile with key actions.
PRD Screen 14 (prd.md line 617). Purpose: Allow patient to edit core profile fields.
PRD Screen 15a (prd.md line 670). Purpose: Manage push and email notification preferences.
PRD Screen 15c (prd.md line 731). Purpose: Display Privacy Policy content (static/read-only).
PRD Screen 15d (prd.md line 758). Purpose: Display Terms & Conditions content (static/read-only).
PRD Screen 16 (prd.md line 794). Purpose: Allow patient to submit a data deletion request.
PRD Screen 17 (prd.md line 825). Purpose: Allow an authenticated patient to change their password.
PRD Screen 18 (prd.md line 872). Purpose: Verify patient identity before performing sensitive actions.
PRD Screen 19 (prd.md line 903). Purpose: Admin oversight of patient accounts.
Patient picks the service and one active treatment-area option; eligibility is validated before the flow continues.
Patient picks up to 10 destination countries, ordered by regional configuration or proximity, with starting prices.
Patient describes the concern, duration, previous treatments, severity, optional context, and uploads photos and videos.
Patient captures the standardized head scan photo set (V1) with real-time quality feedback and retake.
Patient chooses up to 10 non-overlapping date ranges within two years, respecting the minimum lead time.
Patient answers the admin-managed Yes/No questions with details for Yes; alert level is derived.
Read-only summary of all sections, terms acceptance, and submission that generates the inquiry ID.
Patient selects 1 to 5 providers from suggestions in the chosen countries.
Patient sees stage, timeline, responses, summary, deadlines and stage-dependent actions (cancel or contact support).
Patient confirms irreversible cancellation, with impact summary and a required reason.
Confirmation after cancellation completes: reference, server timestamp, impact summary, provider notification status.
Provider list of distributed inquiries with masked patient names, alerts, date ranges and filters.
Provider detail of one inquiry, read-only before a quote, with media, head scan, questionnaire and the exclusive-inquiry decline action.
Admin list of all inquiries in every stage with unmasked identity, status, counts and advanced filters.
Admin edit, reassign, override, soft delete and audit trail for one inquiry.

Provider creates or edits one parent quote and its package options with full inquiry context, through seven ordered tabs (Treatment Service; Package Options with Sub-screen 2A Inline Package Editor; Grafts & Visual Plan; Dates & Pricing; Option Treatment Plans; Clinical Details & Notes; Review & Submit). Each tab has a completion gate; Review & Submit links each issue back to its owning tab and submits parent and options as one transaction.

Provider views all quotes in a single unified list with no tabs, reflecting global case statuses; actions (Edit, Soft Delete, View Details) are state-aware; cancelled quotes are greyed out with a badge and all actions disabled.

Provider inspects full quote details, patient-first as a continuation of the inquiry (Patient, Inquiry, Quote, Audit); Edit and Soft Delete only when eligible; an Inquiry Cancelled banner and read-only state for cancelled quotes.

Patient reviews parent quotes and their subquotes, read-only in FR-004; acceptance of exactly one subquote, edge cases and booking handoff are governed by FR-005, which may extend the actions while preserving FR-004 privacy and data structure.

Admin lists and filters all quotes across providers, grouped by inquiry by default, with a multi-quote cue, per-quote audit trail and version history; Restore and Archive are hidden for accepted quotes.
Admin views the complete quote with inquiry continuation and can switch between quotes of the same inquiry.
Admin performs limited, audited inline edits on draft or sent quotes only, with a mandatory reason; blocked once a subquote is accepted.

Admin authors a quote for the replacement provider during an FR-006 provider-fault transfer, opened only from the transfer; Save and Continue confirms the summary and returns to FR-006 to record the acceptance.

Extends FR-003 Screen 8. Patient views submitted inquiry status (stage, timeline, summary, medical alerts, deadlines, next actions), browses parent quotes grouped under providers, compares complete subquotes side by side, and accepts one subquote. Parent quote groups show provider, reference, shared clinical information, reviews, credentials, the expiry timer and a Message Provider button that opens the FR-012 conversation. Each subquote card offers View Details and Accept. Sort and filter controls and Compare checkboxes (at most three) sit above the list; the comparison panel renders only when at least two subquotes are selected.

Extends FR-004 Screen 4 (Quote Review). Patient views one complete subquote with inherited parent context read-only, may enter a promotion code for this subquote, acknowledges the terms, and taps Accept, which opens the confirmation modal.

Confirms acceptance and shows next steps (Booking & Payment handoff information) before finalizing. Confirm finalizes when eligible; Cancel returns to the subquote detail. Shows the slot-taken error state when the slot is taken first.

Read-only. Informs the provider of the acceptance outcome for each parent quote and its subquotes; only the selected provider sees the accepted selection; a non-selected reason never identifies another provider or the accepted price; links to version/audit history.

Admin monitors all subquote acceptance events with status filters (active, booking cancelled, superseded), views the immutable accepted selection, supersession or booking-cancelled indicator, flagged conflicts, and annotations, and adds audited notes or corrections with a reason. No delete or restore action exists.

Review the accepted subquote and inherited parent context, view its pre-scheduled appointment slot, and proceed to payment without reselection. Accessed from FR-005's Accepted Subquote detail view; shows a read-only blocked state when the booking can no longer be paid.
Confirmed booking, reference number, next steps and basic itinerary; appears immediately after successful payment.
Accepted and confirmed bookings in table list format (no calendar view); monitor booking status and payment state.
Complete booking details with context from inquiry, parent quote, accepted subquote, acceptance and booking stages; read-only.
Monitor all bookings across the platform; entry to the governed interventions.

Complete booking details from all stages, with the governed intervention actions: revive, change appointment, cancel, provider-fault transfer, resolve in-progress provider fault, reassign aftercare, refund, internal note.
Revive a Payment Window Expired booking to Accepted with a new slot hold, opened from Screen 6.
Change the appointment date/time of an Accepted or Confirmed booking, opened from Screen 6.
Cancel a booking on an admin decision or a patient request received through support, opened from Screen 6.
Move a patient to a replacement provider in the same inquiry through an admin-authored replacement quote and a new admin-authored acceptance, opened from Screen 6.
Record the admin's case-by-case decision for a provider fault while the booking is In Progress, opened from Screen 6.
Screen 1. Allow patient to pay deposit to confirm booking.
Screen 2. Allow patient to complete final payment before or on procedure date.
Screen 3. View complete payment information with full context from inquiry, quote, booking, and payment stages.
Screen 4. View payout status and details for completed treatments with full context from booking and payment stages.
Screen 5. Allow admin to monitor patient payment progress across all bookings (list/dashboard view).
Screen 5B. View complete payment information with full context from all stages for a specific booking.
Screen 6. Process refunds per cancellation policy with full context from booking and payment stages.

Allow the patient to select an installment plan at booking checkout. Reached from the Payment Options step (FR-006/FR-007) after the patient selects Pay in Installments; shows the full schedule and an interest-free highlight, a Pay in Full alternative, a plan versus full payment comparison and a calculator. UI controls: installment selector, calculator, Pay in Full option, confirm.

nodes.title: Patient Booking Details - Installment Schedule View

attrs.description: Allow the patient to view the installment payment schedule and history from the booking details screen. UI controls: progress bar, countdown, Update Payment Method button (opens P03.1 Payment Methods Management; the Business Rules also name an Update Card button), receipt download.

Let the provider see all their bookings that use installment plans, with high-level status and risk indicators; read-only. UI controls: Booking ID link to the shared detail screen, plan status and date range filters, sort.

Read-only view of one booking's installment plan, schedule and payment history. The Installment Schedule table has one row per installment; the overdue or defaulted support banner is described by a Rule.

Monitor and manage all installment plans across the platform: metric widgets, a filterable and sortable plan list, aging report, revenue forecast, export and drill-down. UI controls: widgets, filters, export, contact patient, retry, cancel booking actions.

Actionable view of one booking's installment plan with the Admin Action Panel (Retry Charge, Mark as Resolved, Cancel Plan and Apply Cancellation Policy), each with a justification of at least 20 characters. The panel is a UI control group; its justification is written to the audit log (S-06), not to a graph entity.

Patient submits the passport photo and form after the booking is Confirmed, only for Path A, so the provider can complete included bookings. Passes the on-device photo quality gate first. After submission the screen becomes a read-only confirmation of the form fields with a masked passport number and no photo.

Path B only. Full-screen prompt with the confirmed booking reference and appointment context and a single question: does the patient need to arrange travel. Yes continues to flight then hotel submission; No sets no_travel_required and goes to the itinerary showing No travel required. Buttons: Yes and No.

Path B only. Patient submits confirmed flight details for one leg; used twice for a round trip. The form header shows Outbound Flight or Return Flight. Locked on submission. Early-departure warning applies to the return leg.
Path B only. Patient submits confirmed hotel details so the provider can coordinate. Locked on submission. Early-departure warning applies to the check-out date.

Unified read-only view assembled each time it opens from the booking, TravelContext and current records: booking and accepted choice, package travel items, passport (Path A only), outbound and return flight, hotel. Shows Awaiting submission, Travel dates under admin review, and No travel required states; read-only when the TravelContext is closed.

nodes.title: Travel Section Provider Confirmed Booking Detail

attrs.description: Collapsible Travel section at the bottom of the provider's confirmed booking detail screen (FR-006 Screen 4), visible once Confirmed. Shows accepted choice summary, travel path, status badges and path-dependent actions: View Passport, Enter Flight, Enter Hotel (Path A) or View Travel Details (Path B). Shows early-departure flag, Travel dates under admin review and Travel-date review required labels.
Path A. Read-only view of the patient's passport details, with the passport number in full and the photo viewable but not downloadable. Access is logged.
Path A, only for flights included in the accepted option. Same form as the patient flight screen; the submitter is recorded as the provider. Locked on submission.
Path A, only when a hotel is included in the accepted option and none has been submitted yet. Same form as the patient hotel screen. Locked on submission.
Patient-submitted flight and hotel details shown inline as collapsible sub-sections of the Travel section for Path B bookings. Entirely read-only; no passport sub-section.

nodes.title: Travel Section Admin Confirmed Booking Detail

attrs.description: Travel section of the admin's confirmed booking detail screen, shown for every confirmed booking. Shows accepted choice, travel path, statuses and TravelContext status with the review baseline. Actions: Re-notify patient, Apply Correction (to Screen 12) and Confirm Travel Dates (review only). Unavailable actions when the TravelContext is closed.

nodes.title: Travel Record Detail and Admin Correction

attrs.description: Full travel record view and correction screen reached from Apply Correction: a header plus tabs for Passport (Path A only), Flight Details and Hotel Details. Each correction needs a mandatory reason note; admin can replace the passport photo, edit fields and soft-delete a record; corrections notify the patient and provider.
Central view of team members, roles, status, seat usage and available actions (PRD Screen 1).
Collects the details needed to invite a new team member (PRD Screen 2).
Modifies a non-Owner member's role and shows the permission difference (PRD Screen 3).

nodes.title: Remove or Suspend Team Member Modal

attrs.description: Guided reassignment and access revocation (PRD Screen 4).
High-volume reassignment before removal (PRD Screen 5).
Profile, workload, permissions and activity of one member for Owners and Admins (PRD Screen 6).
Validates the invitation token and orients the new member (PRD Screen 7).
Collects core account details and password before access is granted (PRD Screen 8).
Educates a new member on allowed actions and pending tasks (PRD Screen 9).
Cross-provider view of team members for support and compliance (PRD Screen 10).
Admin oversight of one member: profile, audit log, assigned work, deferred security and relationship tabs (PRD Screen 11).
One provider's team with an Invite Staff Member action, embedded in FR-015 Screen 3 Tab 3 (PRD Screen 12).
Admin invite form inside PRD Screen 12: email address and non-Owner role.
Show the patient a read-only view of their active treatment case, including the provider's beginning-of-treatment note, day-by-day treatment status, and an estimated graft count reference.
Show the patient a focused view of a single treatment day's description and current status when they tap a day row in Screen 1.
Display all cases currently in the "In Progress" stage for the provider's clinic, with search and filter capabilities.

The primary treatment execution workspace, displayed as a tabbed case detail page with tabs: Treatment Plan | Note | Book hotel & Book flight | In Progress (active tab during treatment). The In Progress tab is organised into three stages: Before Procedure, During Procedure, and End of Procedure.
Allow the provider to update the status of a specific treatment day and add or edit a clinical note.

Capture final treatment documentation — conclusion, prescription, advice, medications, actual graft count, final head scan photo set *(V1; true 3D scan in V2)*, and treatment photos — and signal treatment completion to FR-011.
Display all active In Progress cases across all providers and clinics platform-wide, with search, filter, and direct access to edit any case.

Allow admin to view and edit all aspects of an In Progress case — including treatment day statuses, provider notes, and case actions. The case status is never set by hand. All fields are editable by admin unless system-locked for audit integrity.

Let an admin change a case's current treatment plan days, assigned clinician set, and estimated graft count at any time from `Confirmed` onward (Alternative Flow A2). The clinic uses the same form from Screen 4, but only from `Confirmed` until Check In.

Patient aftercare home: overall progress, current milestone, days remaining, next and upcoming tasks, last scan and questionnaire, medication adherence, with quick actions to upload a scan, complete a questionnaire, view instructions and contact support.
Guided capture and upload of the head scan photo set for a due scan, with real-time quality feedback, retake, upload progress and access to previous scans. True 3D scanning is V2.
Completion of the milestone questionnaire rendered from the assigned FR-025 Questionnaire Set, with draft save, submit and a warning when responses raise the urgent flag.
Today's doses and the provider-prescribed medications with a mark-as-taken action, missed-dose indicator, weekly adherence, missed count and adherence history.
Milestone educational resources by category (videos, guides, FAQs, help) with view or download, viewed tracking and completion percentage.

Patient picks post-treatment add-on or standalone service, enters external treatment details where needed, browses purchasable templates with pricing in local currency, picks fixed or subscription and proceeds to payment.
Order summary with subtotal, platform fee, tax and total (and monthly breakdown for subscriptions), payment method choice, billing address and terms acceptance; payment is processed by FR-007.
Provider list of assigned aftercare cases with patient, treatment, current milestone, progress, medication alerts and last activity, with search and filters.

Provider view of one case with plan, progress, scan history, questionnaire responses, medication adherence history and communication log, plus actions to adjust the plan, request a scan, contact the team and escalate.
Five-step provider wizard: select a template, customize milestones, set up medications, add custom instructions, review and confirm before activation.
Provider (and admin) edit of an active plan: template, milestones, medications and instructions, with a mandatory change reason, approval status for major changes and change history.
Provider progress view of an assigned patient: timeline, overdue tasks, scan and questionnaire status, adherence, compliance and a recent activity feed.
Admin list of every aftercare case across providers with provider, type, milestone, progress, medication alerts and status, with search, filters and actions.
Four-tab admin case view: overview, progress tracking, communication log and admin actions (edit plan, reassign via Screen 19, escalate, add notes, change history).
Admin intake of paid standalone requests: patient and treatment details, documentation, concerns, photos, provider choice by specialization and availability, assign or reject with reason.

Admin template list and editor: milestones, scan and questionnaire schedule per milestone, educational resources, resource files, and pricing configuration per currency (purchase availability, pricing model, default payment method, discounts).

Backlog (post-MVP analytics): provider list and performance metrics, case drill-down and actions (feedback, reassign, suspend). Its data fields are aggregate metrics with no entity; only the provider name is mapped.

Backlog (post-MVP analytics): system-wide progress overview, provider performance grid, status distribution and real-time alerts. Its data fields are aggregate metrics with no entity; only the case status and milestone phase are mapped.
Admin reassigns the aftercare provider or Hairline aftercare team of a case (including a treatment-linked case whose booking stays Aftercare) with mandatory reason and confirmation.

Patient views all conversations with providers (one entry per provider), searches, filters by read status, sorts, sees unread counts and the admin badge, and opens a conversation. Layout: search and filter bar over a paginated conversation list.
Patient messages one provider with text and attachments, sees timestamps and read receipts, and can start an audio or video call. Reached only from the inbox.
Header popup showing the provider's recent conversations (10 by default, up to 20 when filtered) with unread counts, search and filters, and a link to the full chat view.
Three-panel chat: conversation list on the left, message thread and compose area in the centre, conversation info, quote references, call buttons and actions on the right.
Admin list of all patient-provider conversations with comprehensive simultaneous filters, search, sort, flag and intervention badges.

Same layout as Screen 6A with a warning banner, admin compose area, mandatory emergency reason, internal justification and pre-send checklist; message goes to both parties.

Review detail for the provider with an inline response composer (not a separate screen): Respond as Provider, response text with live character counter, cancel with confirmation, submit.
Global paginated review list with source type, flagged and response badges, filters, search, and navigation to detail, takedown queue and review settings.

Review categories/labels, photo guidelines, removal reason catalog, reviewer display policy, flagging thresholds, takedown SLA settings, read-only link-outs to FR-030 for invitation and reminder cadence, and the review export action.

Purpose: Single scrollable page for daily triage. Three vertically stacked sections (A: Inbox, B: Performance, C: Financials). No tabs. Layout: Header (filters) → Section A → Section B → Section C. Collapse to single-column on ≤1024px.

Purpose: Deep analysis of how efficiently the provider converts inquiries to bookings, including TTFQ trends and benchmarking. Filters: Time range (same options as Screen 1 global) + Country + Treatment type (multi-select)
Purpose: Understanding who the provider's patients are, where they come from, how satisfied they are, and how long their journey takes. Filters: Time range + Country
Purpose: Full financial picture — revenue breakdown, refunds, installment health, and complete payout history. Filters: Time range + Country + Treatment type (applicability per Rule 5A)

Purpose: Understand the prices patients actually accepted, their descriptive relationship with parent-quote acceptance rates, and the provider's position relative to platform peers. This screen does not measure the full offered-price market or establish that price causes conversion changes. Filters: Time range + Country + Treatment type
Purpose: Allow providers to generate PDF or CSV exports of any analytics screen's data.

Purpose: Platform health at a glance — one scrollable page with three sections mirroring the provider dashboard structure but aggregated across all providers. Filters: Time range (same options) + Country + Provider (optional, defaults to All); Layout: Three sections (A: Operations, B: Performance, C: Finance). Responsive layout required: multi-column on desktop, reduced-density stacked layout on tablet/mobile, with a single-column fallback on ≤1024px.

Purpose: Two-section screen — Performance (conversion quality) and Engagement (activity/dormancy). These are distinct jobs: performance tells you how well a provider works; engagement tells you whether they're working at all. Filters: Time range + Country + TTFQ health tier (All / Green / Amber / Red) + Engagement status (All / Active / At Risk / Dormant)

Purpose: How patients enter the platform and move through the inquiry-to-booking funnel. Affiliate acquisition tracked where available. Filters: Time range + Country + Treatment type (applicability per Rule 5A)

Purpose: Strategic supply/demand view. Where is patient demand concentrated? Where does the platform have insufficient provider coverage? Used for expansion planning and targeted provider recruitment. Filters: Time range (affects inquiry and booking data) + Treatment type (applicability per Rule 5A)

Purpose: How treatments are performing operationally and in patient satisfaction. Scope is strictly operational and satisfaction-based — no clinical outcomes exist in the database (no graft survival rates, no hair density measurements, no complication data). Filters: Time range + Country + Provider (optional) + Treatment type

Purpose: Platform financial risk monitoring and revenue health. The admin's question is: "Is money flowing correctly, what do we owe, and where are the risks?"; Filters: Time range + Country + Currency

Purpose: Accepted-price landscape across providers and treatments. Helps Hairline understand the prices patients selected and identify descriptive outliers; it does not represent every offered alternative or measure offered-price conversion. Filters: Time range + Country + Treatment type
Admin list of all providers with status count tiles, search and filters, a 50-row table and per-row quick actions (Screen 1).
Six-step wizard (basic information, professional details, clinic, documents, commission and settings, review) that creates an Active provider (Screen 2).
Tabbed provider view: Basic Information, Languages, Staff List, Awards, Reviews, Documents, Commission and Financials, Activity Log; header quick actions including Login as Provider (Screen 3).

Target time for the idempotent background job of the A5 cancellation cascade, counted from the effective time.

Maximum team size per provider organization, configured by admins in FR-015; adjustable 1-500. Stub created during FR-009 migration.
